Accurate knowledge of the rotor position is vital to ensure the smooth operation of the drive. A vector-controlled PMSM drive comprises two interconnected loops: an outer loop for speed control and an inner loop for current control. This hierarchical control structure enables precise speed regulation and exemplary-grained management of the motor's current components, enhancing overall performance and efficiency. Using fuzzy logic in the current loop, the control system can handle non-linearities, uncertainties, and complex dynamics more effectively than a traditional PI controller. In this project, the performance of the PMSM motor is tested and analyzed using PI & Fuzzy in MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: Fractional Order PID Controller for a 2DoF Rotary Torsion Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this work, a Fractional Order Proportional-Integral-Derivative (FOPID) controller is proposed to control the rotational load's angular position in a 2 degree of freedom (2DoF) rotary torsion plant. The 2DoF torsion system which is used here consists of torsion modules that have flexible coupling connected to the shaft of a DC servo motor. Here the linear dynamics of a 2DoF torsional plant is obtained. Then a FOPID controller is developed for position control, in which method of Particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique is used to tune the parameters of this controller. FOPID controllers have been shown to be more robust to parameter variations, external disturbances, and modeling errors than traditional PID controllers. The effectiveness of the proposed FOPID control system is compared to that of the traditional PID and 2DoF PID control systems. Robustness analysis is also done with the developed controller. As per the results obtained in simulation, controlled output of proposed FOPID controller presents no overshoot, less settling time, and zero steady-state error in comparison to the the conventional PID, and 2DoF PID control systems.

Author Keywords: 2 degree of freedom rotary torsion plant

articleTitle: Development of Active Toy for Increasing Eye-Hand Coordination and Reaction Time Among Toddlers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Eye-hand coordination and reaction time are important skills for performing a wide range of physical activities and tasks. These skills can be enhanced with practice and training in childhood when the brain is more adaptable and flexible. The project aims at making an active toy for children. This active toy is intended to increase the eye-hand coordination and reaction time of users. It is a simple but cost-effective structure. The difficulty of the game can be adjusted using a compatible mobile application. This paper discusses the hardware and software implementations of the prototype.

articleTitle: Decentralised Society Using Soulbound Tokens
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Today's world revolves around Web 3.0 technology to form a decentralized network as it addresses issues such as privacy, connection, and security that were at stake in Web 2.0. This paper proposes a system that can be used by Educational Institutions, Students, and Recruiting Organizations to provide an environment that can store and verify the credibility of students. The proposed system is built using the concept of Web 3.0 and utilizes technologies such as Soul Bound Tokens(SBTs) that underlie Block Chain technology. On successful implementation of the system, the results observed are; it provides a secure environment to store the certifications or data of students that cannot be forged, reproduced, or removed from the chain, also addresses concerns regarding the privacy of crucial data by proposing the off-chain data storing method which shall enhance the provenance of the student's data. Finally, this system emphasizes building an environment that stores students' data and processes them in a decentralized manner which shall resolve the concerns of Web 2.0.

articleTitle: Lane Detection for Self-Driving Cars Using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Concern regarding the nature of accidents has grown as the frequency of traffic incidents has increased. It happens frequently as a result of human mistake. In order to assist drivers, lane detection systems are currently being created with the primary aim of identifying lanes and warning drivers about potential lane departures. There are multiple techniques for detecting lanes, with many focusing on straight lanes. This paper's main goal is to examine the drawbacks of various lane detecting algorithms and suggest a solution that does away with them. This work uses artificial intelligence to recognize lanes using OpenCV, NumPy, and digital image processing (noise removal, edge detection, Hough transformation).

articleTitle: Oral Expression Evaluation Algorithm Based on Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of oral expression in oral learning is very important, but there is a problem that language expression is not clear. The public's oral expression information is easily distorted, poorly recorded, and the transmission distance is short. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-feature fusion oral expression scheme for oral expression evaluation and analysis. Firstly, the teaching theory is used to evaluate the oral expression of learners, and the oral expression is divided according to the fusion of multiple characteristics, so as to reduce the defects in general oral language Factor. Then, the pedagogical theory teaches learners ordinary oral English, forms a contrasting scheme, and synthesizes the results of the two Analyse. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the oral expression evaluation algorithm with multi-feature fusion has higher accuracy, more complete expression, and long propagation distance.

articleTitle: Image Manipulation Detection Using Error Level Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Image editing is now easy because there are so many user-friendly multimedia tools available. The photographs can be altered using a variety of methods. The process of combining two or more photos to produce a single composite image is known as “image splicing,” one of numerous methods for altering images. These edited images might be used to trick others. A deep learning-based method to detect picture splicing in the photographs is suggested in this work. The input image must first be preprocessed using a technique called “ELA” in order to extract the noise remnant from the input image by suppressing the image content. Second, the well-known MobileNet network is used as a feature extractor. The obtained features are then tested for authenticity using the Voting Classifier classifier. Research on the CASIA dataset shows that the suggested approach performs better than competing approaches already in use. The proposed method achieves an average classification accuracy of 94.24.

articleTitle: Taylor and Chebyshev Method Based Evolutionary Computational Techniques for Antenna Designing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The operation of a number of functionalities on the identical antennas needs a topological reconfigurability to obtain a radiation pattern and frequency agility. Specifically, different parameters like profile, array's size and grid spacing ought to be altered to adjust according to the necessities set by the reasoned functionality. Evolutionary computational methods like the Taylor Method and Chebyshev Scheme are applied in scheming novel types of antennas with remarkable designs. Using this technique, an antenna's design may be improved to achieve specified potential frequency reconfigurability for enhancing wideband performance.

articleTitle: Using Discussion Thread Context in Sentiment Analysis for Improving Cyberbullying Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cyberbullying is the act of harassing, demeaning, or threatening someone via technology such as social networking, texting, or instant messaging. It is defined as “willful and repeated harm inflicted through the medium of electronic text” (Patchin and Hinduja 2006:152) [1]. Cyberbullying is an underlying problem in social networking services, threatening users' mental and physical health. The aim of this study is to improve the detection of cyberbullying in discussion threads by utilizing the repeated negative context formed in the presence of cyberbullying.

articleTitle: MODI Script Recognition System Using Zernike Moments and DCT Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Modi Script or the old Marathi script was the script used to write Marathi language prominently before 1950's. Due to its intricate writing style and bent character properties, it has lost its meaning. In recent years, it has become crucial to examine old writings in order to glean meaningful information from them. It is difficult to recognize the documents since they are damaged and because the MODI script's overlapping characters make it tough. Different classifiers, including Decision Tree, SVM, KNN, and others, have been used in some MODI script recognition systems (MSRS) that have been proposed thus far. In order to achieve high accuracy, this research offers a Modi script recognition system that calculates Zernike moments and DCT coefficients as features. Each of the 27 classes in the custom dataset, which each represent a different character, was made. Different categorization methods, including Decision Tree, Random Forest, and KNN, were used. These were used to evaluate the system's performance. 97.77% high accuracy was achieved following feature fusion.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Approach to Identify Plastic Bottle for Environment Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Several classification problems have been resolved with computer vision and deep learning technology. Despite this, no dedicated work has been carried out to classify plastic bottles from non-bottle objects. Therefore, this paper is concerned to resolve issue to classify waste plastic bottle from non-bottle objects. Here a dataset of 52000 images of bottle and non-bottle has been used to classify different objects based on their size. Each image contains a single bottle and non-bottle object. In this paper, various pre-trained models have been employed to classify these objects based on their size. The pretrained models have been trained with bottle dataset and attained 97%, 92% and 91 % accuracy. The comparison shows that the ResNet-18 outperforms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Digital Hearing Aid System with an Improved Speech Intelligibilty
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A significant amount of the global population suffers from hearing impairment and a small portion of it makes use of hearing aids. A hearing aid is to make sound audible to a person with hearing loss and to improve their hearing ability. This paper presents efficient digital filter design and implementation approaches for the efficient implementation for a customizable digital hearing aid system. The comparative analysis for various window functions for Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filters is presented. Our experimentation shows that the Kaiser window stood to be the best window function for hearing aid application. Experimental results stated through the time domain analysis and spectrogram plots, demonstrate the effectiveness of the FIR filters. The proposed design approach for the customizable digital hearing aid system helps in improving speech intelligibility and effectively reduce the AWGN noise.

articleTitle: Issues with the Use of the Hampel Filter for the Recovery of Event-Related Dynamics from Electrophysiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Frequency-domain Hampel filter can eliminate narrow-band artifacts contaminating electrophysiological signals like EEG/MEG. Artifact removal is expected to unmask the underlying Event-related dynamics (ERD) and help us better understand the neural mechanisms. Though Hampel filtering has been shown to recover resting state EEG well, Hampel filter can attenuate the ERD. In this work, we investigate the effect of Hampel filter parameter tuning on the recovery/attenuation of event-related dynamics in the presence of narrow-band artifacts by simulating a gamma-band ERD masked by a synthetic Deep brain stimulation (DBS) artifact. Hampel filter was deployed on the simulated signal created by adding synthetic DBS artifact to the event-related gamma activity. We analysed the recovery of underlying gamma-ERD by the Hampel filter while varying the two filter parameters viz., window length and threshold. We determine the optimal parameter settings for recovery of event-related dynamics. We show that the ERD recovery is better with shorter window lengths and laxer thresholds but the approach results in residual artifact. In contrast, longer window lengths and stringent thresholds remove both ERD and artifact. Our results indicate that Hampel parameters be set based on the study's objectives with a longer window length if the elimination of artifacts is a priority and a shorter window length if the recovery of ERD is essential.

articleTitle: Dynamic Changing Trustability Based Secured Protocol For Collaborative Data Transmission In Mobile Adhoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Secured data transmission in mobile adhoc network is an more difficult where there will not be any decentralized environment to monitor the packet transmission progress. There are various methods has been introduced earlier for ensuring the secured data transmission. However those research methodologies tends to have more demerits such as reduced data delivery rate, increased delay and so on. These problems are focused and resolved in the proposed research methodology by introducing the method namely Dynamic Changing Trustability based Secured MANET Protocol (DCT-SMANET-P). In this method, trustable nodes in the network environment will be find out first, through which data transmission will be carried out. Once trust values are evaluated, direct route path between the network nodes will be estimated based on which most trustable nodes will be chooses and the network carrier changes will be calculated. After trust estimation, routing will be carried out by choosing the most suitable route path through which data transmission will be carried out. The overall simulation of the research work is carried out in the NS3 simulation environment from which it is proved that the proposed methodology attains better outcome than the existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Predicting the Impact of Advertisement on Sales Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's world, sales has become very important factor for business to survive in competition. For increasing sales marketing go hand in hand to increase sales. Ultimately, it has been observed that advertisement has great impact on Sales. Current study focuses on finding the correlation between sales and advertisement. There are tons of example and parameter which lead us to assumption or prediction is correct or not. Current study helps in identifying which advertisement is most suitable to increase sales. The use of machine learning approaches becomes an important part for modelling business and also keeping in consideration the purchase patterns of consumers. The comparison between TV, Radio and Newspaper is conducted for predicting whose advertisement is more accurate or can lead us to generate more sales is discussed using Linear Regression in the current study. Linear regression analysis is a statistical procedure for calculating dependent variable from the independent variables.

articleTitle: Development of a Real-Time Guidance System for Matched Placement of Surface Electrodes in a Repeated Measures Design
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Recording electromyography (EMG) data from the upper limb plays a huge role in sensorimotor investigations. Such investigations may require a repeated measures design wherein the experimenter has to place surface electrodes on locations matched to that of the previous sessions. However, this is prone to human error, and the resulting locations decided by the experimenter across sessions might not be precisely matched. This might lead to differences in the corresponding cortical correlates, the estimate of which is not yet known. No tool currently exists that can assist the experimenter in the above problem. We propose a novel tool, Myolocate, that will use a webcam to identify the electrodes placed in the human arm and their corresponding locations with respect to well-known anatomical points in the arm in the first session of the experiment and guide the experimenter, in real-time, to quickly identify the electrode locations in subsequent sessions without having to go through the measurement of anatomical reference to resolve the electrode positions of the previous session. The proposed tool will ease locating electrode position and optimize the data acquisition process.

articleTitle: Implementation of Anti Drowsy Alarm for Drivers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Automobile accidents are caused by driving when fatigued for an extended period of time or by operating a vehicle after drinking alcohol. These accidents result in many fatalities and severe injuries. These mishaps might all have been avoided. A technology that can alert the driver via buzzer and identify alcohol and fatigue is in high demand. The method described in this study continuously monitors the eye and warns the driver if signs of drowsiness are detected. Moreover, the technology has the ability to detect alcohol use and a head tilt. An authorized person will also receive the information and the location so that the appropriate steps can be taken to lower the risk of accidents.

articleTitle: Cartesian Genetic Programming Algorithm and its Application in Artistic Graphics Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Cartesian genetic programming algorithm is a method of generating images using genetic rules. The basic idea behind it is to create a random “gene” population, and then combine them into new genes through crossover and mutation, which will generate new combinations that can be used to generate images. This algorithm has created a new form of artistic expression, expanding people's understanding and understanding of artistic graphics. In the generation of artistic graphics, this algorithm is often applied to design and draw symmetrical shapes, while also continuously optimizing and improving based on individual fitness and other selection operations. In addition, the Cartesian genetic programming algorithm can also be used in the fields of 2D and 3D graphic design to meet different application needs. The main idea behind it is to represent the image as a grid of pixels, where each pixel has its own color value and brightness. In this way, we can use the Cartesian genetic programming algorithm (CGPA) to find the appropriate color and brightness for each pixel in the image. The basic idea behind CGPA is that we have an input image (image) composed of pixels arranged on a 2D grid. In summary, the Cartesian genetic programming algorithm has important application value in the generation of artistic graphics. It can not only optimize the traditional graph generation algorithm, but also develop some new artistic expressions, adapt to different application scenarios, and promote the progress and development of computer graphics and art fields.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of CABAC Decoder in HEVC Using HLS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In real-time Ultra High Definition (UHD) applications, video compression (VC) is essential. The H.265/HEVC standard is the newest of various VC algorithms available. In contrast to the predecessor AVC (Advanced Video Codec) standard, it can handle the UHD image at 120 frames per second. H.265/HEVC employs modern approaches like the sample adaptive offset (SAO) filter, inter- and intra-prediction, and CABAC entropy coding (Context-based Adaptive Binary Arithmetic Coding). In H.265/HEVC, CABAC is the sole entropy code that is employed. The computational complexity of CABAC decoding poses a significant challenge to achieving fast and efficient video decoding. This paper addresses this challenge by developing a hardware IP core for the HEVC video-coding standard that accelerates the CABAC decoding process, allowing real-time decoding of higher-resolution video streams. The proposed method uses the Xilinx Vitis HLS tool to generate RTL code for the CABAC decoder from a C++ implementation.

articleTitle: Depletion of Torque Ripple in Induction Motor Using Direct Torque Control Technique Incorporating Novel Multilevel Inverter Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Induction Motors (1M) are popularly used in different industries due to robustness, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. They also offer efficient and dependable operation. The Direct Torque Control (DTC) has gained significant recognition as a powerful technique for speed and torque control in electric drives. One of the key strengths of DTC is its exceptional dynamic torque performance which enables precise and rapid control of the motor torque, allowing quick and accurate response to changes in the load. Inverters that have multiple levels have recently acquired popularity due to the improved performance. The viability of a DTC technique for reducing the torque ripple via a Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) Three Level Inverter (TLI) is studied in this research. TLI with fewer switches compared to conventional TLI is used in this strategy. The efficacy of the suggested method is demonstrated by comparing its torque ripple and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) with traditional DTC methods. The performance analysis is carried out using the MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Operating System Command Execution Using Voice Command
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Recent years have seen a considerable increase in the use of voice commands as a result of the growing popularity of smart gadgets, virtual assistants, and other related technologies. In this study, we investigate the viability of voice commands for operating system commands. In this paper a system is proposed and demonstrated that enables voice commands to be recognized by the operating system and executed according to parameters. This way it is offering a fresh and more usable voice assistant to carry out typical computer chores. Python tools are used to go over how the system is put into practice, including how speech recognition and natural language processing are used, and how well it executes in terms of accuracy, speed, and usefulness. The main impact factor of this paper is to provide voice assistance to disadvantageous people whose hands and fingers are not working well.

articleTitle: Towards Realizing Lightweight Consensus Protocol for IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) refers to the network of heterogeneous computing devices that are web-enabled and have the capabilities of sensing, collecting, processing, and disseminating data. The IoT devices are embedded with various sensors or actuators supported by communication hardware and protocols to ensure their deployment for real-world applications. Furthermore, these devices can use logic building with sensor inputs and on connecting actuators to generate relevant output. With numerous applications but the unavailability of basic security policies, interoperability issues, and resource constraint environment, IoT devices nowadays face lots of difficulty in terms of ensuring communication security. Also, the use of simple processors and stripped-down operating systems which may not support sophisticated security approaches, make IoT systems vulnerable to security attacks. The advent of blockchain technology paved the way to secure data or information using distributed hashed ledger of transactions. With blockchain, one can ensure the secure sharing and dissemination of data between the entities running blockchain network. However, deploying blockchain with IoT systems may hinder their performance and efficiency because of resource constraint characteristics of heterogeneous devices. In this research work, we have explored a lightweight blockchain-based approach using AERGO blockchain to secure data transfer between IoT devices. The same has been confirmed for validity and effectiveness using a test-bed setup of IoT devices.

articleTitle: PLI Cancellation from Biomedical Signals Using VDTA-Based Notch/Comb Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research article presents a novel VDTA-based notch and comb filters and their application in suppressing power-line interference from low-frequency biomedical signals. They use a lesser number of active and passive components. First, it discusses the design of a single VDTA-based notch filter. Then by cascading four such notch filters, a comb filter is designed to eliminate one fundamental frequency and three consecutive odd harmonics. These filters' quality factor and pole frequency can be adjusted independently. Also, one can tune the filters electronically by varying the VDTA's bias currents. The proposed notch filter uses two capacitors, one resistor, and a VDTA. For effective notching of the 50Hz PLI and three consecutive odd harmonics (150Hz, 250Hz, and 350Hz), the comb filter's pole frequencies and quality factors are set to 50Hz, 150Hz, 250Hz, and 350Hz and 10, 20, 30, and 40, respectively. The filters have been simulated using PSPICE simulator software in 180nm CMOS technology. The simulated frequency responses of the proposed filters show the sharp notching of these frequencies. Further, to check the filter's effectiveness in the time domain, an ECG signal is corrupted with an artificial 50Hz PLI and passed through. The output response shows that the proposed filter effectively suppresses the noise from ECG signals.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Inference System Based Intelligent Food Recommender System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The personalized suggestions using the intelligent methods are becoming promising ways to change eating habits to-ward more desirable diets. This has necessitated the requirements of intelligent food recommender system (FRS). This paper has designed a FRS using the Fuzzy Inference System (FIS) to suggest the food preference (FP). This is achieved using the different system blocks such as Rule Base, Database, Decision-making Unit, Fuzzification Interface Unit (FIU), and Defuzzification Interface Unit (DIU). The FP is decided by processing the input variables such as Age, Income and Calorific values. This is achieved with an accuracy of higher than 95%. Efficacy of proposed FRS is established by comparing the performance with the rule based FRS reported in literature. Study is performed using the coding environment of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Plastic Waste to Fuel - An Affordable Approach Towards Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: It is widely known that plastic plays a vital role in our daily lives. Plastic's adaptability leads to the overuse of single-use plastic products, which has severe environmental consequences. The problem arises in the disposal of this massive amount of plastic. There are just a few methods of safe disposal of plastic waste without harming the environment. The burning of plastic simply leads to toxins spreading in the air. Plastic waste conversion into fuel is an ideal approach in these times of increased fuel demand. Highly complex and costly methods such as Pyrolysis for converting plastic litter into a valuable product are, therefore in high demand. This paper presents a proposed methodology which is cheaper, indigenous and simple to suit a rural community in India. It includes an intelligent plastic waste collection system and plastic to fuel conversion system powered by renewable sources. The proposed method is well aligned with United Nations Sustainability Development Goals (UNSDG) such as Sustainability Cities and Communities Target (SDG - 11) by minimizing the quantity of plastic litter that pollutes the environment and the Affordable and Clean Energy Aim (SDG - 7).

articleTitle: Predicting Mental Health Illness using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Nowadays, people are becoming more and more concerned with their physical health, but mental health is not given the same level of attention. Even if they are aware that they have been afflicted by chronic mental illnesses, many people choose not to seek treatment out of fear of what others would think, a belief that they have lost their minds, a dislike of doctors, or all three. These circumstances make it urgently necessary to find a solution so that more individuals are not inclined to mental diseases. This paper focuses on forecasting mental health using deep learning approaches and machine learning algorithm that is support vector machine. Support vector machine is used to solve the existing problem, as many machine learning and deep learning techniques are helping to solve these contemporary difficulties. SVM gives more accuracy compared to other machine learning algorithms to predict the mental illness.

articleTitle: Battery Pack Modeling for the Analysis of Battery Temperature and Current Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The temperature and current management of battery storage systems are crucial for the performance, safety, and longevity of electric vehicles (EVs). This paper describes a battery temperature and current monitoring and control system for a battery EV storage system that allows for real-time temperature and current monitoring and control while charging and discharging the battery. The proposed system, which is intended to be integrated into the EV storage system, consists of temperature and current sensors, microcontrollers, and wireless communication modules. The control unit can modify the charging and discharging parameters depending on the temperature and current data to optimize battery performance and prevent thermal damage. The system continuously monitors the temperature and current flow of the battery cells and transmits real-time data to the control unit. Results from simulation and experiments that indicate the system can precisely monitor the battery temperature and current and maintain it within safe operating limits serve as evidence of the system's performance. The suggested monitoring and control system has potential applications in a variety of EV scenarios and can increase the safety, effectiveness, and dependability of the EV storage system.

articleTitle: A Study on the SNR and SINR Performance of a LiFi Transmission System: From the Perspective of a Smart Classroom in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Light Fidelity (LiFi) has been developed to tackle the spectrum crisis raised due to the immerse enhancement of the communication technology since it can utilize higher spectrum, i.e., above 300 THz. The objective of the work is to analyze signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and signal-to-noise-plus-interference ratio (SINR) in the context of a smart classroom of Bangladesh. The work first analyzed the SNR deploying a single LiFi access point (AP). Afterward, it analyzed SNR and SINR deploying 2 LiFi AP. The work derived that, 2 LiFi AP provides better SNR performance in the context of the considered room dimension compared to the single AP scenario. Moreover, the research found that increasing the separation distance between the 2 LiFi APs assures better SINR performance, especially at the cell edge.

articleTitle: Image based Lung Disease Detection: Comparing Swin Transformers and ConvNets
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Each year, chest diseases prematurely claim 4 million lives. They are very difficult to detect even for experienced radiologists. Thus, there is a need to develop artificial intelligence-based detection systems to aid in the diagnosis of chest diseases. The paper proposes a Swin Transformer based approach to classify images into one or more out of 14 chest diseases. The model is trained using a large number chest X-ray images from the Chest X-ray14 dataset. The proposed architecture uses multiple projection heads for improved results. The proposed model is compared to existing solutions based on Convolutional Neural Networks available for the problem and produces an AUC of 0.801 with state-of-the-art performances in four pathologies.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Cryptography Using Reversible Logic Gates for Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In VLSI, heat dissipation is of major concern, which can be reduced by using reversible logic gates in the implementation of the designs. Reversible computations have a broad range of applications in fields such as nanotechnology, low power CMOS, optical computing, digital image processing, etc. It is one among the important technique for low power designs. In today's world securing data is of great importance and to secure data cryptography is used. This paper focuses on image cryptography using Reversible Logic Gates (RLGs). The reason for including reversible gates into cryptography is that it gives much better energy efficiency than other conventional cryptographic systems. In this work an image cryptograpy design is implemeted using Reversible Logic Gates Cryptography Design (RLGCD), RLGCD is used for both encryption and decryption block. Reversible Linear feedback shift register (RLFSR) is used to generate key for the cryptographic system. Thereby implementing the cryptographic system using Reversible Logic Gates for encryption and decryption, and RLFSR for key generation, we intend to make the system secure with more power efficiency and also observed that there is not much distortion of image quality. Analysed the power efficiency of the RLFSR and conventional LFSR and there is great improvement in power efficiency for RLFSR and also the performance of the RLGCD is evaluated. The program is done in MATLAB and Xilinx Vivado.

articleTitle: Prediction of Parkinson's Disease Using Feature Optimization and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Categorization has been significant field for researchers. It deals with the categorization of items using various techniques such as soft computing, machine learning, deep learning etc. Grouping images on the basis of their properties is termed as Image Classification. Image classification is important filed of research for medical, industrial, scientific and real world applications. A standard dataset of Parkinson's disease is attained from UCI and Hybrid approach of optimization and classification is applied. Optimization algorithm is used to minimize the dimensionality of dataset and classification technique is applied on reduced data set.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Power Divider with Quarter wavelength Short-circuited Stubs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A microstrip line ultra-wideband (UWB) power divider (PD) is proposed, analyzed, and designed. This division is achieved by installing a UWB power divider consisting of a single 50-ohm transmission line in the horizontal plane and 3-Quarter wavelength(λ/4) short-circuited stubs (QWSCS) loaded in the vertical plane. One of the stubs is in the middle of one side of the 50-Ωtransmission line, while the other two, of the same proportions, are in symmetrical positions on the other side of the transmission line. All of the stubs are separated by about a half wavelength. Between the two output ports, a single resistor is suitably placed to improve isolation. Following a simple transmission line theory study, it is demonstrated that 3–4 dB power splitting from one input to two output ports, high impedance matching at all three ports, and excellent isolation between two output ports are produced within the specified 3.5-12 GHz UWB range.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Voltage Stability with Integration of Wind Power Generation: Evaluating the Impact on Power System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The growing demand for energy worldwide and the urgency to combat climate change have compelled the power and energy sector to prioritize renewable energy sources (RES) as a means of generating electricity. Wind power generation (WPG) has become increasingly significant in recent times. This study explores the influence of progressively higher WPG penetration on voltage stability and various power system parameters across different load scenarios. The integration of wind power generation is implemented at the weakest bus in the IEEE-14 bus standard test system. The investigation involves incrementally increasing the penetration levels of WPG from 0% to 100% in 10% intervals, while also considering variations in the loading parameter (λ). The AC power flow calculations are conducted using the Newton-Raphson (NR) method, which is implemented in MATLAB. Furthermore, the MATLAB program is employed to evaluate voltage stability indices and other power grid parameters in this study. The specific findings of this study provide evidence to support the idea that a low level of WPG at a single node yields beneficial outcomes and shows positive effects on the performance of the power grid. This paper presents promising results.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Algorithms in Blended Teaching of Financial Analysis Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Higher education is developing towards the trend of informatization, and the way college students learn financial analysis courses has also undergone essential changes. The traditional classroom teaching mode is too single, the content is boring, it cannot attract students, and the teaching effect is not satisfactory. At the same time, there are many contents covered in the financial analysis course, among which financial texts can help enterprises avoid investment risks and prevent financial fraud. Therefore, colleges and universities adopt a blended teaching model, which combines traditional classroom teaching mode on the basis of constructivist education theory, and uses online teaching platforms to improve teaching quality. In the blended teaching of financial analysis classroom, an improved algorithm is introduced to retain the characteristic word frequency factor of financial texts and reassign the weight of characteristic words. The use of this method can improve the performance of financial text classification, so that teachers can complete the blended teaching of financial analysis courses in a targeted manner.

articleTitle: The Engineering Application of Distributed Clean Energy System Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The application of distributed clean energy system is of great significance to achieve energy conservation and emission reduction, but there is a problem of poor energy utilization efficiency. /b10>Based on genetic algorithms, it cannot solve the application problem of clean energy system, and the energy efficiency is low. /b11>Therefore, this paper proposes an ant colony algorithm to study the application of distributed clean energy systems. Firstly, the advantageous performance of the ant colony algorithm is described, and the index requirements are divided according to the application requirements. Secondly, the ant colony algorithm is used to form a clean energy system application scheme, and the effect of system application is comprehensively analyzed. /b12>The simulation results of MATLAB show that the ant colony algorithm can effectively improve the efficiency of energy utilization and achieve sustainable development of energy conservation and emission reduction.

articleTitle: A Technique of X-PROP Verification of Power-Aware Debug Logic Integration Using Formal Verification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop the methodology for formal connectivity checks along with X-PROP and low power verification for the static design trees in the SOC in such a way that it will left-shift the validation process to enhance validation productivity beyond its primary goal of finding bugs at an early stage. Using this methodology the time-consuming and labor-intense simulations are replaced which will ensure that the system meets the highest standards of quality and efficiency. The formal connectivity properties, formal X-PROP analysis, and formal power-aware characteristics are used in conjunction as part of a holistic verification strategy to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and power efficiency of the static design trees in the SOC's debug fabric. Because of the combinational nature of the debug infrastructure, the debug fabric distributed across the SOC (with multiple power domains) faces a unique connectivity difficulty. If even one component of the network fails, the entire network fails. There is no escape route or recuperation facility. Applying formal verification techniques to the debug path validation in the SOC ensures that the debugging infrastructure operates correctly and reliably, enabling effective debugging and testing of the design. This helps in detecting and resolving issues during development and ultimately results in a more robust and reliable end product.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Economic Industrial Structure by BP Neural Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Analyzing and predicting the economic and industrial structure can grasp the future development characteristics and trends of the industrial structure, thereby helping to optimize and upgrade the industrial structure. Analyzed the basic principles of BP neural network and genetic algorithm, and further analyzed the prediction of economic and industrial structure using BP neural network based on genetic algorithm. This article introduces the application of BP neural network based on genetic algorithm in the analysis and prediction of economic industrial structure. One of the important indicators of economic development is the change in industrial structure. In order to predict economic development trends more accurately, an improved BP neural network model is proposed based on the traditional BP neural network model and combined with genetic algorithm. This model utilizes genetic algorithm to optimize the structure of the BP neural network, and enhances the generalization ability of the neural network by learning similar patterns from the training set. Experiments have shown that the improved BP neural network has higher prediction accuracy and lower error rate. This model will be widely applied in industries such as finance and economy, and is expected to provide more accurate predictions and effective decision support for economic development.

articleTitle: Low Power Performance Analysis of 16-Bit Vedic Math RISC Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to design a low-power 16-Bit Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC) processor. The processer design with Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU) and Multiplier and Accumulator (MAC) is implemented using Vedic Math Sutra. The Vedic Math Sutras lies in their ability to simplify and speed up mathematical calculations. These sutras provide a systematic approach to problem-solving to solve mathematical problems quickly and accurately. Within the 16 sutras Urdhva-Triyagbhyam is one among them which means “vertically and crosswise calculations. Introducing Urdhva-Triyagbhyam Vedic Math Sutra in a 16-Bit RISC processor allows to achieve fast operation with less instruction set. This sutra can be implemented using a sequence of simple instructions to perform the multiplication operation. Therefore, the multipliers and adders are designed using Verilog Hardware Descriptive Language (HDL) and simulated through XILINX Vivado software with Artix 7 board. The work uses three Ripple Carry Adder (RCA) and one half-adder of 16 Bit in multiplier unit to reduce power consumption, delay and Slice/Look Up Table (LUT). In addition, modules like Program Counter, Register Bank and Memory block units are designed within RISC Processor. The proposed architecture emphasizes the utilization of LUT's are 997 through which the power consumption is reduced to 0.18W. Hence the speed of operation, reduction in power consumption, and area are improved

articleTitle: Technical Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms in Artificial Intelligence Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of artificial intelligence in image recognition technology is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate recognition. OCR recognition technology cannot solve the artificial intelligence problem in image recognition technology, and the recognition accuracy is low. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine learning algorithm for image recognition artificial intelligence analysis. First, computer computing is used to identify images, and indicators are divided according to artificial intelligence requirements to reduce artificial intelligence in the interfering factor. Then, the computer calculates the artificial intelligence on image recognition, forms an artificial intelligence scheme, and performs on the artificial intelligence results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy of machine learning algorithms for artificial intelligence image recognition The recognition rate was better than OCR recognition technology.

articleTitle: Investigation of Various Machine Learning Techniques for Banknote Authentication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Banknote authentication is a critical aspect of the financial industry, playing a vital role in ensuring the integrity of transactions and safeguarding against counterfeiting and fraudulent activities. The prevention of counterfeit banknotes is of utmost importance due to the significant economic and national security risks associated with such activities. To address this challenge, advanced techniques utilizing machine learning algorithms trained on extensive datasets are employed to identify distinctive features and patterns characteristic of authentic banknotes. This work focuses on comparing and evaluating the performance of various machine learning models in the task of banknote authentication. The models under consideration include Logistic Regression With LBFGS, Logistic Regression With SGD, SVM With SGD, Random Forest, XgBoost, and Neural Network. By analyzing various parameters, the study aims to identify the most accurate and efficient approach for verifying banknote authenticity, thereby ensuring the integrity and security of financial transactions. The impact of counterfeit banknotes extends beyond the financial sector, affecting the economy and public trust in the currency's value. Thus, an effective and accurate banknote authentication system is crucial for maintaining a stable economy. The findings from this study will contribute to improved accuracy and efficiency in detecting counterfeit banknotes, mitigating financial losses, and preserving the economy's security and stability.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of PSO-ACO Optimization and Swarm Intelligence in Healthcare: Implications for Medical Image Analysis and Disease Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Revolutionizing healthcare is a crucial objective for improving diagnostic accuracy and disease surveillance. This review paper aims to explore the potential of PSO-ACO optimization and swarm intelligence in revolutionizing healthcare through enhanced medical image analysis and disease surveillance techniques. The abstract emphasizes the significance of these techniques in transforming healthcare practices. It provides an overview of the PSO-ACO optimization algorithm and swarm intelligence, highlighting their capabilities and potential applications in healthcare. The objective of the review is to investigate the impact of PSO-ACO optimization and swarm intelligence in improving medical image analysis and disease surveillance. The paper extensively examines the existing literature, discussing the benefits and limitations of these approaches, and showcasing their successful integration in healthcare. Furthermore, the abstract highlights the challenges and future directions in this field, emphasizing the need for further research and development. In conclusion, this comprehensive review paper underscores the transformative potential of PSO-ACO optimization and swarm intelligence, illustrating their ability to revolutionize healthcare by advancing medical image analysis and disease surveillance techniques.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Identification and Classification of Pneumonia using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The current study introduces an advanced system that utilizes machine learning methodologies to accurately detect and categorize pneumonia cases from chest X-ray images. The utilized system employs the VGG16 model as the foundational architecture for the classifier. It also utilises transfer learning techniques to adjust the model to the merged dataset of chest X-ray images that have been labelled. The model has been enhanced with the utilisation of Grad-CAM, a methodology that offers interpretability for the model's predictions through visual explanations. The training methodology employed involves mini-batch stochastic gradient descent, with a batch size of 8, for a total of 200 epochs. The evaluation of the system's performance is conducted by means of the utilisation of the test dataset. The findings indicate that the system that was created has the ability to effectively and precisely detect and categorise pneumonia based on chest X-ray images. This suggests that the system has the potential to be a valuable tool in the medical field for prompt diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Tackling Agricultural Challenges of Red Globe Grapes Leaf Diseases: A Federated Learning CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study combines convolutional neural networks (CNN) with federated learning to detect and categorise six disease types in red globe grape leaves. The innovative approach uses distributed machine learning among four clients while protecting data privacy, which might have ramifications for other privacy-sensitive applications besides agricultural disease detection. Each client in the research had a local dataset of red globe grapes leaf diseases, and the study deployed a federated learning model across the four clients. The clients updated the global model collectively after individually training CNN models on their local data and sharing model updates with a central server while maintaining data privacy. The model's professional capacity to recognize and categorise illness states across clients with high reliability was shown by experimental outcomes assessed through Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Support, and Accuracy, supporting the effectiveness of federated learning. The model displayed a strong performance in terms of these average metrics, despite fluctuations in individual customers' results, which were caused mainly by possible class imbalances. Between 87.34% and 94.36% were the Macro-average values, 88.39% to 94.50% were the Weighted-average values, and 88.40% to 94.49% were the Micro-average values for all customers. These excellent results show the model's ability to balance Precision and Recall, adjust to class imbalances, and successfully detect true positives worldwide. This study offers a practical, scalable, and privacy-preserving approach for crop multi-class disease identification, making a substantial contribution to precision agriculture. A significant advancement in distributed machine learning has been made due to the encouraging findings highlighting the potential of federated learning with CNNs for more extensive applications.

articleTitle: Adopting Federated Learning and CNN for Advanced Plant Pathology: A Case of Red Globe Grape Leaf Diseases Dissecting Severity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This article examines a novel method for categorizing Red Globe grape leaf illnesses, supported by convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and federated learning. The goal is to aid farmers in adopting focused, efficient treatments by facilitating a more thorough and accurate diagnosis of various disease severity levels. The research uses a federated learning approach among five clients and contains five discrete severity levels of Red Globe grape leaf diseases. Because it trains a global model based on locally calculated updates and keeps data on the client device, the federated learning paradigm used here is unique in how it operates and handles data privacy issues. CNN is a powerful deep-learning method especially effective when examining visual information. The study findings' accuracy, precision, and recall qualities are encouraging for all customers. The customers' scores for local data precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy ranged from 85.60 to 96.62%, 88.82 to 96.54%, 87.50 to 96.58%, and 0.96 to 0.99, respectively. When the model's predictions were further evaluated using global client values, accuracy scores ranged from 90.71 to 95.21%, demonstrating high predictability. A comparison study of averages was conducted to demonstrate the model's effectiveness among customers. The weighted averages ranged from 91.47 to 95.33%, while the macro-averages ranged from 90.90 to 95.25 %. The micro-averages were between 91.45 and 95.32%, consistently demonstrating the model's resilience at all severity levels. With this method, farmers, especially in India, are given a powerful tool for the early identification and treatment of grape leaf diseases, which increases production and encourages sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Sentiment and Context-Aware Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a Natural Language Processing (NLP) task that involves using machine learning techniques, particularly deep learning, to determine the sentiment or emotion expressed in a piece of text. The goal of sentiment analysis is to understand whether the text expresses a positive, negative, or neutral sentiment towards a particular subject, product, service, or topic. A deep learning technique called Sentiment and Context-Aware Hybrid Deep Neural Network (SCA-HDNN) was proposed for sentiment analysis. In SCA-HDNN, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was used for sentiment classification. However, CNNs require fixed-sized inputs, which can be a limitation when dealing with sequences of different lengths. So in this paper, Recurrent CNN (RCNN) is introduced for sentiment classification. The incorporation of recurrent connections in each convolutional layer of RCNN enables handling variable-length sequences. RCNNs can be more computationally efficient than CNN. The combination of CNNs and RNNs allows for parallelization and shared computations across time steps, which can speed up training and inference for sentiment analysis. This method is named as SCA-RCNN. The results from the experiment demonstrate that the suggested SCA-RCNN method achieves high levels of accuracy, precision, and recall in sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Reducing Cross-Layer Energy Holes in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Multiuser Multi Service Scheduling Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In order to increase the efficiency with which wireless sensor networks utilise their power, the authors of this research suggest a protocol called Multiuser Multi Service Scheduling Protocol (MMSSP). The emphasis is on the interdependencies between the PHY, MAC, and NET levels of the communication protocol stack. Cross-layer models are built to examine the impact of the PHY, MAC, and NET layers on energy efficiency, and the important properties of these layers are considered in the analysis. The recommended strategies aim to increase energy efficiency without necessitating major shifts from the status quo in terms of standards and practices. This study offers fresh approaches to energy use in an effort to solve these problems. By analyzing prior research, we know that increasing the lifespan of wireless sensor networks requires designing protocols with low power requirements. To address the issue of energy consumption, it is necessary to examine a complete, cross-layered scheme of energy efficiency solutions, since energy-consuming components are dispersed throughout the levels of the protocol stack.

articleTitle: Let's Identify the Similar and Confusing Raags of Hindustani Classical Music
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The identification of different raags in Indian classical music is a challenging task, and distinguishing between Raag Bhoopali and Raag Deshkar is no exception. The reason why this is a difficult task is both the raags share similar melodic structures, including the use of a pentatonic scale (“Audav” scale) with five notes (Sa, Re, Ga, Pa, and Dha). This makes it challenging to differentiate between the two raags, especially for those who are not familiar with the nuances of Indian classical music. The present research work addresses this issue of identification between two raags. We have purposed a method based on attention employing a Neural Network (NN) architecture, for identifying the two. To assess the proposed technique, we curated a dataset of Hindustani Classical music comprising these two distinct raags. Before proceeding with the analysis, we performed multiple pre-processing steps, audio data augmentation techniques, and feature extraction methods on the dataset, which yielded several feature values. Next, we employed the proposed architecture that utilized a classification algorithm. Additionally, to gain further insights into the proposed approach we conducted a counterfactual analysis, which involved identifying the minimum changes required in the input data to change the classification outcome. The attention-based neural network architecture plays a significant role in extracting pertinent information about the raags from the pre-processed data. The developed technique was evaluated based on key performance parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, yielding impressive scores of 0.949, 0.949, 0.949, and 0.949 respectively. This indicates the clear superiority of our proposed approach over previously published methods in the literature.

articleTitle: Malicious URLs and QR Code Classification Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Attackers commonly employ malicious URLs and harmful QR codes to spread malware and phishing scams; therefore, they need to be classified. Malicious URLs that lead visitors to phishing or malware-infected websites that steal personal data can be included in emails, social media posts, or website content. Rogue QR codes can be used to propagate malware, steal data, or direct users there, much like malicious websites can. In this paper, the classification of malicious content is provided using two approaches:(1) Malware URL categorization based on ML and malware QR codes (2) classification of malicious QR codes based on deep learning. The first technique classifies URLs as dangerous or benign using machine learning models that are trained on features derived from the URLs. Several ML techniques, such as Random Forest, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine, are used to evaluate the model's performance. The second option focuses on classifying harmful QR codes using deep learning techniques. The classification of QR codes as malicious or benign is done using CNN and well-known transfer learning models like RESNET. In general, the offered approaches provide effective techniques to classify unsafe material, which can be utilized to enhance security.

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Model for Classification of Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's age of technology, the whole world is in a state of rapid change, and as Internet use is worldwide, it is becoming an essential requirement for everyone. Social media on the internet is getting a lot of attention these days. Many people are using social networking applications to voice their opinions on everyday issues, and different ideas of individuals on various topics are expressed and constantly disseminated via numerous social media outlets. It's no secret that social media is one of the largest sources of unstructured data and analyzing this data and extracting meaning from it is a tedious task. In this paper we have not only explored the various machine learning algorithms which may be applied for the sentiment analysis but we have proposed a LSTM based model for sentiment analysis. The experimental results show that LSTM has the highest accuracy among all the models.

articleTitle: A Fingerprint Based Novel Cancelable Biometric Authentication Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, the usage of diverse biometric technologies for reliable automatic human recognition has grown at an exponential rate. There is rising concern that, with the widespread use of biometric technologies, people's privacy and anonymity may be in risk. In contrast to passwords and credit cards, biometrics are linked to a person forever and cannot be altered if they are stolen. Biometric patterns should be altered using non-invertible and revocable transformations to create cancelable biometric templates in order to avoid theft. A summary of latest advancement in different cancelable biometric systems for biometric template protection is provided. The shortcomings and benefits of current cancelable biometric systems are explored and point out promising research areas for development in this rapidly evolving domain. Also present a model of generating cancelable fingerprint template using Reed Solomon error corrections, which can be used to authenticate a distorted biometric image. This approach provides an accuracy of 95%.

articleTitle: Intercept Probability and Secrecy Capacity Evaluation of RIS-Empowered Wireless Communications Over Nakagami-$m$ Fading
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the secrecy performance of a wireless communication network empowered with the reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) over Nakagami-m fading channels. To be specific, we consider two different scenarios of a classical wiretap model where a source communicates with a receiver through an RIS, and simultaneously a passive eavesdropper tries to fetch the information either from the source or through the RIS. In the first scenario, the eavesdropper is snooping the information directly from the source, whereas in the second scenario, it overhears the information through an RIS. We first present the statistical characterization of the instantaneous end-to-end signal-to-noise ratios at the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper under both scenarios by exploiting the tight Gamma distribution approximation over Nakagami-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$m$</tex> fading. We then exploit these to derive the exact expressions for the intercept probability and the probability of non-zero secrecy capacity over Nakagami-m distribution. Finally, we validate our analytical outcomes with numerical and Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Filtration Based Design of Pre-Processing Stage for Efficient Mango Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Mango is an important fruit crop cultivated in many parts of the world, and the health and productivity of mango trees can be affected by various diseases. One of the common diseases affecting mango trees are anthracnose, bacterial canker and black soothy mold which can be identified by the appearance of lesions on the leaves. Image processing techniques can be used to detect and classify the symptoms of anthracnose on mango leaves. In this paper, a method was proposed for enhancing the quality of mango leaf image for better processing. The method involves pre-processing the images with denoising and sharpening and then segmenting the images using an Otsu's thresholding. The proposed method was tested on a dataset of mango leaf images and achieve better values for quality metrics like PSNR and MSE. The results demonstrate the potential of using processing techniques for the early detection and management of diseases in mango trees, leading to improved crop yield and quality.

articleTitle: Comparing Microservices and Monolithic Applications in a DevOps Context
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research looks at the interaction between DevOps and microservices. It explores how these two methods can be combined to create a more agile and efficient application development process. This whitepaper highlights the benefits of using DevOps and microservices over traditional monolithic approaches and examines why microservices-based delivery is preferred for large-scale applications. Additionally, this study seeks to identify best practices for implementing these strategies in organizations for optimal application growth and maintainability. This white paper examines the synergies between DevOps and microservices, providing insights into how organisations can improve their application development processes and gain an edge in today's fast-paced business environment.

articleTitle: Phishing Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: As there are many cyber-attacks that are going on in this world phishing is one of the most important cyberattack phishing attacks starts with fake messages which contain dangerous links or URLs that can be sent through emails and chat applications that messages target the victim and make him open the malicious link in this way hacker gets the important information about the target victim like passwords and login details. So, the user needs to be conscious about which is a malicious link, and which is a legitimate link. Machine learning can be one of the ways to classify the malicious links and the legitimate links by which we can stop the 95% of phishing attacks. This paper is about training machine learning models using phishing datasets to classify the URLs whether they are legitimate URLs or phishing URLs. Machine learning models used to train are KNN, Decision tree, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, CNN, RNN, and all the model's accuracy and all other evaluation metrics are compared and Logistic regression and CNN gave the highest accuracy of 95% and 96% respectively.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Retinal Vasculature for Eye Disease Identification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Non-invasive Medical imaging and diagnosis is one of the prime areas of medical research these days. There exist many challenges in the field of eye care, especially treatment, preventive quality, and visual rehabilitation services among others. In this paper, we attempt to study and draw correlations between conditions such as Diabetic Retinopathy, Hypertensive Retinopathy, Myopia etc. and their effects on various retinal parameters and the vasculature for a speedier diagnosis of eye diseases. Various parameters of the eye such as Cup-to-Disc Ratio and morphological feature measurements such as vessel density, average width, fractal dimension and various measures of tortuosity are studied for each disease to find out how these conditions manifest in the colour fundus photographs of the retina of people suffering from different diseases. Early detection and diagnosis of several eye diseases would prevent patients from complete visual impairment.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Prediction of Lung Tumour Using Combined ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: There are diversified varieties of machine learning models that focus on the detection, diagnosis and stage determination of Lung Cancer. This paper focuses on building one such model by combining various ML techniques. Also, this paper includes a partial implementation of the defined model. The paper elaborated a method which will prove to be a boon for medical science as this model will diagnose cancer, determine which stage it is currently on and also use advanced analysis will provide the curability status of the same. A combination of best-suited algorithms and techniques are used to build this revolutionary model which will yield conclusions with higher precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Agricultural Innovation: Federated Learning and CNNs in Guava Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: To solve the pervasive problem of guava leaf diseases, this research article provides a ground-breaking study that uses Federated Learning (FL) in conjunction with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The categorization of six common guava leaf diseases is the main emphasis of the research, which makes use of four different client datasets. Large-scale dataset management and use for illness diagnosis present considerable hurdles in the age of big data. Federated learning, a technique that enables model training across several decentralized clients while maintaining data privacy, is how our approach tackles these problems. The model was individually trained for each client using local data, and the model parameters were then combined to create a global model via federated averaging. For the global models from each client, the precision, recall, F1-Score, support, and accuracy varied from 91.73% to 93.67%, 91.68% to 93.68%, 91.70% to 93.66%, 875.17 to 1051.67, and 0.97 to 0.98, respectively. Additionally, the comparison study was done to comprehend the unique contributions made by each customer to the overall model. Macro-average, which calculates the average performance across all courses, varied from 91.70% to 93.66% for all customers. The Micro-average, the mean performance overall individual instances, fell between 92.06% and 93.99%, while the Weighted-average, which considers class imbalance, ranged between 92.07% and 94.01%.. The findings of this research provide significant contributions to science and have practical ramifications for the global and Indian agricultural sectors, resulting in improved disease control and higher crop yields.

articleTitle: An Optimized Transfer Learning and Deep Convolutional Neural Network Approach for Automated Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: One of the most common malignancies in the world is breast cancer, which primarily affects women, its early detection is important to diagnose the unwanted cell growth in the breast region. The survival rate increases to 90% when the growth is detected early. The objective of research is to identify different algorithms having a higher accuracy and is faster in detection of the malignant cell growth at the same time to assist doctors to detect the cancerous growth. The research intends to determine whether the existing Convolutional Neural Network architecture performs the detection accurately or not. In this approach of detection, we implemented various model architectures such as Deep-CNN, VGG16, VGG19, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2 on a vast dataset to learn from it. The various models were compared on the basis of their accuracy. VGG16 performed the best in comparison to every other model and came out to be the best of the implemented, afterwards various optimizers were applied on VGG16 to further increase the accuracy to find its best tuning parameter. The best accuracy achieved by tuning different optimizers of VGG16 was 97% when the optimizer was set to default, and the default optimizer was “Adam”. This accuracy over a real-life dataset is considered to be ideal for classification purposes.

articleTitle: Temporal Convolutional Network and its Application in Various Sectors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has been working to meet the needs of humans for a very long time. There have been many progressive evolutions along the way. Neural Networks have emerged to be the best in the field of recognition and data analysis. There have been myriad developments and preparation of models over decades. There is CNN, RNN, FNN, DNN, TCN and many more. In this paper, we aim to compare the working of TCN which stands for Temporal Convolutional Network with the workings of above-mentioned models to figure out the best use of technology for catering the human needs. This paper is a deep analysis of the erstwhile models that are being used and how the temporal convolutional network finds its applications in the present scenario, what are the emerging fields that it can be implemented in and what were the positives of TCN over other neural network models. Through a careful study we have come to a conclusion that TCN could be the basic starting point of all the neural networks as it has proven to have less training time, less memory utilization and gives better results compared to other models. The functioning of TCN models is designed in such a way that no information can be drained from future to the past. Furthermore, the input image can be analyzed irrespective of the length as the same can be mapped to the output layer. TCN finds its application in various multilateral domains that includes healthcare, sequential forecasting, preventing cyber attacks, speech enhancement and many more. It has the capability to outperform the other models most of the time by a major difference and sometimes by a significant margin. Therefore, the applications of TCN can vary in accordance to the needs of the user.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Prediction of Ternary SRAM Cells Using GAA CNTFETS for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The given work introduces a novel design of a low power 17 transistor ternary static random access memory (17T-TSRAM) cell that utilizes a 10nm gate all around carbon nanotube field effect transistor (GAA CNTFET). The proposed design aims to achieve higher speed, lower leakage power, and lower energy consumption. The design employs two 6T standard ternary inverters (STI) that are cross-coupled with differential write and single-ended read circuitry to form the proposed 17 Transistor(17T) TSRAM cell. The design is operated at a low supply voltage of 0.5 volts, which helps to minimize the overall power consumption. The accomplishment of the proposed design is evaluated by comparing it with existing designs that utilize 10nm and 32nm CNTFET verilog-A models. The results show that the proposed TSRAM design offers remarkable improvements in several key parameters like leakage power consumption, write delay, read delay, and PDP (Power-Delay Product), resulting in lower overall energy consumption. Overall, the proposed design of a low power 17T TSRAM cell using GAA CNTFET technology offers promising improvements in terms of energy efficiency and performance compared to existing designs.

articleTitle: Early detection of Osteoporosis through Bone Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Osteoporosis is a prevalent bone disease that can be crippling and is distinguished by a loss of bone strength and density. Fractures and other osteoporosis problems can be prevented by an early diagnosis of the condition. In this context, bone image analysis using X-rays and CT scans is a promising approach for detecting osteoporosis at an early stage. This research paper presents a method for the early osteoporosis identification by bone image analysis. The proposed method combines traditional image processing techniques with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). A diverse dataset of bone images is collected and preprocessed. Conventional image processing techniques are used for feature extraction, while a CNN model is developed and trained for classification. The experimental results demonstrate high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in detecting osteoporosis.
