The proposed method is non-invasive, cost-effective, and scalable, which makes it a valuable tool for enhancing osteoporosis diagnosis and patient treatment.

articleTitle: Social Media Comment Classification and Crime Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The increasing use of social media has led to a vast amount of user-generated content, including comments, which can provide valuable insights for crime forecasting. However, the sheer volume of data makes it difficult to manually analyze and categorize each comment. Once comments are classified, they can be used for crime forecasting. For example, patterns in social media comments related to criminal activity can be analyzed to identify potential hotspots for criminal activity. Additionally, social media comments can provide early warning signals for criminal activity, allowing law enforcement agencies to take preemptive action. Therefore, this paper proposes a social media comment classification model that uses machine learning techniques to identify and classify comments related to criminal activity. The proposed model combines supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms to classify comments into different categories, such as potential criminal activity, crime reporting, and general discussion. Additionally, the paper explores the potential of using the classified comments for crime forecasting by analyzing patterns and trends in the data. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model in accurately classifying comments, and the potential for using social media data for crime forecasting. In summary, social media comment classification and crime forecasting is an emerging field of research that has the potential to revolutionize the way law enforcement agencies prevent and respond to criminal activity. By using machine learning algorithms to automatically classify social media comments, law enforcement agencies can gain valuable insights into criminal activity and take proactive measures to prevent it.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning Based Approach to Prevent Phishing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Communication using Emails, SMS, and various social media platforms have become an important part of life when dealing professionally and socially. Due to their large uses, these platforms also have gained the attention of hackers to carry out sophisticated attacks by sending out messages that contains Malicious content (Generally URL). Huge numbers of Phishing emails are sent daily. Over the past few years, various Machine Learning based techniques were introduced to identify Phishing Attacks still, the count and loss due to Phishing is increasing daily. Blockchain technology is gaining a lot of attention in Security Domain over the past few years, in this state of art authors have proposed a blockchain-based system integrated with a Machine Learning model to identify and prevent Phishing content that is sent out on various messaging platforms. For implementation purposes Ethereum Based platform and from a Machine Learning perspective Classification based Gradient Boost Algorithm and Support Vector Machine Algorithm was used. The proposed systems talk about, sender while sending out a message to a recipient should pay some ETH (cryptocurrency) and if after content validation through ML models the message is found to be legitimate, the ETH value that the sender had paid will be refunded back, else if ML models identify the content as Phishing, then there will be no refund. Even though after validation through the ML model if the recipient marks the email as SPAM or reports the same as Suspicious then also there will be no refund. This eventually will reduce the traffic and will make hackers rethink when sending Phishing Messages. Authors were able to Create a PoC illustrating the same. API endpoints that were created in this state-of-art executed within 1000 ms & the accuracy obtained from the Machine Learning model was also high.

articleTitle: MultiLingualSync: A Novel Method for Generating Lip-Synced Videos in Multiple Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: We present a Multi Lingual Sync model for generating lip-synced videos in multiple languages. The model consists of Lingua Speak for translation and Wav2Lip for lip synchronization. The workflow involves extracting audio from a video, translating it using Lingua Speak, converting the translated text to speech, and then using Wav2Lip to generate synchronized lip movements. Wav2Lip utilizes a Generator with an identity encoder, speech encoder, and face decoder, along with a pre-trained lip-sync discriminator called SyncNet. The proposed model enables the creation of accurate and efficient multilingual videos with synchronized speech and video.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Cluster Based Secured Data Aggregation Using Genetic Algorithm for WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Constricted energy of the sensor nodes is the major significant challenge in the designing of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Data aggregation is one of the effective strategies to decrease consumption of energy and extend the network lifespan. Cluster-based data aggregation is proven to be the best approach because of its advantages likes efficient data computation, reliability, accuracy, flexibility, scalability, and less computational overhead. However, security, imbalanced energy consumption, locating routing channels, and maintaining clusters are the most critical problems in WSNs that substantially affect on the lifetime of network. In this research paper, we suggested an energy-efficient clustering-based secure data aggregation using a genetic algorithm. The suggested technique addressed the number of clustering-related problems, including load balancing, best cluster heads selection and their distribution above the network etc. The proposed algorithm not only maintains the balance in the network's energy consumption by selecting optimal cluster members in each cluster but also ensures proper selection and distribution of cluster heads above the field. The cost function of the proposed algorithm is designed in such a manner that it chooses energy-balanced compact clusters with optimal cluster heads that are dispersed evenly over the field and nearer to the sink to minimize inter-cluster communication distance. The proposed algorithm also detects and prevents black hole attack for secure data aggregation. The experimental results are examined with the existing approaches to verify the competence of the proposed algorithm. The simulation results show the superior performance of the suggested algorithm in terms of energy usage and lifespan of the network.

articleTitle: A New Prototype Based Smart Health Monitoring System in IoT System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed the healthcare industry through the development of novel smart health monitoring systems. These systems enable caregivers and health professionals to access, monitor, and assess real-time patient health data remotely and in a more accurate manner. This paper presents a prototype-based smart health monitoring system that uses IoT technologies and Autonomous Intelligent Robotics (AIR) to support human-computer interaction (HCI) and address the core challenges of in-home patient health monitoring. The system comprises several low-cost and non-intrusive sensing nodes, mobile communication mechanisms, and a cloud-based data platform. sensor nodes allow the system to acquire various vital physiological parameters in a non-invasive manner. A low-cost and lightweight robot has also been developed to track and monitor the physical wellbeing of the patient. All the acquired patient data is securely transferred to a cloud platform for further analysis, activity tracking, and personalized care planning. We have also developed a user-friendly mobile application for caregivers to access and monitor patient health data in real-time. The proposed smart health monitoring system aims to bridge the gap between healthcare, technology, and people, in order to provide cost-effective and personalized healthcare.

articleTitle: Hybridizing CNN and SVM for Precise Arhul Flower Disease Diagnosis and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study uses a hybrid technique involving Convolutional Neural Networks with Support Vector Machines to construct a reliable illness detection model for Arhul flowers. Three layers of convolution, three max-pooling layers, or two fully connected layers make up the model architecture, which facilitates efficient feature extraction as well as learning from the image input. The main goal of this work is to develop a reliable and effective technique for foretelling different Arhul flower disorders. Metrics for recall, precision, F1-score, support, or accuracy are used to assess the model's performance. With values that range from 82.93 % to 88.64<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the evaluation's findings show great precision across several illness groups. This demonstrates the model's ability to categorize occurrences of each disease appropriately. Recall values for each disease range from 83.12% to 87.06%, demonstrating the model's capacity to identify a sizable fraction of true positive instances. The F1 scores, which range between 84.47% to 87.15%, show an evenly distributed ability in terms of recall and precision. In light of the dataset's class distribution, the model's weighted average accuracy, which measures how well it predicts Arhul flower illnesses generally, is 85.50%. Even with unbalanced data, where some illness classes have more instances than others, the model performs consistently. The results of this study make a contribution to the field of farming disease control by providing a workable method for the early identification and classification of illnesses affecting Arhul flowers. In summary, this study offers a hybrid CNN-SVM approach to precise and effective illness prediction in Arhul flowers. The model performs well, demonstrating its promise for real-world agricultural applications that would ultimately enhance crop health tracking and oversight.

articleTitle: A Deep Ensemble Learning Approach for Venomous & Non-Venomous Serpents and Insect Species Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years snake and insect attacks have become a huge problem worldwide. Most species have similar colors and shapes, which makes it hard to tell them apart using typical techniques. Similarly, identifying different species of bees and wasps can be challenging, especially for non-experts in the field. Therefore, developing a reliable and effective method for recognizing these animals is essential to reducing the issues caused by snake and insect attacks and supporting wildlife conservation efforts. The proposed method in this research utilizes deep ensemble learning and transfer learning techniques to identify snakes, wasps, and bees accurately. Deep ensemble learning involves combining several machine learning models to make better predictions, and transfer learning is a technique that allows pre-trained models to be re-used for new tasks, saving time and computational resources. The proposed method utilizes deep ensemble learning and uses three base transfer learning models, DenseNet201, MobileN etV2, and InceptionResN etV2, for classification. The study obtained a training accuracy of 93%. The research classified 11 types of snakes, four types of bees, and four types of wasps, including all 19 classes. Moreover, the author developed a mobile application for user interaction and utilized Flask API for the logic tier. The mobile application enables users to take pictures or upload images of a snake, wasp, or bee and identify the species accurately. This feature makes the proposed method more accessible to people who encounter these animals daily. Overall, this research represents a promising step towards developing an accurate and effective system for identifying snakes, wasps, and bees, with practical implications for human safety and biodiversity conservation.

articleTitle: Advanced Android Based In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) Software Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Manufacturers from all over the world are vying now to create the most cutting-edge digital cockpits for their next vehicles. These characteristics are derived mostly from other related technologies now in use by consumers. As high-tech safety systems are being built into automobiles these days, the future of the cockpit is changing. Users will expect connected, secure, and improved mobility interfaces from the digital cockpit of the future. Without sacrificing security or performance, a digital cockpit controller system allows for the simultaneous operation of Infotainment, Instrument Cluster, and ADAS functions in real time from a single SoC. It is capable of powering several HuD and other high-resolution monitors. New connected features, intuitive HMI, on-the-go entertainment, and safety features are drawing in customers, making it crucial for OEMs to set themselves apart in the realm of Cockpit electronics. The modern digital cockpit is defined by features such as internet-connected infotainment systems with a virtual assistant and streaming media, larger and higher resolution 3D displays, all-digital instrument clusters, Augmented reality-based head-up displays, and other advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) like surround-view, eMirror, etc. Expansion opportunities exist for suppliers of linked digital cockpits thanks to the development of a cockpit domain controller architecture that consolidates these disparate functions onto a single multi-core SoC and ECUs. Centralized computer technologies that merge previously independent fields into the automobile's control panel are the driving force behind the current mobility revolution.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach for Detecting and Classifying Loitering Events in Fishing Vessels Using Supervised and Semi-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing practices pose significant threats to marine ecosystems and global fisheries sustainability. The detection and classification of loitering events, where fishing vessels spend an extended period in a specific area, are critical for identifying potential IUU activities. This research proposes a comprehensive approach that combines supervised and semi-supervised learning techniques to effectively detect and classify loitering events. By leveraging various machine learning algorithms, including logistic regression, Gaussian mixture models, support vector machines, and random forests, accurate predictions can be made to enhance surveillance and combat IUU fishing.

articleTitle: Study on Growth of Electric Vehicles in India: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Air pollution is currently causing severe problems in India. According to a survey, certain cities have high levels of air contamination brought on by the transportation and industrial sectors. In India, the transport industry accounts for almost 18-19% of all energy consumption. Because of the constant exploitation and usage of natural resources, there is a need to protect renewable energy sources and environmentally friendly goods. Out of such a product, the electric vehicle is one such notion that is a successful creation that will displace traditional petroleum-based automobiles. Electric engines are used instead of internal combustion engines, which significantly cuts pollution. This paper provides the study of evolution of electric vehicles in India.

articleTitle: Solution of Direct and Inverse Problems of Shaping of Optical Pulse by Machine Learning based Neural Network in Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Neural networks are becoming increasingly important in optical communication systems. They are being used as a tool for modulation, code modulation, and optical signal processing. A traditional neural network is a type of machine learning algorithm that can process non-linear simple relationships between inputs and outputs. Neural networks are very useful for solving complex problems in optical communications, such as equalization and adaptive coding. They are also capable of automatically learning patterns within data and modifying them in real-time, based on new information. In particular, neural networks are being used to improve the capacity and efficiency of optical communication systems, by optimizing bit error rate, optical performance monitoring, and signal recovery. Additionally, they are used to enhance the classification of received signals, thereby ensuring more reliable communication performance. This is because neural networks can easily be trained using large data sets, which offer robust solutions to complex problems in optics. In conclusion, neural networks are an efficient and powerful tool for optical communication systems, capable of optimizing performance, learning new patterns, and providing more reliable communication performance.

articleTitle: Extension of Fiber Connectivity to End User by Free Space Optics in Optical Fiber Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Free Space Optics (FSO) is a photon-based wireless technology that uses free space-the optical analog of the wireless environment between two points-to deliver high-speed data communications over distances of up to several kilometers. In optical fiber communication, FSO is an ideal solution for providing fiber connectivity to end users. By replacing the need to run cables and eliminating the need to cross difficult terrains, FSO solutions can be quickly and cost effectively deployed. The technology has many advantages over traditional copper wire and radio solutions, such as being completely invisible, line-of-sight, secure, scalable, and highly reliable. FSO solutions are ideal for connecting multiple sites, connecting business and residential neighborhoods, connecting video surveillance cameras, and providing emergency services and data connections on-the-move.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Facial Detection for Criminal Probe
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The potential of crime and violation is intended to be controlled. Computationally, accurate crime predictions and future trend analysis can help to improve metropolis safety. We are all aware that a person's face is an exceptional and significant component of their physical nature. As a result, we can use it to track down a criminal's identification. As a result of technological advancements, CCTV is now installed in many public locations to record illegal activity. The criminal face recognition system can be used with the previously photographed faces and criminals' photos that are on hand in the police station. The primary objective of this study is to determine how law enforcement authorities may use a combination of ML and computer vision to detect, prevent, and solve crimes considerably more rapidly and correctly. The precise estimation of the crime rate, types, and hotspots using historical trends presents numerous computational opportunities and challenges. Despite significant research efforts, a better predictive algorithm is still required to lead police patrols in the direction of criminal activity. The linear regression, support vector machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, k-nearest neighbours (KNN), decision tree, random forest, K-means clustering and neural networks are some of the machine learning techniques used in this system. Our proposed system will detect crime as well as the criminal hotspots on which crime is likely to take place using hidden patterns from criminal datasets.

articleTitle: Prediction of Better Path Selection in Network for Coverage Based Communication Among Sensor Node in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Currently, congested data networks have become a major issue that affects the quality of communication, especially in urban areas and in high-traffic locations. Even with the introduction of technologies that can help alleviate congestion, with the increasing demand for data, it is still hard to guarantee all data transmissions go through, and this affects the performance of communication. This paper focuses on a solution that seeks to improve the overall performance of data transmissions, particularly when users are located in urban environments and in high-traffic areas. The proposed solution is based on the prediction of network paths that lead to better coverage and faster data transmission. To accomplish this, we propose to use machine learning models and analyze the current network state from a probabilistic point of view. Subsequently, we explore the use of predictive analysis to identify possible congestion and the most effective routes for faster communications. We also investigate the scalability characteristics of our proposed solution. The results of our experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach provides improved coverage for data transmission and that it is capable of handling tolerable delay even under high traffic load.

articleTitle: Malware Detection in Android Based Devices by a Hybrid Approach Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Android applications are rapidly evolving across the mobile ecosystem, but they also face a growing threat from Android malware. Researchers have extensively analyzed the concept of detecting Android malware and proposed concepts and procedures from various perspectives. Machine learning has been identified as an effective and promising approach for detecting Android malware. However, some reviews have addressed various problems which are in relation with Android malware detection using machine learning. Therefore, our paper aims to provide a more comprehensive survey that covers a wider range of aspects of the topic. As part of this paper, we provide a comprehensive overview of Android malware detection approaches that rely on machine learning. We briefly introduce the background of Android apps, covering the Android system design, security procedures, and malware categorization. We analyze and summarize the research status from important angles such as sample collecting, data pre-processing, feature selection, machine learning models, algorithms, and detection efficacy, with a focus on machine learning. Finally, we examine the future possibilities for detecting malware in Android using Machine Learning. By covering an extensive variety of aspects, our review aims to help researchers gain a better understanding of Android malware detection using machine learning. It will serve as a foundation for future studies and help guide research in this field.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of TextRank and Latent Semantic Analysis Algorithms for Extractive News Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: News summarization is an essential process that condenses news stories or collections of stories while retaining key details and main ideas. It offers readers a concise overview of significant events and essential takeaways from news stories, allowing them to quickly grasp the necessary information without reading the entire article. This paper presents a comparative analysis of two widely used algorithms, TextRank, a graph-based algorithm based on the PageRank algorithm, and Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA), a statistical method that captures latent semantic relationships using singular value decomposition for news summarization. The experiment results obtained using established evaluation metrics such as ROUGE-N and ROUGE-L suggest that the TextRank algorithm performs better than the LSA algorithm for all news categories and consistently demonstrates higher Precision, Recall, and F-Score values. The research aims to contribute to a deeper understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of TextRank and LSA in summarizing news by incorporating five news categories (Business, Politics, Sports, Entertainment, and Technology) and using a significantly large dataset containing 2225 news articles and their summaries. This knowledge will empower researchers and practitioners to make informed decisions when selecting an algorithm for summarization tasks based on their requirements and constraints.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Generative AI and Quantum Computing for Mutual Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The paper aims to explore the symbiotic relationship between Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Quantum Computing. This cutting-edge event will delve into the potential synergies between these two transformative technologies and demonstrate how their collaboration can revolutionize various domains. The paper will commence with an insightful overview of Generative AI and Quantum Computing, shedding light on their fundamental concepts and applications, capabilities and challenges. The paper will emphasize how Generative AI can reciprocate and contribute to the advancement of Quantum Computing. It will inspire collaboration, spark new research directions, and pave the way for ground-breaking advancements at the intersection of Generative AI and Quantum Computing.

articleTitle: Generation of Multiple Choice Questions from Indian Educational Text
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Multiple Choice Questions(MCQs) are becoming increasingly popular among testing organizations, educational institutes, and MOOC creators due to their ease of evaluation. With a rapid increase in the number of educational institutes in India, standardized tests in India such as the Joint Entrance Examination(JEE) are adopting MCQs as the format of questioning. Human evaluators find the difficulty of questions generated by existing automatic MCQ generators on the Indian context easy. To avoid this an automatic MCQ generator capable of capturing paragraph level dependencies, framing questions around them, and generating semantically close distractors is proposed, that is optimised on Indian high school geography and biology textbooks of the CBSE curriculum. The MCQ generator has two distinct modules, a question and answer generation module and a distractor generation module. The question and answer generation module contains a T-5 transformer trained on the Stanford Question Answering Dataset(SQuAD) dataset and fine-tuned on a custom handmade dataset to train the model to generate questions linking concepts in different sentences in different parts of the source text and perform well in the context of Central Board of Secondary Education(CBSE) textbooks. The distractor generator uses a combination of the outputs from a Part of Speech(POS) tagger, a T5 transformer, a sense2vec model, and a syntax checker to generate distractor options semantically close to the answer option. The model was judged by human evaluators for fluency, relevance, answerability, grammar, and difficulty and outscored the popular encoder-decoder based question generators. The model also promises a better F1 score than the encoder-decoder based question generators.

articleTitle: Video Motion Magnification Based Approach for Improved Recognition of Spontaneous Facial Micro Expressions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is studied extensively over decades. Recognition of subtle emotions exhibited as micro-expressions is the most challenging task. Being spontaneous, micro-expressions usually exhibited only temporally and entail minute spatial changes and last over very short duration of time, this makes micro expression recognition (MER) significantly challenging compared to non-spontaneous expression recognition. Since the micro-expressions exhibition is at very low intensity level, in order to enhance distinguish-ability, Eulerian Video Magnification (EVM) method is opted for accentuating subtle facial expression. Local Binary Patterns with Six Intersection Points (LBP-SIP) method, is used as a feature extraction technique for dynamic texture analysis in spatial-temporal domain. MER classification process is carried out using Support Vector Machines (SVM) with Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel. For this proposed method 76.53% MER accuracy is achieved. The process shows enhancement in overall computational efficiency and robustness in high dimensionality (concatenated feature), which is advantageous for practical purpose.

articleTitle: Development of a Didactic Guide for the Integration of the Smart Meter in the Laboratories of the Salesian Polytechnic University Cuenca Campus
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This article presents a tutorial on how to use the ION 7400 module to teach students about power quality. The guide begins with an introduction to the module and the basics of electrical energy measurement. It then describes the module, including its standards and how it communicates with other energy management devices and systems. Advanced topics are also covered, such as voltage levels, rapid voltage disturbances (flicker), total harmonic distortion (THD), and voltage unbalance, which are addressed in Resolution No. ARCERNNR-017/2020 and Resolution No. ARCERNNR-002/20. The tutorial is designed to ensure that students understand how ION 7400 modules work in real-world applications and prepare them to apply their knowledge in future energy management applications. Additionally, it aims to raise awareness about issues that may indicate that the energy service is not continuous, acceptable, or reliable.

articleTitle: Strengthening Video Integrity and Anti-Duplication Measures with Blockchain Innovations
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The emergence of the digital era has had a significant impact on the channels humans use to communicate. And with the increasing popularity of multimedia distribution channels, the law finds it difficult to adapt the traditional legal notions of privacy and intellectual property ownership rights to the digitalization of tangible goods and assets. As these modern digital assets, viz., videos and audio, do not constitute property in most countries, it is more challenging to employ conventional legal protection. Besides, several applications for copyright objection, duplication detection, and the current media can be manipulated or tampered with in different ways to erase any proof of content modification histories and propagate false objectives. Thus, it is crucial for organizations to detect and eliminate multimedia duplication to protect the intellectual property rights of a creator. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that allows one to manage data more efficiently by addressing copyright and data duplication issues over modern multimedia channels such as Facebook, YouTube, etc., leveraging blockchain technology. The proposed blockchain-based framework encapsulates the diverse content of every multimedia file with a hash using different cryptographic hashing technologies, such as perceptual hashing. Moreover, to make the entire process more secure, the proposed architecture develops a hash for every file using the Merkle Tree. The computed hash is then stored inside the decentralized database in order to preserve a historical audit trail. The proposed architecture holds promise to detect and address video duplication, ensuring secure and immutable protection against content tampering.

articleTitle: Nature-Inspired Driven Multiuser Multi Service Scheduling Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In order to enhance the energy efficiency of wireless sensor networks, the authors of this research suggest the Nature-Inspired Driven Multiuser Multi Service Scheduling Prootocol (NID-MMSSP). Load balancing is a method used in cloud computing to accomplish the goal of optimum resource use. The load is spread among available resources using a method inspired by natural systems. As a result, a plethora of NID-MMSSP methods are put out to ensure optimal performance. Nonetheless, there is not a comprehensive and exhaustive research examining and investigating the key essential concerns in this sector, despite the relevance of the NID-MMSSP methodologies for tackling the problem of the Nature-Inspired in the cloud environment. Consequently, this study provides extensive treatment of the NID-MMSSP methods used in the field of Nature-Inspired cloud computing. This paper's primary objective is to emphasize the importance of algorithms and the advantages they give in resolving Nature-Inspired problems. Furthermore, the benefits and drawbacks of the NID-MMSSP algorithms have been studied, and their substantial obstacles are taken into account when suggesting new strategies that are more successful at solving the Nature-Inspired issue in cloud settings.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Social Media on E-commerce: Harnessing Recommendations from Online Product Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The rise of social media platforms has significantly altered the nature of online interaction. Social networking sites like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn have given companies a new and effective way to connect with clients, get feedback, and market their wares. Customers' positive product reviews shared throughout social media platforms, however, help build a loyal following. Our study's overarching objective is to examine the role of social media in online retail and use data from consumers' reviews to foretell whether or not they would advocate for a certain product. The paper also discusses the pros and cons of e-commerce utilizing social media and provide suggestions for companies who want to tap into the potential of social media to boost their online sales.

articleTitle: ISL Animated Translator and Desktop Virtual Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Sign language is a visual language that uses hand gestures to exchange information between their community and with other people. There has always been difficulty in communication between a verbally impaired person and a normal person. The Sign Language Recognition system is a breakthrough for helping deaf-mute people to communicate with others. Various Indian Sign Language Systems have been developed by many developers around the world but they are neither flexible nor cost-effective for the end users. The main reason behind the lack of research is that there is no proper grammar of ISL and another reason is Sign language is not universal and it varies from country to country and region to region [1]. The aim of this project is to develop a software system that can facilitate communication between normal individuals and deaf/mute individuals by translating Hindi or English text into Indian Sign Language (ISL) gestures, and vice versa using the MediaPipe model. The system will consist of a translator component to generate ISL gestures from input text, an animator component that uses computer graphics techniques to create realistic representations of ISL gestures, and an AI virtual assistant that interprets ISL gestures made by the user to trigger corresponding actions. The system will be integrated with the MediaPipe model to enable translation of ISL gestures to text using computer vision techniques. The overall goal is to provide an advanced system that bridges the communication gap between normal individuals and deaf/mute.

articleTitle: Minimization of Energy Constraint Problem in Wireless Communication Network by Using Iterative Bisection Based Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Energy constraint problem is one of the major concerns in wireless communication networks. The problem of unconstrained energy consumption by the user terminals is both energy and cost inefficient for communication operators. Furthermore, energy conservation also leads to significant improvements in network coverage, which would benefit a major portion of users. This problem can be partially solved by setting an a priori upper threshold on the energy consumed per time unit. However, this solution fails to provide uniform power distribution in the case of spatially distributed user terminals. In order to address such issue, a minimization of energy constraint problem arises. Its goal is to establish an optimal energy compromise between the user terminal and the network. In practice, this is done by approaching the problem as an optimization problem with nonlinear equality and inequality constraints. The exact solution of such problem involves solving a nonlinear optimization problem. Under the assumption of long-term power budget constraints, the optimal solution of the problem can be obtained either by using the Lagrange multiplier approach or the interior-point method. Another efficient method for solving this problem is the Lagrangian relaxation, where the problem is transformed into a quadratic problem by relaxing the nonlinear constraints. This allows for the more accurate solution of the energy constraint problem, but with significantly higher computational complexity. Additionally, it is also possible to solve the energy constraint problem with game-theoretic approaches. This involves considering the user terminals as self-interested players with goals beneficial to all involved parties. Thus, it allows for the equitable and cost-effective sharing of the energy resource among the players. Overall, the minimization of energy constraint problem in wireless communication network is an important problem, as it ensures a proper balance between user terminal energy consumption and network efficiency. In order to obtain the optimal solution, several methods are currently available, such as nonlinear optimization, Lagrangian relaxation, and game-theoretic approaches. Each approach has its own limitations and advantages, and further research is needed to fully incorporate these methods into practical solutions.

articleTitle: Securable Personal Healthcare Record in Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Personal Health Records are now receiving more attention as a result of the expansion of cloud computing (PHR). The privacy and security of patients' medical records must be protected even while e-health systems have the potential to enhance patient care. A number of cryptographic techniques, including encryption and distributed data processing, have been proposed to safeguard the security of private health information. But, because each recipient needs a different decryption key, sharing encrypted material with many parties becomes difficult. Due to the fact that the decryption private key can only be given to one individual, even (t, n) threshold privacy-preserving techniques have their restrictions. Our suggested solution offers a decentralized identity-based approach to decryption that makes it simple to open encrypted data without needing to create new secret keys. Using attacks on adaptively generated cypher text, we further show that our distributed identity-based decryption technique is private. To further ensure privacy protection without the requirement for private key regeneration, we add a (t, n) threshold to our distributed decryption system. With the goal of protecting privacy and secrecy, our solution handles the issue of sharing encrypted personal health information with several parties.

articleTitle: Integrating Artificial Neural Networks into Hybrid Perturb and Observe Algorithm for Improved Photovoltaic System Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: One of the most prominent and sustainable sources of power generation is the PV solar system. However, the efficiency of energy production from the PV system is highly dependent on solar irradiance. Fluctuations in temperature can significantly impact the system's power generation, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this challenge, the implementation of a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) technique is crucial for enhancing the overall performance of the PV system. In this research paper, we propose the development of a novel MPPT algorithm based on the Perturb and Observe (P&O) technique, combined with an Artificial Neural Network (ANN). By utilizing MATLAB/Simulink, we conduct various test cases involving both uniform and non-uniform irradiance scenarios to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid method (P&O-ANN). Furthermore, compare hybrid approach with the existing P&O-Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique. The obtained results demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method, as it outperforms the P&O-PSO technique in terms of maximum power extraction and tracking speed. The P&O-ANN algorithm not only enhances the efficiency of power generation in varying environmental conditions but also ensures better accuracy and precision in tracking the maximum power point. These findings underscore the potential of our approach to significantly improve the performance of PV solar systems and contribute to the advancement of sustainable power generation.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Delivery Drone Using Live Transmission Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Supply chain management and logistics could undergo significant shifts as autonomous drone delivery systems become commonplace. Unmanned aerial vehicles, or UAVs, are used by these systems to deliver packages and other items without the need for human intervention. Faster turnaround times, lower costs, and greater efficiencies are just a few of the many benefits of using drone delivery services. Automated drone delivery faces several challenges before it can become widespread, including public safety and health worries, potential legal conflicts, and the need for cutting-edge technology. In this study, it is proposed to equip drones with active transmission to deliver packages as a means of resolving the issues. While automation and active gearboxes typically necessitate a sizable amount of hardware and software, the proposed approach may prove advantageous due to its lower cost and reduced complexity.

articleTitle: Machine Vision Enabled Fall Detection System for Specially Abled People in Limited Visibility Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this study, a unique fall detection system with machine vision capabilities is presented. It is intended to help people with special needs in environments with low visibility. People with disabilities are far more likely to fall, so it is important to spot such accidents right once for their safety and wellbeing. However, current fall detection technologies sometimes have trouble operating effectively in dimly lit environments. Our suggested method uses cutting-edge computer vision algorithms to detect falls in real-time, even in environments with poor sight, in order to solve this problem. The device collects visual data using infrared sensors and a low-light camera, and uses a deep learning algorithm to identify falls. The deep learning model can learn complicated patterns and traits related to falls because it was trained on a huge dataset of annotated fall and non-fall samples. The model takes the collected photos and extracts the pertinent elements, then categorises them as autumn events or non-fall events. The system also uses a threshold-based methodology to distinguish between falls and other behaviours that could cause false alarms. To assess the system's performance, numerous tests were run, including ones in controlled low lighting and in real-world situations. The outcomes show that the suggested system can detect falls reliably even in difficult lighting situations, attaining high detection accuracy and a low false alarm rate. The machine vision enabled fall detection system has a great deal of promise to improve the safety and independence of people with disabilities by offering prompt help in the event of falls, especially in dimly light areas. The system provides a dependable and efficient way to meet the particular requirements of people with disabilities in low-light situations and can be deployed in a variety of venues, including homes, hospitals, or care facilities.

articleTitle: Reduction of Both Health and Environmental Risk from the Med-Waste Technology of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Med-waste technology is a growing concern for health and environmental risk due to the large amount of medical wastes it generates. Medical wastes are broadly categorized as infectious, radioactive, pharmaceutical, and non-infectious. Med-waste technology can present some potential health and environmental risks if they are not managed properly. Infectious wastes, such as discarded syringes, body fluids, and tissues can contain infectious microorganisms and can lead to serious human health risks when they are not managed safely. Radioactive wastes can also be a risk to both human health and the environment if not properly managed. Pharmaceuticals can potentially contaminate the environment if not disposed of properly, and non-infectious wastes, such as sharps and non-bio medical waste, can pose environmental threats when not disposed of properly. In order to reduce the risk, med-waste technology should be managed with practices, policies, and proper disposal methods to ensure that health and environmental risks are mitigated.

articleTitle: High Performance Level with Low Energy Consumption Using Individual Routing of Event and Query Packets for Location Identification in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The emergence of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) has enabled the development of efficient and innovative approaches to the location identification problem. These networks have the capability to collect sensory data from a variety of sources, and have presented new challenges when it comes to routing packets from both events and queries to the appropriate locations. This paper presents a new approach to the problem of individual routing of event and query packets for location identification in WSNs. By combining network centric approaches with the existing location-based services, the proposed approach provides an improved way of routing by utilizing the location information of the sensor nodes. Results of experimentation with a simulated network demonstrate the advantages of the proposed approach, since it enables accurate location identification with a much lower routing deficit compared with other existing methods. The proposed approach has the potential to provide a robust platform for location identification in Wireless Sensor Networks.

articleTitle: Minimization of Computational Error by Using Optimization Power Transmit via Lagrange-Duality Method in Wireless Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The use of optimization techniques in power transmission has been gaining importance over the last decades. With the advance of technology, optimal power systems have been proven to be much more efficient than conventional ones. These power systems minimize computational errors due to their optimization strategies like dynamic programming, genetic algorithms, discrete optimization, and fuzzy logic. This helps in reducing cost and allows for the implementation of intelligent power flow control. Furthermore, the optimization techniques provide an effective method for calculating the optimum power distribution and regulating voltage. Furthermore, optimization power systems help to increase the safety of power distribution and reduces the need for human intervention in critical electricity networks. As a result, it can reduce overall operational cost as well as improve overall power reliability. Additionally, optimal power transmission systems also help decrease inappropriate use of energy, reduce cost of engineering, and improves the network reliability.

articleTitle: Pre-Trained Generative Architectures for Question-Asking Chatbots on Technical Text: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, chatbots' usefulness has spread to an ever-expanding number of domains. Chatbots can be used in educational contexts to ask students questions about topics they are studying for self-testing. Designing models for dialogue systems includes the crucial step of generating appropriate responses. In this study, we propose using chatbots which ask questions specifically catered to a technical domain of interest. To that purpose, we've chosen the fundamental concepts of the Java programming language as our domain. We begin by creating a collection of Java-based dialogues with various sets of question-answer pairings of varying difficulty across various topics. Our Java dialogue dataset includes 10000 multi-turn dialogues generated by an algorithm that simulates a Java interview on basic concepts. Every conversation serves as a training example for our proposed framework. Then, for training on our dataset, we use versions of two different transformer-based pre-trained generative architectures. We compare and evaluate the architectures based on standard automatic metrics for dialogue response generation and other parameters specific to our use-case. We observe that the usage of generative architectures pre-trained as dialog models can generate newer questions, in most cases meaningful in the context of the interview. However, the model design could benefit from incorporating a further knowledge component in order to improve the production of questions both in terms of topic and suitable level of difficulty.

articleTitle: A New Traffic Prediction Algorithm with Machine Learning for Optical Fiber Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Optical Fiber Communication systems are increasingly used for transport networks due to the low cost, large capacity, and high bit rate of optical transmission [1]. However, effective traffic management and predicting future congestion levels is a critical challenge in order to ensure smooth and reliable operations. Machine learning algorithms can be used to accurately predict the future traffic volumes in such networks, providing real-time information on expected capacity usage and allowing operators to take proactive measures to prevent congestion. In this paper, we propose a novel Machine Learning based traffic prediction algorithm for Optical Fiber Communications Systems (OFCSs). The proposed algorithm uses a combination of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architectures for predicting future traffic patterns. We train the model using a sequence of historical traffic data from an OFCS and evaluate it against benchmarks in terms of prediction accuracy and processing time. The results show that the proposed algorithm can make accurate traffic predictions, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.036 for one-step-ahead predictions and 0.077 for five-steps-ahead. Furthermore, the processing time is significantly less than other benchmark models, providing a practical and reliable approach for predicting future traffic in OFCSs. We also discuss the implications of this study in terms of improving optical fiber capacity utilization and meeting the increased demand of growing data traffic.

articleTitle: Breaking the Silence: Empowering the Deaf, Mute & Blind Community through Sign Language Live Captioning Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Gesture recognition is a rapidly advancing field in human-computer interaction, driven by the progress in artificial intelligence. This study focused on developing an efficient method for real-time translation of static and dynamic gestures in American Sign Language (ASL), British Sign Language (BSL), French Sign Language (FSL), and Indian Sign Language (ISL). Hand features were captured using Google's Mediapipe, while a custom dataset was created for experimentation. Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) was employed to recognize hand gestures, encompassing 70+ classes of signs and gestures. By training the LSTM model with spatiotemporal features extracted from the dataset, the resulting machine learning model facilitated real-time gesture prediction, live captioning, Text-to-Speech audio generation in multiple languages as well as text/speech conversion into ASL. This system has profound applications, benefiting individuals who are deaf, mute, or have difficulties in reading. With the proposed method tested on an 80% training and 20% test split, encouraging results with an accuracy of 96.77% were obtained for sign language gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model to Reduce the Various Defects on Die Casting Process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: To avoid flaws such as porosity gaps, low-pressure die casting (LPDC) is often utilised for high-performance wheel castings aluminium alloy cars. Casting process parameters have a significant impact on LPDC component quality. There is a requirement to fine-tune the process variables to boost the component's quality against challenging flaws like gas and shrinkage porosity. Examine Defect rates needed for measured process variables. This article culled Information using cloud-based tools typical of the Industry 4.0 paradigm. Develop Supervised machine learning classification models are anticipate defectives in an actual foundry Aluminium LPDC process using this data. Since defects in this process were low and happened against many relevant process measurement factors, determining the underlying cause is challenging. XGboost technique relates the process-related conditions with defectives at the time of the production stage. Used a single LPDC machine and die mould to collect data over three shifts and six days. Using a total of 36 entities or features of the process from this, consider 13 variables. All these features are considered from the 1077 wheel, which is small skewed and 62 samples from the large crooked. From this, existing data need to identify the defective rate with 87% of accuracy for non-defective parts and 74% of accuracy for faulty parts. As a result of this work, pre-series production of innovative products might have fewer problems.

articleTitle: Maximization of Energy Utilization in Machine to Machine Communication via Pricing Based Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The concept of maximizing energy utilization through pricing-based matching algorithms in Machine-to-Machine (M2M) communication is increasingly gaining importance due to the growing demand for energy efficiency in telecommunication networks. M2M systems are capable of efficiently utilizing energy by establishing direct communications between machines situated at heterogeneous locations. By setting up pricing-based matching algorithms, energy utilization in M2M can be enhanced. Price-based incentives can be set up to maximize energy utilization either on the demand side or on the supply side, depending on the end goals desired. On the demand side, pricing-based incentives can take the form of discounts for lower energy usage and higher priority for higher energy usage. Devices can be rewarded for consuming less energy without significantly impacting their performance. On the supply side, pricing models can also be designed to reflect surplus electricity or generation capacity. This provides incentives to producers that offer their energy at lower prices to help balance out the overall energy utilization. Overall, pricing-based matching algorithms provide a robust framework to maximize energy utilization in M2M communications and can help reduce energy-related costs, potentially leading to increased energy efficiency and better energy management.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Power of Data Structures: Exploring Applications in Diverse Computing Domains
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The function of data structures in a variety of computing contexts, such as web development, video games, computer graphics, artificial intelligence, and operating systems, is examined in this study. For the functionality and usability of software programmes, data structures are necessary for effectively organising and manipulating data. The study examines the various data structures employed in each industry and how they support effective algorithms for certain tasks. For instance, web browsers store and manage web page data using linked lists, hash tables, and trees, whereas video games handle game characters and objects using arrays, linked lists, and graphs. The significance of knowing the proper data structures for certain applications is also covered in this paper as a way to streamline software development. This study seeks to offer insightful understandings into the relevance of data structures and their applications in software development by examining the use of data structures in various computing domains.

articleTitle: ML Based Number Plate Recognition Model using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this research paper the Number Plate Recognition System (NPRS) is used which is one of the smartest and most high-tech detection systems. This is a system of different technologies where an interface enables the system to automatically detect and read the unique ID of a number plate of vehicles from the real-time captured images. It is basically the process of extracting the pixel data from the digital images and converting it into ASCII values or the plain text of the number plate. The system first detects the vehicle and then takes a real-time image of that vehicle. To get the solution to this problem, a deep learning model known as YOU ONLY LOOK ONCE (YOLO) and its latest version YOLOv8 is used for detecting the license plates. This model's main aim is to make use of different types of morphological operations so that the specifically required number plate can be detected and translated efficiently. Once we get the desired number plate, we can perform various important operations or tasks such as checking it with the databases to check for stolen vehicles, for tracking the vehicle's movement, etc. It can help to improve public safety and enhance the efficiency of the transportation system.

articleTitle: Detailed Analysis of Computing Methodologies with Special Reference to OSS while Mitigating Crises with Help of Varied Decision Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The crisis for a firm may be of various types and may vary from disastrous man-made events and may extend itself to natural calamities. Globalisation has taken the World by storm and these days the crisis that the firm deals with has also grown beyond proportions. Smaller event may transform into a vast organisational crisis and more so in OSS environment. All the stakeholders get affected in such a scenario and consequences get out of proportions. Being proactive in approach in such a scenario definitely helps mitigating the effect of the unforeseen crisis. This paper deals with identification of certain definite practices and processes that have been implemented by certain successful firms dealing with various products in their respective fields. Detailed analysis, examination and discussion on different decisions being taken by the firms during their business practices has been carried out in this paper.

articleTitle: The Application of K-Means Clustering Algorithm in the Profit of Building Material Rental Customers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: K-means clustering algorithm is a common Unsupervised learning algorithm. It divides samples into multiple clusters by calculating their similarity, and each cluster represents a class of samples. In the profit analysis of building materials leasing customers, different customers can be classified and analyzed based on their profit levels using K-means clustering algorithm to find the high and low points and characteristics of profits. Specifically, for different customers, relevant financial data, business data, and other related data can be collected and integrated, such as the type of leased equipment, lease term, etc. Based on this data, K-means clustering algorithm can be used to establish a customer profit model, dividing customers into different clusters according to their profit level. Customers within the cluster have similar financial and leasing characteristics, which can better reflect the actual situation of the customer group. By analyzing different clusters, we can discover the profit level and characteristics of each cluster, and further grasp the leasing situation, leasing time, equipment type, and other information of customers in different clusters. These analysis results can serve as the basis for customer clustering management. By analyzing the characteristics and predictions of customer needs, a fast and accurate leasing plan can be formulated to improve customer satisfaction. In addition, building materials leasing companies can develop personalized marketing strategies based on cluster analysis results for customers in different clusters, and launch different preferential measures and service plans for customers with different profit levels to achieve differentiated competition. In summary, the K-means clustering algorithm can be well applied to the profit analysis of building materials leasing customers. Through cluster analysis, customers can be classified based on factors such as their profit level and leasing characteristics, providing more accurate and practical market analysis and management decision support for enterprises. In practical applications, it is necessary to select appropriate data and algorithms based on the actual situation, and continuously adjust and optimize them to ensure the accuracy and stability of the model.

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Disorders from X-Ray Images Using Hybrid Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Worldwide, lung illness is a ubiquitous event. With the use of emerging technology, machines, and computer power, we can help in the timely and more precise diagnosis of diseases, particularly lung disease, which can save a great deal of lives and lessen the strain on the system. These include Tuberculosis, pneumonia, asthma, fibrosis, COPD, and others. To predict lung disease, several types of deep learning techniques exist that includes convolutional neural networks (CNN), vanilla neural networks (VNN), visual geometry group neural networks (VGG), and capsule networks. We propose a hybrid model where CNN is combined with VGG, data augmentation, and the spatial transformer network (STN) that beats the existing techniques for both sample datasets as well as complete datasets in terms of measures like precision, recall, F0.5 score, and validation accuracy. The purpose of this research is to develop an autonomous, exact, dependable, strong, and intelligent aiding system that most effectively diagnoses lung illness from a chest X-ray. The “National Institutes of Health Chest X-Ray Dataset” was utilized by the authors of this paper to train the proposed system. The model reported an unmatched accuracy of 95.43% on sample dataset and 97.56% on full dataset comprising of lung X-rays. Moreover, a comparison with the existing models and approaches shows that the proposed system finds clearer demarcation between the highly similar chest X-rays of various diseases.

articleTitle: Development of a Debugging tool for ISAM in Python
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's highly competitive and rapidly evolving telecommunications industry, efficient and effective network planning and optimization are essential for the success of any network operator. The ability to collect, analyse, and visualize data is crucial for identifying network performance issues and taking appropriate corrective actions. In this paper, we present a plotting tool developed for Nokia Networks and Solutions, which enables the plotting of various data types, including carrier data, counters, and vector disturber lists. The tool provides a comprehensive and user-friendly interface for visualizing and analysing network performance metrics, enabling network operators to identify and resolve performance issues quickly and efficiently. We describe the design and implementation of the tool, including the data sources used, the visualization techniques employed, and the user interface features. We also present case studies demonstrating the effectiveness of the tool in identifying and resolving network performance issues. Our results show that the plotting tool is an asset for network operators in the planning and optimization of fixed networks, improving network performance and ensuring customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Establishment of Telemedicine Architecture in IoT Based Smart Home Security System for Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Telemedicine is a technology-enabled healthcare delivery system wherein medical professionals and their patients are geographically remote. It is one of the major use-cases of the Internet of Things (IoT) offering a wide array of innovative solutions improving the healthcare system by providing convenience and cost-effective services. Nowadays, Telemedicine leverages the vast potential of the Internet of Things to enable excellent connectivity and data exchange between the medical personnel and their patients. The core component of the telemedicine architecture in IoT is the network. This network comprises of various interconnected devices. It could include an array of sensors, switches, nodes, etc. for data acquisition. Additionally, these objects are often associated with multiple applications for easy access to health data and treatments. A telemedicine system collects and stores patient data collected from the wide array of sensors that act as data sources. The patient data is stored in a secure database, which is accessed by doctors or medical staffs to perform medical analysis or treatments. The medical personnel can also access the data remotely using personal computers or tablets. The security aspect of this technology is paramount as a breach in privacy can cause serious harm to a patient. Therefore, telemedicine systems are required to incorporate security measures, such as authentication and encryption protocols, to ensure patient privacy and safety. In summary, Telemedicine in IoT is a revolutionary technology that promises cost-effective and convenient healthcare solutions. Its ability to leverage the connectivity of the Internet of Things and its modern security measures makes it an ideal system for healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Effective Disease Detection in Bean Leaves Using Deep CNN and SVM Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Bean leaf diseases have the potential to drastically reduce crop output and quality. The diagnosis of these diseases at an early and accurate stage is critical for optimal care and prevention. In this paper, we propose a model built around a CNN architecture that can forecast the occurrence of six distinct diseases in bean leaves: Acute Leaf Spot, Rust, Bean's Common Mosaic Virus, Bean's Yellow Mosaic Virus, Bacteria Blight, and Anthracnose. Four convolutional layers, 4 maximum-pooling layers, and two completely interconnected layers make up the model. A collection of labeled bean leaf photos was collected and prepared to train and test the model. The convolutional layers enable relevant characteristics and disease-specific patterns to be extracted from the photos. The maximum pooling layers aided in minimizing dimensions and focused on critical information. The completely connected layers performed pattern mapping and prediction at the highest level. The accuracy, recall, F1-score, encouragement, and accuracy measures showed that the model performed well in disease categorization. The study revealed the correct identification and separation of the six disorders, demonstrating the efficacy of the suggested model. The findings emphasize the CNN approach's potential for early disease identification and control in bean crops. This study advances plant pathology by offering an accurate and fast approach to diagnosing beans leaf diseases. The proposed framework can help farmers, agronomists, and scholars make informed disease control and preventive decisions. More study is needed to evaluate the model's effectiveness across various bean types and environmental conditions, which will lead to its usefulness in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Mental Health Disorder Detection Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Tehniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the year 2023 mental illness has become a topic that just can't be ignored. According to “Our World In Data” more than 792 million people suffer from some type of mental illness, that means over 10.7% of the global population suffer from mental illness. Data Science is the most popular technology in the world today, and it's not going away anytime soon. There are many organizations that use data science technologies to solve the mental health problem. There are prediction models built with the help of machine learning and deep learning algorithms. The fact is many developers and medical professionals don't understand the difference between machine learning mental health models and deep learning mental health models. There are different technologies used to solve different metal health problems. This project not only tries to address and solve some of the mental health issues with the help of Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques but also differentiate between the models built with the help of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques. In this project 4 machine learning models have been used to solve the mental health problem of whether the individual gets the medical attention he/she needs. The techniques used are Logistic Regression, K-Neighbors Classifier, Decision Tree Classifier and Bagging, On the deep learning side of we things a CNN model is built that determines whether the individual is depressed or not depressed.

articleTitle: Data Driven Decision Making Algorithm for Self Organizing Networks by Q-Learning Methods for Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Q-learning is an algorithm for data-driven decision making for self-organizing networks (SONs). This approach utilizes reinforcement learning principles to automatically optimize various network parameters, enabling SONs to adapt and self-organize in order to maximize network performance metrics such as mean throughput, system capacity, and handover rate. Q-learning has been used in several SONs, such as those for LTEs, WiMaxs, and Mobile WiFis. Q-learning works by considering various network parameters as states or actions, defining a reward function based on desired network performance metrics such as mean throughput, and leveraging algorithms to learn which actions produce higher rewards. With this approach, Q-learning can be used to self-configure, self-optimize, and self-protect SONs, allowing networks to evolve autonomously and remain reliable under diverse conditions.

articleTitle: Various Techniques of Cryptanalysis, Their Challenges and Remedial Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cryptanalysis is a technique that extract the text or information from encrypted text. Nowadays, breaking or hacking the cryptographic algorithm is called as cryptanalysis. It is an approach to find the flaws or weakness within a cipher to make them stronger. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of various techniques of cryptanalysis used for stream ciphers, the challenges encounter in their implementation and potential solutions to address these challenges. This paper covers total nine cryptanalysis techniques which are used to extract information from stream ciphers.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Marine Animal Classification: Enhancing Taxonomic Identification and Conservation Efforts
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Classification of marine animals is essential for studying marine ecosystems, keeping track of biodiversity, and developing efficient conservation plans. The success of deep learning methods in picture classification tasks has increased dramatically in recent years. In this research, we propose a systematic investigation of the use of several deep learning models for the categorization of marine organisms; these models include Inception, ResNetV, ResNet50, VGG16, InceptionV3, Xception, DenseNet, MobileNet, and NASNet, among others. Models originally built on ImageNet were then fine-tuned using transfer learning before being applied to our marine animal dataset for training. Training and validation accuracy were used to rank the models, and the models' overall performance was compared to find the best one. Inception outperformed the other models in tests by a wide margin, with a training accuracy of 95.85% and a validation accuracy of 96.75. Inception's greater performance in marine animal categorization may be attributed to its deeper design and its ability to grasp complex spatial connections. When deep learning models are used to correctly categorize marine species, it may greatly improve taxonomic identification, aid conservation efforts, and make ecological study much easier. Additionally, the results highlight the significance of constructing domain-specific deep learning models for fields like marine biology, where distinct obstacles exist.

articleTitle: Real-Time Maritime Semaphore Sign Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In times of distress, the maritime signalling system using semaphore signs play a crucial role in facilitating communication and ensuring the safety and efficiency of maritime operations. Traditional methods that have been used over the years of semaphore sign communication rely on manual interpretation, which can be subjective, time-consuming, and prone to human error. The interpretation can also vary depending on the observer's skill and experience, leading to inconsistencies in message comprehension. The proposed system aims to provide an integrated solution to enable communication with the help of detection of semaphore signs. It utilizes convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for classification of semaphore signs in real-time. The dataset consisting of semaphore signs for six letters of the English language i.e, ‘A’, ‘E’, ‘F’, ‘O’, ‘S’, ‘V’ is created and used to train the model. The CNN model trained on this dataset showed an accuracy of 99.20% on the train set and 98.87% on the test set while detecting semaphore signs in real time.

articleTitle: Application of Agent Technology in Supply Chain and Negotiation Under E-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the e-commerce environment, supply chain management and negotiation are very important links, and Agent technology provides a very effective application solution. This article discusses the application of proxy technology in supply chain and negotiation in the e-commerce environment. Using agents in supply chain management is one of the most important ways to improve efficiency and productivity. In recent years, proxy technology has been widely applied in various fields, including e-commerce. Agency technology is used to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction. In this study, we investigated how these two companies use agency technology to improve productivity and optimize their business processes by better coordinating human resources and information technology. We also discussed how they can use agents to reduce transaction costs and increase customer satisfaction by improving product quality control. Agent technology can use Intelligent agent to simulate human negotiation in the negotiation link, and make independent decisions by analyzing the key words of the opponent's strategy, attitude, language and other dimensions. Meanwhile, Agent technology can also predict opponents' strategies and reactions, continuously improving the success rate of negotiations through self-learning and self-adjustment. In short, the application of Agent technology in e-commerce has made supply chain management and negotiation more intelligent, efficient, and automated, providing enterprises with higher quality and stable services, and enhancing their competitiveness.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in IOT Site Using CatBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: IoT environment is growing rapidly due to availability of large number of connected components like sensors and actuators.
