Due to heterogeneity and constrained nature of IoT devices, they are vulnerable to security issues, including attacks from unauthorized sources and anomalous behavior within the system. Anomaly detection helps to mitigate these security risks in the IoT infrastructure. Thus, the investigation in IoT network for detecting anomalies is a fast-emerging subject. There are various techniques developed by the researchers for the detecting anomalies and work on improving accuracy, precision etc, yet rarely consider the categorical data. In this paper, we presented a CatBoosting approach which enhances the anomaly detection for IoT devices and handle the categorical data. The proposed approach effectively monitors and distinguishes between normal and abnormal activities in the data by using the optimized techniques like gradient boosting and decision tree. To evaluate its effectiveness, the DS2OS dataset is considered and achieve the accuracy of 99.4% and precision 98.7%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection in Autonomous Vehicles Using Tree-Based Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: According to this study, autonomous vehicles (AV) employ a network intrusion detection system with a tree-structured machine learning model (IDS). In machine learning techniques such as XGBoost, additional trees, random forests, and decision trees, trees are utilized. The decision tree is a well-known classification technique that employs a divide-and-conquer strategy (DT). Each leaf node and decision node in a decision tree represents a criterion test for a particular attribute and outcome class (DT). Using the majority voting rule, the decision tree class with the most votes determine the categorization outcome. This is how Random Forest, an ensemble learning-based classification algorithm, works (RF). Extra Trees (ET), a comparable ensemble model, is made up of a large number of randomly generated decision trees generated by analyzing a large number of data samples. To improve performance and speed, the XGBoost ensemble learning system employs gradient descent and multiple decision trees. The IDS multi classification problem is solved using machine learning algorithms. The proposed method achieves high detection rates at low processing costs by combining feature selection and ensemble learning. The computational efficiency of well-known supervised machine learning techniques is also considered when selecting a model. The proposed method for detecting different threats in anti-virus (AV) networks produced promising results.

articleTitle: Prediction of Channel and Enhancement of System Energy in Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) by Convolution Based Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper, we discussed the prediction of a channel and energy enhancement in wireless body area networks (WBANs). WBANs are becoming increasingly popular due to their low cost, ease of use and wide-area coverage. They are used mostly for monitoring and tracking of medical applications in addition to sensing, communication and localization in modern computing applications. The channel predictions used in wireless body area can be done either through deterministic methods or stochastic methods. The most widely used method for channel predicting in WBANs is deterministic models, such as ray-tracing and single-cell-based modeling. Stochastic methods use statistical measurements based on multipath fading environments. Furthermore, energy enhancements are key criteria for WBANs, especially in energy sensitive applications such as medical monitoring. To improve energy efficiency in WBANs, there are some techniques that can be used such as routing optimization, power management and resource scheduling. These techniques can lead to improved energy utilization and enhanced availability of WBANs. We have discussed the different strategies used to predict a channel and to enhance system energy in WBANs. We have also presented some recent developments related to the enhancement of energy in WBANs. We have also discussed some open issues related to the energy prediction and enhancement in WBANs. This review paper provides a comprehensive view of the field of channel and energy prediction and enhancement in WBANs.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Control of a two-area power system using Supervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Automatic Generation Control (AGC) plays a pivotal role in maintaining the delicate balance between electricity consumption and production. Our study delves into the intricacies of this system. To ensure its real-world applicability, we construct a simulation of a regional electricity grid, validated through generator-tripping experiments that closely mirror actual grid scenarios. Employing a well-established AGC control model, we scrutinize a simulation-based approach applied to a two-area thermally linked power system. Here, we propose intelligent techniques like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Supervised Machine Learning (SML) to optimize PID controllers, with the primary objective being the swift restoration of the grid's frequency to its desired standard while minimizing undesirable undershoots and overshoots during load fluctuations. Our comparative analysis of these techniques, focusing on settling time and overshoots, highlights the superiority of PSO and GA, showcasing their effectiveness in AGC applications. This research underscores their potential for enhancing grid stability and efficiency, shedding light on areas for further development in the realm of Supervised Machine Learning.

articleTitle: Acceptance of Google Classroom Technology among Students at Romblon State University-Cajidiocan Campus Using the Modified UTAUT Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The fundamental change that has come to be accepted as the standard in the field of education has fundamentally altered both the transmission and acquisition of knowledge. As a response to extraordinary global difficulties, the educational system has embraced a hybrid approach that integrates digital tools with more traditional pedagogical methods. The researchers in this study employed a modified version of the UTAUT model to the acceptance of Google Classroom technology among RSU Cajidiocan Campus students as a basis for adopting the technology in the new normal in education. Only facilitating conditions and hedonic motivation demonstrated statistically significant relationships with technology acceptance, according to the findings. The relationships between social influence, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and performance expectancy were not statistically significant. The high R-square and adjusted R-square values indicated revealed the revised UTAUT model explained a significant percentage of the observed variability in the behavioral intentions of students to utilize Google Classroom. The model accurately reflected the associations between predictors and behavioral intent. These findings contribute to our comprehension among the many elements that have a role in the dissemination of educational technology and which may direct efforts to increase student technology adoption.

articleTitle: ELMo Layer Embedding Comparision with Short Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: ELMo was the first context based embedded generated neural model which mainly solved the problem of polesmy issue. Word embedding generated with ELMo was used with downstream tasks such as text classification to improve the classification performances. The architecture of ELMo consists of 3 layers such as convolution layer, and two LSTM layers. These layers can be either concatenate or used separately to generate different embedding representations. with the existing work, ELMo embedding layer performances was not properly evaluated for short text classification tasks. Moreover, it is hard to identify the best traditional classification algorithms with ELMo embeddings. Therefore, this study mainly focuses on identifying the best layer embedding weighting scheme as well as the best traditional machine learning algorithm which performs well with short text classification tasks. Seven short text type datasets were selected for the experiment. According to the experiment, concatenation of three layers was identified as the best layer embedding representation over the others. There was a around 2–4% performance improvement over the other layer combination. Moreover, the support vector machine algorithm showed the best classification performances among other Machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Degenerative Parkinson's Disease Using Various Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: There are millions of people throughout the globe who are dealing with the degenerative neurological ailment known as Parkinson's disease (PD). Improving patient outcomes requires prompt diagnosis and treatment. Diagnosis has traditionally relied on clinical observation and medical history; this method is not only inefficient, but it may also lead to a wrong diagnosis. Due to recent developments in machine learning, algorithms have been developed that can accurately predict PD based on patient speech features. In this work, we look at the feasibility of using machine learning models to make PD predictions based on individual patients' vocal characteristics. We used a dataset that included measurements of many sound features, such as fundamental frequency shift, amplitude fluctuation, and nonlinear dynamical complexity. According to our findings, machine learning systems can accurately identify PD from voice features. These algorithms have the potential to aid in the early diagnosis and treatment of Parkinson's disease, which in turn would improve clinical results and the quality of life for those living with the disease. The study emphasizes the need for more research into this field to improve patient outcomes and healthcare, as well as the potential of machine learning in medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Analysis and Development Suggestions on Rural Revitalization in China Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Since the establishment of CiteSpace, we have been studying several analyses and development suggestions for rural revitalization in China. The following is a brief summary of these suggestions: Analysis suggestion 1: Rural revitalization in China is a key issue for the future development of the country. The current situation of rural revitalization in China can be summarized as follows: in the past few years, the number of impoverished people has sharply increased; The gap between urban and rural areas has widened; There are still many issues that need to be addressed in terms of poverty alleviation and economic development. This article analyzes the current research status of rural revitalization in China based on CiteSpace, and finds that the current research mainly focuses on policy research, industrial development, and social and cultural aspects, while lacking research on the overall development strategy of rural revitalization. Therefore, this article proposes three major development strategies for rural revitalization, namely protecting the rural environment, promoting the development of agricultural industries, and developing rural social culture. Among them, it is necessary to strengthen rural environmental protection and promote the construction of ecological civilization; To promote modern agricultural technology and cultivate rural industries to develop and strengthen rural economy; To explore the cultural heritage of rural areas and inspire innovation in rural culture. Finally, this article proposes a series of relevant policy recommendations to promote the healthy development of rural revitalization in China.

articleTitle: Assessment of Microclimatic Alteration and Their Impact Using Crop Level Data Through Experimental Prototype of Agro Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Agrivoltaic (or) Agrophotovoltaic system is a rapidly growing land productivity method by using photovoltaic (PV) panels in agriculture. The vertical panel positioning and the tilted panel positioning are the design methods, which are placed on land looking after solar resources and the type of crop which is to be grown. The agrivoltaic is contributing to the expansion of renewable energy production. Every crop has a different habitat, some are grown in wintry weather conditions, and some are in hot conditions. To grow the crops suitable soil, temperature, humidity, moisture containing soil are required. And due to alterations in microclimatic conditions, the crops are getting affected, so the crop yield is continuously decreasing. To avoid this situation and increase the productivity of land, solar panels are placed on agricultural land to generate a double source of income. This term is said to be the double use of land productivity. While using the PV panels in agricultural land, how the shadow is affecting the crops and what will be the crop level temperature, and humidity condition is to be measured and analysed by this project. To measure the temperature, humidity, moisture, and the PV panel output voltage, current a microcontroller-based data logger is designed. The data logger function is to collect the temperature, humidity, and soil moisture data under the PV panel and open surface. After analysing the data from open surfaces and under PV panels the data will elaborate the knowledge of the agrivoltaic in Indian weather conditions. Also the PV panel, voltage, and current measurement when it is directly connected to the load side are to be calculated through sensors.

articleTitle: Enhancing Land-Based Robotics Through the Development of Remotely Operated Vehicles for Military, Rescue and Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, there have been significant advancements in Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs), particularly in air and underwater applications. However, the progress in land-based ROVs has been slow, necessitating innovative approaches to address the existing challenges. This research paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the current state of land-based ROV technology, focusing on its limitations. A comprehensive solution is proposed, which combines well-established technology from the gaming industry, such as steering wheel controls and accelerators, with high-performance vehicle control systems to overcome these shortcomings. The suggested approach aims to enhance the control and precision of land-based ROVs using imitation learning techniques, thereby increasing operator safety during critical missions. The paper highlights the primary features and capabilities of the proposed model while underscoring its potential to revolutionize land-based robotic systems. The researchers aspire to advance the field of remote vehicles operating in challenging terrains by providing valuable insights derived from their study. The conclusions drawn from this research significantly impact the future development and utilization of land-based ROVs, paving the way for safer and more efficient operations across various sectors and applications.

articleTitle: Reduction of Bit Rate Error by Mapping Optimization Technique for Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Bit rate error is an important factor that affects the performance of digital signal processing. In order to reduce this error, it is important to optimize the signal mapping process. This paper presents a mapping optimization technique that is used to minimize bit rate error in digital signal processing systems. The optimization process involves the selection of mapping functions with optimal properties that minimize the bit rate error. The optimization technique takes into account the signal constraints and the hardware-specific characteristics of the system, and uses an iterative search process to find the optimal mapping functions that minimize the bit rate error. The results show that the optimization technique reduces the bit rate error significantly, and can be applied to a wide range of digital signal processing systems. Furthermore, the optimization technique offers significant improvement in performance compared to the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Development of User Friendly Based Home Health Monitoring System for The Prediction of Hypertension Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a serious and potentially deadly disorder that afflicts one in three adults. It is a major risk factor for heart attack, stroke, and other cardiovascular diseases, and is an important predictor of premature death. Machine learning algorithms can be used to predict the occurrence of hypertension in individuals, based on a range of factors such as age, gender, genetic predisposition, and lifestyle. Machine learning algorithms rely on data science techniques, such as clustering and classification techniques, to analyze vast amounts of data, such as medical records, to identify patterns and make predictions about the disease. Additionally, machine learning algorithms can be used to identify potential risk factors for hypertension, or factors that can be altered to reduce a person's risk of developing the disease. By combining the insights gained from machine learning algorithms with the knowledge of healthcare professionals, healthcare organizations can improve diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of this life threatening condition.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of Panels Using Thermoelectric Cooling Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Solar energy, with its vast potential as a sustainable energy source, is quickly rising to prominence. As the temperature of a PV panel rises, its efficiency drops. Therefore, when the temperature rises, the power output of the PV module decreases unless the heat is removed. The efficiency of PV panels could be improved with the help of module cooling. This thermoelectric system is utilized for cooling purposes. Combining photovoltaic (PV) and thermoelectric (Thermoelectric) modules can improve the overall efficiency of the solar energy conversion system by maintaining a consistent temperature. There has been research into thermoelectricity and a model of PV-Thermoelectric combo produced to show how effective these two types of modules may be when combined. The research demonstrates the effectiveness of a thermoelectric cooling system in improving the electric conversion efficiency of a PV array. If the heat is not dissipated, a PV module's output power decreases as its temperature rises

articleTitle: Advancements in Cancer Disease Prediction Using Modified Multi Model Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cancer disease prediction is a critical task in healthcare that can significantly impact patient outcomes. This abstract presents a multimodal deep neural network (DNN) approach for cancer disease prediction, implemented in MATLAB. The proposed model leverages the power of DNNs to handle diverse types of data, such as medical images, genomic profiles, clinical records, and patient demographics. By integrating these multimodal data sources, the model aims to capture a comprehensive view of the disease, incorporating both genetic and phenotypic information. The MATLAB implementation allows for efficient data processing, model training, and evaluation. The performance of the proposed multimodal DNN model is assessed using benchmark datasets, and the results demonstrate its potential in accurate cancer disease prediction. Further research is needed to explore the interpretability of the model's predictions and expand its application to real-world clinical settings. Overall, this work contributes to advancing the field of cancer diagnostics by utilizing a multimodal DNN approach implemented in MATLAB for improved disease prediction.

articleTitle: The Enabling Role and Value Realization Mechanism of the Internet Economy on the Regional Homestay Economic Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: With the in-depth development of Internet information technology, changes have taken place in the consumption demand, consumption mode and operation and management mode of homestay consumers, which has promoted the transformation of the traditional business model of homestay. The Internet has also changed the way companies operate, communicate with customers and interact with suppliers. The Internet is a global network connecting millions of computers around the world. It allows people to get information from anywhere in the world at any time. This is due to the use of software called “application”, which allows users to perform specific tasks, such as sending e-mail, playing games or watching videos online. Based on the strategic background of “Internet plus”, this paper analyzes the impact of the Internet on the business model of home stay from a theoretical perspective, and on this basis, discusses the feasible path of Internet based business model innovation of Zhejiang home stay. First of all, in order to study the characteristics of the Internet and explore the elements of the business model of Internet plus home stay industry, through the construction of the Internet plus home stay business model, and through innovation in the three major elements of market positioning, operating system, and profit model, it provides various possibilities for the combination of home stay product categories and service categories, and establishes closer links with its target customer groups to achieve win-win cooperation with complementary industries and competitive industries.

articleTitle: Impact of FDI Attack in Grid with Minimal Information
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper investigates the covert threat of Stealthy False Data Injection (SFDI) attacks on microgrid state estimation, a vital aspect of energy distribution management. As cyber-attacks grow in sophistication, SFDI poses an insidious threat, capable of bypassing conventional bad data detection mechanisms and distorting system states. The study unravels the intricacies of these stealth attacks, elucidating their methodology, potential impacts, and their capacity to undermine microgrid reliability and safety. Through detailed analysis and simulation, the research proposes an innovative framework to enhance the cyber security of microgrid systems, specifically addressing the shortcomings of current bad data detection schemes. By deepening the understanding of SFDI attacks, this study aspires to contribute to the resilience of critical microgrid systems and to inspire further research into robust defense strategies.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Various Embedding Techniques for Identification of Depressive Contents in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Depression has emerged as the most common mental disorder in today's world, causing experts to concentrate on early detection in order to minimize its long-term consequences, including the likelihood of suicidal thoughts leading to suicide. As societal dependence on social media as an essential means of interaction expands, it has evolved into a significant platform for individuals to interact and engage with others, surpassing conventional interactions in person. Understanding this transition, researchers have shifted their focus to using social media data to detect indicators of depression. There is a rising opportunity of identifying and tackling depression more effectively, potentially preventing its damaging repercussions, by using the large volume of information provided on these platforms. To provide a solution, we propose a model that can effectively identify depression in social media data. Considering three different embedding techniques such as TF-IDF, Word2Vec, and BERT model classified using conventional machine learning algorithms, we compare the performance of each embedding technique on two different datasets. Context-aware sentence embedding method BERT has achieved better accuracy compared to hand-crafted feature extraction and static word embedding methods.

articleTitle: Prediction of Accuracy in Wireless Networks by Power Control Algorithm with Multi Agent Q-Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The design of power control algorithms for wireless networks has long been a challenging problem for researchers. Previous research has focused mainly on optimizing the delivery of data in order to increase network throughput and reduce interference. However., prediction of the accuracy of these algorithms in different scenarios is an open problem which has received little attention in the literature. This paper proposes the use of a Support Vector Machine (SVM) for predicting the accuracy of a given power control algorithm's performance in a wireless network. The algorithm was trained using data from a large pool of transmissions over many different wireless networks., and a cross-validation procedure was used to ensure that the results are not biased. The performance of the SVM model is compared to traditional algorithms and shows significant improvements in accuracy. Additionally., the results illustrate that different scenarios and networks may require different power control algorithms and that the SVM can accurately predict which algorithm is best suited for each scenario. The results suggest that the improved accuracy of the SVM model should be taken into account when designing power control algorithms for wireless networks.

articleTitle: Glomeruli Detection Using Faster R-CNN and CenterNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Histopathology is a complex discipline that requires the expertise of skilled pathologists to analyze tissue specimens accurately and provide guidance to clinicians in the management of a patient's healthcare. Digital histopathology has revolutionized the field of pathology and has indeed offered a helping hand to pathologists. The integration of Artificial Intelligence(AI) based digital pathology not only streamlines the pathology workflow but also offers a more comprehensive and individualized perspective, empowering pathologists to better manage the progression of intricate diseases. The renal biopsy is an essential diagnostic tool for identifying glomerular diseases. The detection and localization of glomeruli are crucial in the initial stages of diagnosing kidney diseases. Accurate counting of glomeruli in WSIs can aid in research studies aimed at under-standing the pathophysiology of kidney diseases and developing new treatments. This work aims at finding the best possible object detection mechanism to accomplish the automated detection of glomeruli in renal disease diagnosis. The experiment is carried out with the variations of developing Faster R-CNN which takes the input of single glomeruli and, the Faster R-CNN model and CenterNet model which takes WSI patches with multiple glomeruli separately. This study is a comparative analysis among the developed models and the results obtained show that Faster R-CNN is achieving promising results with an average IoU of 64.2% and an mAP of 65.7% with WSI image patches.

articleTitle: Improving Efficiency of Panel Using Water Spraying Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Water spray application over the surface of pho-tovoltaic (PV) panels as a potential alternate cooling method is discussed. Water spray cooling was used as an alternate method since both sides of the PV panel could be cooled at once; this allowed researchers to examine how cooling affected the performance of the panels under conditions of maximum solar radiation. When cooling the front and rear of PV panels at the same time, the average panel temperature dropped from 54 C (uncooled PV panel) to 24 C. It was also established that the proposed water spray cooling method is economically viable, with the main benefit relating to the surface of the PV panel and its self-cleaning effect, which serves as an additional boost to the average provided electricity. One technique to improve the efficiency of a PV panel is to use this water-cooling device to keep it at a low temperature while it is in use.

articleTitle: Emerging Role of Healthcare Chatbots in Improving Medical Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study proposes integrating healthcare chatbots and assistive robots to address issues in densely populated areas with limited medical services. These robots offer benefits such as quicker and more accurate diagnoses, alleviating the workload of medical workers. The suggested healthcare chatbot enables efficient health inquiries through question-and-answer discussions. Users can input symptoms and receive ideas for suspected diseases, along with guidance on how to seek medical help. The chatbot uses natural language processing and machine learning. The chatbot compares symptoms to a database of recognized ailments, achieving an impressive 93% accuracy and outperforming existing models. The combination of accurate healthcare chatbots and assistive robots shows excellent potential for improving patient access and healthcare delivery, benefiting the medical sector.

articleTitle: Growth and Application of Intelligent Systems in Various Fields
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: As the technology is advancing there is a direct growth in communication travelling, exploring new technological resources. There is a vast amount of boom in the tourism sector and it's redefining the tourism industry's production process, and affecting industry stakeholders. This study investigates the application of an intelligent system to electronic tourism and custom apparel production systems, as well as the use of an intelligent system for decision making. In this paper, the involvement of intelligent systems in three fields has been investigated, namely electronic tourism, clothing market, and decision making. Additionally, a comparative performance evaluation of the growth of intelligent systems has been performed to analyse the growth of intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Key-frame extraction in Spacio-Temporal Neural Networks for Human-Action Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Video analysis especially related to human-actions is an crucial part of research done in domain of computer science and mathematics. Some of the areas are image and video processing, computer vision and Video understanding systems. With widespread use of mobile phone and other comb act video recording devices people capture many events that involve human as a center object This paper presents and tests various models that can extract both spacial feature's using CNN and temporal feature using RNN. By Developing a system that train a Deep learning model and optimized it to identify the type of human action/activity and ultimately classify them into categories/classes of different action performed by humans daily. A key-frame extraction approach has been implemented to increase the model's performance. Using an innovative algorithm, this technique selectively finds and classifies key-frames. By concentrating primarily on these key-frames, overall processing time is lowered without jeopardising the model's significant performance increases.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prevention of the Influence and Common Failure Modes of the Unqualified Air Tightness of the Automobile Headlamp
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Car headlights are an important component of ensuring safe driving. Domestic and foreign automobile manufacturers regard light and gas inspection as two important indicators for lamp inspection, and start from the lamp production line to conduct strict testing on light and gas inspection. Based on the current situation of automobile headlight inspection in China, the impact of unqualified airtightness of automobile headlights was analyzed, and common fault modes and prevention research were analyzed. Analyzing and preventing the impact of substandard airtightness and common failure modes of automotive headlights is a high-risk process. The reason is that there are many factors, such as temperature changes in summer or winter, humidity changes in rainy or dry seasons, and dust accumulation in the cabin when driving on rough roads, which may lead to a decrease in weather resistance. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze these factors before starting the investigation. Common failure modes of unqualified airtightness include aging or damage of sealing rings, loose interfaces, and glass breakage. Among them, aging or damage of the sealing ring is the main reason for the unqualified airtightness of the lamp. In addition, improper use can also lead to unqualified airtightness, such as improper installation leading to loose interfaces, etc. For the issue of unqualified airtightness of lighting fixtures, the following measures can be taken: regularly check the airtightness of lighting fixtures, replace aging or damaged sealing rings in a timely manner, keep the lighting fixtures dry and clean, correctly install and check whether the interfaces are tight, etc. These measures can effectively improve the service life and driving safety of lighting fixtures.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning-Based MRI Radiomics for Brain Tumor Prognosis and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Advancements in deep learning (DL) techniques have brought a ray of hope in the battle against brain tumors by significantly improving their detection and segmentation in MRI scans. This research paper delves into recent studies that have introduced innovative DL models for brain tumor diagnosis and segmentation, achieving exceptional levels of accuracy, precision, recall, and AUC values. The VGG16, VGG19 and Hybrid-DANet architectures, among others, have emerged as beacons of promise, enabling automated tumor delineation and MR image segmentation. The integration of DL algorithms in clinical practice not only enhances surgical and radiotherapy planning but also plays a vital role in survival prediction and tumor subtyping. The discoveries of this study reveals the extraordinary capabilities of DL techniques in elevating brain tumor detection and segmentation accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score. It highlights the power of embracing hyperparameter tuning to unlock optimal performance and redefine the landscape of brain tumor diagnosis and treatment. This profound progress instills a sense of warmth and optimism, as DL paves the way for more personalized and effective care for individuals battling brain tumors. With every step forward, DL empowers healthcare professionals and instills hope in patients and their loved ones, offering a brighter future where early detection and precise tumor segmentation become cornerstones of compassionate care.

articleTitle: Threshold Based Real-Time Landslide Prediction System Using Low-Cost Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Landslides pose a recurring threat in the Himalayan region, leading to devastating consequences in terms of human casualties and property damage. This research introduces a groundbreaking approach to real-time landslide monitoring and prediction, leveraging an affordable sensor network. The system employs a network of wireless sensors strategically placed to continuously monitor environmental conditions and gather pertinent data. This data is then transmitted to a cloud server via a WiFi module, where it is integrated into the PowerBI platform for visualization and analysis. To predict landslides in real-time, the collected data is fed into a machine learning model. The performance of three algorithms, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor (K-NN), and Decision Tree (DT), was evaluated using the acquired data. Among these algorithms, SVM demonstrated exceptional results, exhibiting low values for key error metrics such as Mean Squared Error (MSE=O.067), Mean Absolute Error (MAE=O.246), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE=0.204). Threshold values are determined based on the training model's output, enabling the generation of alerts and warnings at different levels. This innovative system significantly enhances preparedness and response strategies in landslide-prone areas, equipping stakeholders with timely information to effectively mitigate the impact on lives and infrastructure.

articleTitle: The Quest for Fairness: A Comparative Study of Accuracy in AI Hiring Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning based models are increasingly being used in developing models for automating recruitment systems in various Multinational Companies as well as small-scale and developing companies and industries. With the advent of Generative Artificial Intelligence models, many companies are turning towards automatic and AI-based hiring software. J.P. Morgan uses HireVue, Deloitte incorporates Hiretual for talent sourcing and engagement, IBM incorporates X.ai for automated interview scheduling and many more. But in all these systems a major factor to consider is the biasness in the models and how to detect them and efficiently mitigate them. Some models unwillingly sometimes amplify the biases in the models and results in faulty and biased predictions which can lead to the inaccurate matching of profiles to the job description and result in wayward hiring processes. The biasness can be based on the parameters such as gender, address, etc., or biasness transferred from the programmer into the model while creating the model which is called unconscious bias. The models implemented in the research are Random Forest, Decision Tree, KNN Tree, AdaBoost, and XGBoost. The accuracies for the models Random Forest, Decision Tree, KNN Tree, AdaBoost, and XGBoost were 0.80, 0.81, 0.81, 0.78, and 0.84 respectively.

articleTitle: Achievement of Good Energy Efficiency in WSN using Sleep/Awake Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) consist of numerous small battery powered sensors designed to collect measurement data from specified locations within an area of interest. The management of these energy-constrained sensors is a great challenge for WSN-based applications designers, since these sensors have to collect and transmit data for long periods of time. Various strategies have been developed to reduce energy consumption and thus prolong network lifetime. Among them, Sleep/Awake schemes are of great importance due to their highly efficient mechanism. Sleep/Awake technologies in WSN provide an effective way of decreasing energy consumption while maintaining the efficiency of data collection and transmission. Sleep/Awake-based schemes typically consist of two components, namely the sleep scheduling algorithm and the wake scheduling algorithm. The former determines the duration and timing of the sleeping phase of a particular node and the latter determines the duration and timing of the wake phase. These algorithms take into account different parameters such as the node's energy level, the acceptable transmission rate, the current network load, and the network topology. The main goal of Sleep/Awake technology is to achieve good energy efficiency in WSN by reducing the energy consumption of the nodes. The sleep scheduling algorithm ensures that nodes go to sleep at the appropriate times so that the quota of the total energy used for transmission is minimized. The wake scheduling algorithm, on the other hand, wakes the nodes up periodically to collect and transmit data. Aside from energy efficiency, Sleep/Awake technology also helps in preserving the longevity of the nodes. Through the judicious use of Sleep/Awake algorithms, WSNs can achieve maximum performance and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Compressed Air Energy Storage Scheduling with Demand Response in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Due to the enormous need for electricity the power system has large integration with uncertain renewable sources. Mitigating the intermittent nature of solar power requires bulk energy storage systems (ESSs) for the fulfillment of vast energy needs in an economic way. For maintaining a balance between supplies is equal to demand the demand response (DR) programs is a tremendous option. The DR programs are ultimately used for load balance by shifting loads or load scheduling. The applied demand response theory helps in mitigating fluctuation in load and further gives a reliable and cost-effective solution. In this paper, the uncertain parameter related to solar power and the economic operation of compressed air energy storage (CAES) for large solar penetration with the DR program is deliberated. The bulk ESSs like the CAES system are a productive way for reducing irregularity of solar PV production, as it has large capacity and is environment friendly. Also, the case study is done by focusing on optimal and commercial approaches. The case study includes the IEEE six bus system along with PV modules, which offer solutions like curtailment of solar and overall cost reduction.

articleTitle: Real-Time Casualty Detection System Using CCTV Surveillance: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The use of CCTV cameras for surveillance has become widespread in contemporary years, and there is a demand for efficient and accurate real-time casualty detection system to ensure the safety of the public. Our paper proposes a deep learning-based approach for real-time casualty detection using CCTV surveillance. Our approach uses a Densenet121 model that is trained on a huge dataset of casualty images to detect 13 different types of casualties. The model achieved an AUC score of 0.88, demonstrating its high accuracy in detecting casualties. We evaluated our proposed method on a real-time CCTV surveillance dataset and demonstrated its effectiveness in detecting casualties in real-time. Our system can provide timely alerts to emergency responders, enabling them to quickly and effectively respond to incidents and save lives. The results of our study demonstrate the potential of deep learning-based methods for real-time casualty detection using CCTV surveillance, and the importance of such systems in ensuring public safety.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart Disease Diagnosis Using Deep Learning Fusion Algorithm for Patient Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms have become increasingly popular in the field of medical diagnosis due to their ability to identify complex patterns and correlations in medical data in an efficient manner. In this paper, we present a novel deep learning fusion algorithm for the diagnosis of heart disease. The proposed algorithm combines convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks to extract both spatial and temporal features from electrocardiogram (ECG) data. The algorithm is then used to analyse the ECG signals of patients in order to accurately diagnose a heart disease. The performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, where it achieved an accuracy of 95.5%. The results suggest that the proposed algorithm could be used for the early and accurate diagnosis of heart disease.

articleTitle: Quantum Cryptography: Mathematical Modelling and Security Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper offers a thorough investigation into quantum cryptography, a security paradigm based on the principles of quantum mechanics that provides exceptional guarantees for communication and information protection. The study covers the fundamental principles of quantum cryptography, mathematical modelling, practical applications, and future prospects. It discusses the representation of quantum states, quantum operations, and quantum measurements, emphasising their significance in mathematical modelling. The paper showcases the real-world applications of quantum cryptography in secure communication networks, financial systems, government and defence sectors, and data centres. Furthermore, it identifies emerging domains such as IoT, 5G networks, blockchain technology, and cloud computing as promising areas for implementing quantum cryptographic solutions. The paper also presents avenues for further research, including post-quantum cryptography, quantum cryptanalysis, multi-party quantum communication, and device-independent quantum cryptography. Lastly, it underscores the importance of developing robust infrastructure, establishing standards, and ensuring interoperability to facilitate widespread adoption of quantum cryptography. This comprehensive exploration of quantum cryptography contributes to the advancement of secure communication, information protection, and the future of information security in the era of quantum technology.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of LSTM, GRU and Transformer Models for German to English Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) encompasses a broad range of techniques and methodologies for processing and understanding human language. One of the most important NLP applications that has experienced significant advancements and has gained immense importance over the years is Neural Machine Translation. Research on German-to-English language machine translation has remained a prominent area of research within the field of Natural Language Processing and Deep. This paper presents an in-depth analysis of three significant models that are used for Neural Machine Translation namely Recurrent Neural Network with Long Short-Term Memory, Recurrent Neural Network with Gated Recurrent Unit, and the Transformer. For the implementation of each model, a large data corpus of 221,534 sentence pairs is used. Two evaluation metrics are employed to assess the performance of models i.e., the BLEU Score and the ROUGE Score. BLEU-4 Score of 0.386, 0.402, and 0.482 is obtained for RNN+LSTM, RNN+GRU, and Transformer model respectively. Precision, Recall, and F1 Score of ROUGE Score are studied which points to similar results as that Learning of the BLEU Score. Both the evaluation metrics suggest that the transformer model outperforms both variants of RNN. The study also paves the way for further investigation in this area by offering important information about how each model is implemented and the outcomes it produces.

articleTitle: Study of the Doubly-Fed Induction Generator's Electromagnetic Transient Properties During a Surge in Grid Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The analysis of the electromagnetic transient characteristics of DFIGs under grid voltage swells requires an understanding of the voltage response, power output, rotor protection, and control strategy. By carefully analyzing these factors, engineers can design DFIG systems that are robust and reliable under varying grid conditions. Wind turbines uses Doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs) because of their easy ability to adjust the rotor speed and improve the energy efficiency. However, during transient faults, DFIGs can negatively impact the stability of the system. A stator-flux oriented vector control strategy can be utilized for both the stator and rotor side converters to address this problem, and it has been demonstrated to increase the system's stability during transient faults. To learn more about the transient overshoots and ripples in DFIG-based wind turbines, a thorough simulation research was undertaken. Overall, the study provides valuable insights into the dynamic performance of DFIGs in wind turbines.

articleTitle: Single Phase to Ground Fault Line Selection in Distribution Network Based on EMD Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The EMD clustering algorithm based single-phase grounding fault line selection in distribution networks is an effective method to solve the problem of single-phase grounding fault line selection in distribution networks. This method uses empirical mode decomposition (EMD) algorithm to decompose the fault signal, extract the features of the fault signal, classify and analyze the features using clustering algorithm, and ultimately determine the location of the fault occurrence, providing reliable basis for fault processing. The main advantage of this method is that it can reduce the influence between signal features, reduce the impact of data noise, and improve the accuracy and accuracy of fault detection. In the experiment of this method, an IEEE33 node distribution network model was selected for simulation experiments. In the experimental results, this method has very high accuracy in detecting and locating single-phase grounding faults, and can also effectively distinguish different types of faults, improving the efficiency of fault handling. In addition, this method can also analyze the characteristics of fault signals, providing corresponding reference opinions for subsequent maintenance of the line. In summary, the EMD clustering algorithm based single-phase grounding fault line selection in distribution networks is a very effective method for detecting and locating faults, which can improve the accuracy and accuracy of fault detection in distribution networks and provide strong technical support for maintenance and management of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling of Environmental Radiation Spectra using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a mathematical modeling approach for a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that incorporates Savitzky-Golay Filtering and Pyramid Pooling layers for the analysis of environmental spectra. The aim is to improve the network's feature extraction capabilities and enhance its performance in processing environmental spectral data. Savitzky-Golay Filtering is employed as a preprocessing step to reduce noise and smooth the input spectra. By applying convolution operations with weighted coefficients, the network can extract underlying patterns and remove unwanted variations in the spectral data. The Pyramid Pooling layer is integrated into the CNN architecture to capture multi-scale information from the spectra. It divides the spectra into regions of varying sizes and performs pooling operations to extract representative features at different spatial resolutions. By considering information at multiple scales, the network can effectively capture local details and global context in the spectral data. The mathematical modelling of the proposed CNN includes defining the convolutional layers, Savitzky-Golay Filtering operations, and Pyramid Pooling operations. The network's weights and biases are optimized through training on labelled environmental spectra. This mathematical modelling approach contributes to the advancement of computational methods in environmental science and offers potential for further research and application in environmental spectral analysis using CNNs.

articleTitle: A Reliable and Secure Utilization of Resource Power In Wireless Communication by Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, wireless communication has become an increasingly popular form of communication as it has enabled users to make connections with others easily and conveniently. The reliable and secure utilization of resource power in wireless communication is of utmost importance to ensure that users are able to exchange data and communicate securely. There are several essential components of resource power management in wireless communication, such as frequency reuse, power control, and interference management. Frequency reuse can be used to divide a spectrum of available frequencies into segments, allowing more users to access the spectrum concurrently. Power control is a mechanism used to balance the transmission power used by each user to ensure that there is no interference between users. Interference management is used to manage the interference between wireless transmissions of different users to prevent data loss and packet collisions. Furthermore, there are several security measures that can be employed to reduce the risk of data breaches and unauthorized access. These include encryption techniques, access control methods, and authentication mechanisms. Through the secure and reliable utilization of resource power, wireless communication can be made more secure and reliable, enhancing the user experience.

articleTitle: Ensemble-Based Context-Aware Recommender System Using Clustering And Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The recommendation system is facing the problem of how to overcome sparsity, scalability, and cold start issues. Numerous studies have been done to increase recommendation accuracy and address the aforementioned issues. But there is a need for improvement. Therefore, this research proposed a context-aware recommendation system that tries to improve accuracy, scalability, and sparsity issues of recommendation by integrating ensemble clustering for clustering the dataset, SVD for dimensionality reduction, and context-aware for improving the accuracy and sparsity issue. The research also will create a new similarity metric that will be used to find similarities among user-user and/or item-item so that the sparsity of the data is decreased. we evaluate our approach on MovieLens 100k and 1M real-world datasets. The findings indicate that the SVD has performed better with high-accuracy rating prediction using the reconstructed low-dimensional matrices in comparison to the KNN by splitting the sparse and high-dimensional rating matrix into two low-dimensional matrices. While the context-aware uses the item context such as movie ontology and user contexts such as age, location, and gender to improve scalability. On comparison with the state-of-the-art approach so far, we noticed that the proposed method based on (User and Item+SVD+ensemble+Context) was the best-performing technique with an average MAE score of 0.6031. F-measure, Precision, and throughput results demonstrated that the CF recommender systems' performance could be enhanced by using context awareness in conjunction with clustering and dimensionality reduction techniques. Our analysis of findings showed that recommender systems' scalability and sparsity problems can be resolved using the suggested recommendation method.

articleTitle: Adoption of IIoT-Based Smart Manufacturing Systems by MSMEs - A TOE-TAM approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study investigates the factors prompting micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs)' to adopt industrial smart manufacturing systems (SMS) enabled by the Internet of Things (IIoT). The study blended two well-established theories of technology adoption namely the TOE (Theory of Technology-Organization-Environment) and the TAM (Technology Acceptance Model). The study finds technological, organizational, and environmental factors influence the intentions of top management of MSMEs to consider IIoT-based SMS. The results derived from a sample of 307 MSMEs indicate that the utility perception and adopting easiness (technological factors) have a direct bearing on system adoption intention. MSME's commitment (organizational factor) contributed to the top management's intentions for a smart manufacturing system. Lastly, technological (perceived ease of usage and specific) and ambient (competitive pressure) factors influence MSMEs' intentions to adopt SMS.

articleTitle: Text Summarization: GPT Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has witnessed significant advancements in recent years, particularly in the areas of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and transformers. These technologies have revolutionized various industries, including healthcare, finance, and transportation. This study provides an extensive examination of GPT-based models, especially GPT-4, in their ability to effectively condense text. We investigate the architectural elements, training approaches, and multiple strategies used by the model to generate high-quality summaries. Our analysis offers valuable insights into the strengths and possible enhancements for GPT-based models in text summarization tasks.

articleTitle: An Improved Accuracy and Efficiency Based Defect Detection Method for Industrial Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Defect detection is an important part of industrial signal processing that uses various techniques to identify abnormalities in signals. This is done by using a combination of feature extraction, signal analysis, and machine learning algorithms. It can be used in industrial applications such as quality assurance, predictive maintenance, and safety activities. Feature extraction techniques are used to identify features from signals which then used for further analysis. These features can be base waveforms, frequency components, waveform trends, and amplitudes. Signal analysis techniques such as discrete-time Fourier transform, wavelet transform, and fast Fourier transform are used to extract additional information from signals. Machine learning techniques are used to analyze extracted features to detect anomalies in data. This helps in making decisions and optimizing performance of industrial systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Course Scheduling System for College Nursing Teaching Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Curriculum planning and scheduling in nursing teaching in universities is an important and complex issue, especially in the context of an aging population, where the demand for nursing courses is increasing. This paper proposes an intelligent course scheduling system for college nursing teaching based on Ant colony optimization algorithms. Firstly, the system has constructed a curriculum layout design diagram based on the curriculum settings of nursing majors and students' course selection. Then, the Ant colony optimization algorithms is used to optimize the arrangement of courses and find the optimal course scheduling scheme. Finally, the effectiveness of this system was demonstrated through practical case testing. The research results show that the intelligent course scheduling system for college nursing teaching based on Ant colony optimization algorithms has good applicability and effect, can improve the utilization rate of course resources and teaching effect, and has great significance in promoting the training of nursing professionals. Compared with the traditional course scheduling method, the course scheduling system based on Ant colony optimization algorithms has the following advantages: First, the course scheduling effect is better, and can consider multiple factors and constraints to obtain more scientific and reasonable results; 2, Faster course scheduling speed, able to automate course scheduling calculations, and improve work efficiency; 3′ Stronger scalability, able to adjust and optimize the system according to various actual situations, and adapt to different teaching needs. The intelligent course scheduling system for nursing teaching in colleges and universities based on Ant colony optimization algorithms has high practical value and development prospects, and is of great significance for improving the level of nursing talent training in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Design of a Lithium-Ion Battery with Optimal Thermal Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents a design for a lithium-ion electric vehicle (EV) battery that aims to achieve long-range and high performance. The proposed design focuses on optimizing the battery's energy density, power density, and thermal management, which are critical factors for EV batteries. The design also incorporates advanced materials and manufacturing techniques to improve the battery's reliability and durability. To assess the performance of the proposed battery, a comprehensive modelling and simulation approach is employed, including evaluating the battery's behaviour under various driving conditions. The results of the simulations demonstrate that the proposed battery design can achieve a significantly longer range and higher performance compared to current EV batteries. The proposed battery design is expected to contribute to the development of more efficient and reliable EVs, which can help reduce dependence on fossil fuels and mitigate climate change.

articleTitle: High-Performance and Energy-Efficient FIR Filter Architecture Using Parallel Prefix Adder-Based Triangular Common Subexpression Elimination Algorithm for IoT Enabled Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) generate an enormous quantity of data, which necessitates preprocessing at the source to lower the entire amount of data collected for transmission and storage. The finite impulse response (FIR) filter is extensively utilized as a signal preprocessing phase in WSNs. The triangular common subexpressions elimination framework is suggested in which the number of logical operators (LO) and logical depths (LD) in FIR filter implementations has been significantly reduced. In the presented Triangular CSE approach, the occurrences of common Triangular subexpressions are first examined across the complete set of filter coefficients. The proposed method considerably reduces the computational burden, which is again reduced by using Vertical common expressions and Horizontal common expressions. The paper includes a detailed illustration of the algorithm and compares existing algorithms. The proposed architecture minimizes the delay units, structural adders, and adder circuits in the FIR filter's multiplier blocks (MBAs) to decrease the overall complexity of the hardware. Furthermore, the design is improved using Parallel Prefix Adder Based on Kogge-Stone Tree. The LD is not increased during the reduction in LO. Energy consumption is also investigated, along with hardware expenses. Compared to other methods, the proposed solution decreases the number of structural adders while slightly increasing the number of delay elements.

articleTitle: Recent Trends in Deep Learning Based Omnidirectional Image SuperResolution
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Omnidirectional imaging is extensively used in fields such as virtual reality, surveillance, and remote sensing. Super-resolution aims at enhancing the detail and resolution of low-resolution images, including omnidirectional ones. This article provides an overview of deep learning methods for achieving super-resolution in omnidirectional images. Using techniques like CNNs-convolutional neural networks and GANs-generative adversarial networks, deep learning has proven highly effective in improving the quality and resolution of omnidirectional images. The study explores various techniques, including models for single-image super-resolution, methods for multi-frame fusion, and the challenges faced in applying deep learning to omnidirectional image super-resolution. The article also highlights the method used in each technique, discusses potential applications, and identifies future research directions. It lays the groundwork for further advancements in this exciting field of deep learning-based methods to apply super-resolution in omnidirectional images.

articleTitle: Grid based Mobile Communication Network using Multi Stage Authentication Method in Mobile WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Mobile Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are used in a variety of applications, such as military, industrial and consumer products. As WSNs are increasingly deployed in wireless environments, security has become a major issue. One of the key security techniques for protecting WSNs against unauthorized access is the use of multi-stage authentication methods. These techniques use a range of techniques to verify the identity of the user attempting to access the WSN. In multi-stage authentication, the security of WSNs is enhanced through the addition of multiple levels of verification. Each verification stage requires an increased degree of validation. This means that the further a user moves through the stages, the more secure they become. Validation techniques used in multi-stage authentication can include the use of passwords, biometrics, cryptographic keys, certificates, tokens and other cryptographic techniques such as digital signatures or public key encryption. Due to the critical importance of security in WSNs, the use of multi-stage authentication is becoming increasingly common. It provides a robust level of security which is required for protecting the data and resources of WSNs from unauthorized access. Furthermore, as technology evolves, multi-stage authentication is capable of evolving with it, offering WSNs increasing levels of protection from the constantly changing threats.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Threat Detection in Internet of Things Using Optimized Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cybersecurity threat detection in the Internet of Things (IoT) refers to the process of identifying and addressing potential security risks and attacks within IoT systems and devices. It involves monitoring IoT networks and devices for abnormal behavior, detecting intrusions or unauthorized access attempts, ensuring the integrity of data, managing vulnerabilities, analyzing behavioral patterns, and staying informed about emerging threats. This ongoing process aims to maintain the security and integrity of IoT infrastructure by proactively identifying and mitigating potential security threats. Recent studies have demonstrated that deep learning algorithms are highly efficient and offer numerous advantages compared to earlier methods when it comes to conducting security assessments of IoT devices. Dual Channel Convolution Neural Network with Spider Monkey Optimization (DCCNN-SMO), a deep learning technique which visualized colored images for finding harmful intrusions in IoT network. Here, DCCNN used two channels of CNN and combined in fully connected layer for detecting intrusions in IoT network. The hyper parameters of DCCNN were fine tune by SMO which enhance the performance of DCCNN. In this paper, the convergence speed and effectively fine tuning the hyper parameters of DCCNN an Adapted SMO (ASMO) is introduced for better detection of intrusions in IoT network. The position update equation of the basic SMO algorithm is modified by incorporating a dual seek scheme. This approach, employed in the local leader (LL) phase, global leader (GL) phase, and LL decision phase, facilitates the acquisition of fresh outcomes, representing best hyper parameters of DCCNN for better detection of intrusion in IoT network. The performance of the proposed DCCNN-ASMO is demonstrated to be superior in terms of accuracy, precision, and recall, as evidenced by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Enhancing Review Authenticity Using Transformers: Web Extension for Detecting AI-Generated Fake Reviews vs Human-Written Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The importance of the online review system is growing along with the significant increase in internet users. The reliability of online reviews is crucial for businesses since they have a significant influence on their reputation and revenue. It is essential in influencing how people see a good or service, as they are the ones through which customers share their first-hand experience. This study suggests a flexible and user-friendly web plugin while shedding light on the most effective method for locating and eliminating genuine evaluations. The web plugin will have a significant impact on customers and help them form better opinions about a product or service. A supervised learning model is used while deploying the proposed plugin. The user just has to enable the plugin first. The dataset is then retrieved using web scraping tools. Further, in order to extract sound characteristics from the data, it is examined and deconstructed using Natural Language Processing methods. Later predictions are made on the data. Three models namely- BERT, DeBERTa, and XLNet are used for review classification. Based on the experimental results of the study, DeBERTa has a dataset accuracy of 980/0, which is the maximum out of all the three models used. The major goal of this project is to develop a fake survey filtering system that will give clients more trustworthy data and prevent enterprises from losing money dramatically.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Weed Detection Methodologies in Soybean Crop
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Weed detection is a significant problem, especially in India, where agriculture is one of the primary economic activities. Weeds are unwanted plants that compete with crops for resources, and act as pests to crops, resulting in reduced crop yield quality and increased cultivation and labor cost. So, effective site-specific weed detection and removal is necessary for efficient and cost-effective agriculture. Recent studies have focused on developing automated weed detection systems using machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision techniques. Most studies have focused on weed classification, with less attention given to identifying numerous weeds in a single image. The paper aims to comprehensively review and compare various weed detection techniques, focusing on soybean crops, as an image classification and object detection task. After examining the strengths and limitations of each approach, the study concludes that Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based and Transformer-based deep learning models achieved the best possible accuracy possible. These methods can present a potential use case in precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Alternative Methods of Implementing the Applications of Smart Home Automation System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Since the declaration of the concept of technology, it has been mankinds' ultimate motive to make human work easier. There has to be minimum physical effort that humans have to put in in order to accomplish both daily and complex tasks. Automation is one of the key concepts that has replaced the existing workforce with machinery. Smart home automation systems aim to bring the technology of automation to homes. It has replaced the concept of switches, circuit boards and brought the technology in the hands of the user in literal sense. The system can obtain commands and instructions from the user directly through voice automation systems and perform tasks like dimming the lights and turning on the fan with minimal to no physical effort at all. Smart home automation systems aim to bring the idea of automation to a comfortable workspace where people can control their surrounding devices from their mobile phones. In this paper, we have reviewed various different technologies which are used in order to accomplish a safe and fast network in which the devices can communicate with each other. There are various different ways of doing the same thing and this paper reviews multiple ways in which the smart home automation system can work to provide the best results with minimum constraints.

articleTitle: RJB-Net: Residual Deep Learning with Joint Bilateral Denoising Network for Remote Sensing Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Remote sensing image fusion amalgamate information from panchromatic and multispectral remote sensing images to generate an optimum representative image. In this paper, we have proposed a novel method for image fusion known as Residual Deep Learning with Joint Bilateral Denoising Network (RJB-Net). The RJB-Net procedure is initiated with panchromatic image denoising using a joint bilateral filter to suppress noise and retain edge information. RJB-Net model is trained at image patches covering all major spectral classes. The denoised panchromatic image along with multispectral data is input to the residual deep learning network for inference and generates a fused image. The remote sensing datasets used for RJB-Net training and evaluation are Indian Cartosat-1 panchromatic and Resourcesat-2 multispectral imagery. The experiment section compares the RJB-Net denoising output with prominent spatial domain image filtering methods both qualitatively and quantitatively. It is found that RJB-Net fused images inject the spatial information from panchromatic images in a controlled manner while retaining the spectra characteristics of multispectral data. The merging performance of RJB-Net is compared with state-of-the-art remote sensing image fusion techniques that range from classical to recent deep learning model. The proposed method RJB-Net generates superior results among all fusion methods at different feature targets and compared the performance both visually as well as with image quality metrics.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Jaw Muscle Electromyography in the Detection of Temporomandibular Joint Disorder
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Temporomandibular Joint Disorder (TMD), one of the most chronic muscular disorders affecting adults and adolescents whose signs and symptoms are complex. It is estimated that about 60% to 70% of the population has at least one symptom. Although it is prevalent in the general population, females are more prone to this condition. A simple electromyography test is commonly used to visualize and diagnose jaw muscles disorders such as TMD. In this study, the researchers used the wavelet decomposition technique to denoise the surface electromyographic (EMG) signal and extract the various features of the same. They were able to use the classification models to extract the results. After testing the model optimization features, the output values indicated when it came to TMD detection, the Adaboost model outperformed the other techniques. The null hypothesis is disproved by data analysis, demonstrating that there is a significant difference between the EMG activity of the control and study groups.

articleTitle: Decentralized Storage System to Store Data Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's society, data storage is becoming more and more crucial. In the lives of customers, data reliability, secrecy, security, and accessibility have all been crucial factors. All web2.0 vulnerabilities are removed by blockchain in general by introducing new technology and structure. With the power of the blockchain, data storage problems might be resolved and customer privacy and security of their data could be guaranteed. This reduces the possibility of a single point of failure and encourages ideas like tokenization and incentivization to reward customers and storage providers for making data storage compatibility possible. As a result, we offer a decentralised storage system that use a blockchain network and smart contracts to store user data.

articleTitle: Improvement of Routing Path in Efficient Manner using Inter Connection Based Path Selection in MANET
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper explores the use of inter-connection based path selection to improve the routing of data in an efficient manner. Path selection is a key challenge in routing, as there are usually multiple paths that can be used to reach a given destination. It is also important to consider the network conditions that affect the quality and performance of each path. Inter-connection based path selection is a new approach to address these challenges. This method considers the topology of the network, and uses different connections between the source and destination to select the best path. The proposed approach can support multiple types of networks, such as optical, wireless, and software-defined networks. In order to demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, a number of experiments were conducted on simulated and real-world networks. The results of the experiments show that the proposed inter-connection based path selection outperforms traditional routing algorithms in terms of throughput, delay, and network utilization. Thus, it is a suitable method for efficient and reliable routing of data in modern networks.

articleTitle: Pilot Design and Channel Estimation Using Deep Learning for Downlink Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
