abstract: Our research paper presents a new method for designing pilot signals and channel estimation in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems applying two-stage deep learning (DL), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Wide ResNet (WRN). Our proposed DL framework leverages the compressibility of massive MIMO channels in the angular domain to reconstruct high-dimensional channels from underdetermined measurements accurately. The end-to-end ANN-WRN architecture imitates the pilot signals and channel estimation through deep learning. A fully connected layer is utilized to compress the high-dimensional massive MIMO channel vector into low-dimensional received measurements, treating the weights as the pilot signals to design the pilot signals. Unlike traditional methods that increase the depth of the network, WRN allows for adjusting the network width while maintaining high performance, this adjustment improves channel estimation. A fully connected layer and Wide ResNet are employed to reconstruct the high-dimensional channel for the channel estimator. We trained the end-to-end deep neural network using the Adam algorithm, which optimizes a loss function defined as the mean square error between the input and output. By training with extensive channel samples, we could simultaneously obtain the pilot signals and the channel estimator. Our simulation results demonstrate that our proposed solution achieves a superior normalized mean square error (NMSE) of approximately 1 to 2 dB compared to the previous DNN network.

articleTitle: Building Cross-Platform Application for Optimized 3D Bin Packing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel 3D bin packing optimization algorithm and an application built with 3D models for visualization. The algorithm is designed to optimize the packing of 3D objects into a minimum number of bins while minimizing the total volume of unused space. The algorithm is particularly effective for applications in which the input objects of varying sizes and for larger quantities of objects. This paper presents an application built using ElectronJS and ThreeJS, two popular frameworks for developing cross-platform desktop applications and 3D graphics. The application is designed to provide users with an intuitive and interactive interface with 3D models. Combining 3D modeling and 3D bin packing algorithms offers a powerful solution for optimizing packaging processes and reducing waste. By accurately modeling the boxes and pallets in a 3D space, the algorithm can efficiently pack the boxes, leading to cost savings and improved efficiency

articleTitle: Evaluation of CNN Models for Accurate Classification of COVID-19, Pneumonia, Tuberculosis in Chest X-ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study presents a study on the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for the classification of pulmonary diseases in chest X-ray images. The study utilized DenseNet121, ResNet50, VGG16, and a custom CNN architecture to accurately predict the presence of COVID-19, pneumonia and tuberculosis. Datasets sourced from publicly available repositories were used, encompassing diverse variations in patient demographics, imaging techniques, and manifestations of pulmonary diseases. The CNN models were trained on high-performance computing systems using GPUs, with adaptive learning rate strategies for optimization. Data augmentation techniques, specifically rotation, were employed during training to enhance model performance and mitigate overfitting. The trained CNN models achieved promising results, demonstrating high accuracy in classifying pulmonary diseases in chest X-ray images. Evaluation and validation using F1-score, recall, and recall metrics for each disease category confirmed the models accuracy and reliability. These models serve as valuable tools for assisting radiologists and healthcare professionals in diagnosing pulmonary diseases. Although this study did not include visualizations of learned features, future work could explore interpretability techniques such as gradient-based class activation maps. In conclusion, this study showcases the effectiveness of CNN models in automating the classification of pulmonary diseases in chest X-ray images, offering potential for more efficient and accurate patient care. Keywords: pCNN, chest X-ray, COVID-19, pneumonia, tuberculosis, DenseNet121, ResNet50, VGG16

articleTitle: Plant Detection and Counting using Yolo based Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In agricultural applications, identifying and counting plants in plot photos is essential for yield estimation, crop monitoring, and resource optimization. The YOLO (You Only Look Once) method is used in this work to properly identify and count plants in plot photos. The algorithm was trained using the Roboflow platform through a supervised learning procedure. This method provides an automated and effective solution for plant analysis in agriculture by utilizing the power of machine learning. A broad dataset of plot photos with plants is gathered as part of the technique, and each plant instance is then annotated with exact bounding boxes. The Roboflow platform is used to manage and annotate data effectively. For plant detection, the YOLO method, known for its real-time object detection capabilities, is used. YOLO achieves impressive detection speed without sacrificing accuracy by dividing the input image into a grid and forecasting bounding boxes and class probabilities for each grid cell. The suggested method shows promising outcomes in precisely identifying and counting plants in plot photos. By giving farmers, agronomists, and researchers access to insightful information for crop management and decision-making, it has the potential to greatly improve agricultural practices. The methodology can be improved in the future, and its application can be broadened to include more plant species and climatic situations.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection Using ESP32CAM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), vehicular crashes result in an estimated 1550 deaths, 71000 injuries, and 12.5 billion dollars in monetary losses each year. Developing an affordable, convenient-to-use, easy-to-install, and non-wearable system to monitor drowsiness and fatigue may provide employers a way to address drowsy driving and workplace fatigue, this will not only prevent fatigue-related accidents but positively affect road safety. To address this issue, the system works by monitoring the driver's eye, closing the eyes for too long triggers an alarm for a few seconds, if the alarm gets triggered 3 times in a row, it will continuously go on until the device is either rebooted or switched off. The system consists of ESP32CAM for video transmission over Wi-fi, and a computer for detection, classification, and alarming process.

articleTitle: Skills 360: Machine Learning-Driven Job Recommendation and Immutable Document Verification Through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Validating an applicant's credentials and expertise prior to hiring is one of the most elementary yet crucial responsibilities for every company. However, it is extremely time-consuming owing to the soaring number of applicants, especially in larger firms. Therefore, it is overlooked many times. The hiring department is increasingly concerned about the applicants providing incorrect information, and while traditional talent verification tools are helpful, they are still far from ideal for handling it. Although expensive, this activity is crucial, thus it needs to be made more efficient and cost-effective. Blockchain is a new technology that, due to its decentralised and distributed ledger system, ensures security and trust. Although this is a high-cost activity it is very significant, and hence, needs to be made more efficient and economical. Blockchain is an emerging technology that guarantees security and trust due to its decentralised and distributed ledger mechanism. Therefore, a blockchain based system for the verification of candidates credentials is a promising solution. Furthermore, from an applicant's point of view, it can become overwhelming to pick a job role in the technology industry considering the wide array of career opportunities and roles that are available today. Hence, a sophisticated machine learning algorithm can be used to recommend job titles to student applicants to help ease their decision-making process and provide them with necessary input concerning any career decisions that they would want to make in the future.

articleTitle: Exploring Common Areas and Types of Cybercrime in Today's Digital Landscape
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Since the advent of the Internet, humanity has made great strides in enhancing global communication. But the rise of cybercrime is a serious problem in today's world. To commit a cybercrime, criminals often access a victim's private data over the internet and then use that data to injure the victim in some way, whether it be by smearing their reputation or physically harming them. Cybercrime and other crimes against women have risen in tandem with the development of new technologies. This is due to the fact that over half of all internet users know very little about how websites work. Numerous people, businesses, and even governments have been harmed by cybercrime in recent years. The many forms of cybercrime that exist today and the typical locations where they occur are briefly discussed in this paper. Some examples of cybercrime case studies are also provided.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Learning Resource Recommendation Method for Online Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of learning resource recommendation in online education is very important, but there is a problem that the recommendation is unreasonable. Traditional resource integration methods cannot solve the problems of resource arrangement and resource classification in massive data, and the recommendation effect is not satisfactory. Therefore, this paper proposes an online recommendation algorithm. Firstly, the resource planning theory is used to divide the resources and realize the preprocessing of resource recommendation. Then, use online division to form a collection of resource recommendations. MATLAB simulation shows that the recommendation accuracy and readability of online recommendation algorithms are better than traditional resource integration methods under certain requirements of online education.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Optimization Using CNN and GCN for Adaptive Signal Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The number of vehicles is increasing every day, and hence traffic congestion, especially in intersections, is becoming a major issue. This paper presents a novel approach for traffic analysis and signal prediction using a combination of deep learning techniques.3000 images were utilized to train on CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) for spatial feature extraction using the Yolov5 algorithm. Then those features were given to the GCN (Graph Convolutional Network) as input by creating a DGL graph. The findings from this research provide valuable insights into improving traffic flow efficiency and can be applied in various sectors such as logistics, transportation, and urban planning.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PI Based Controller for the BLDC Motor for Electric Two-Wheeler Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Permanent magnet rotor and field mount on the stator, BLDC motors have gained popularity in recent years due to their high-quality electrical and mechanical characteristics. This enables a wide range of torque and speed control. Therefore, the Brushless DC (BLDC) hub motors now have a wide application range in electric two-wheelers. The conventional PI controller has poor outcomes such as torque ripple are high and steady state error is maximum for nonlinear conditions. The complexity of PI controller tuning and high response time are overcome in fuzzy PI based controller. This fuzzy PI-based controller provides higher accuracy and fast response with respect to time and gives a robust and fast settling time with changes in speed. This paper mainly focuses on analysis of fuzzy PI controller for the BLDC hub motor drive for the electric two-wheeler application. The focus is to improve the torque and speed performance. The proposed fuzzy PI is simulated using the MATLAB, and the motor performance can be observed under several conditions, including continuous speed change and change in load torque.

articleTitle: Visual Design Comfort of OCULUS VR Panoramic Stereo Video Based on Image Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This article explores the issue of visual design comfort in OCULUS VR panoramic stereoscopic videos based on image recognition algorithms. Traditional flat video only includes information in two-dimensional space, while panoramic stereoscopic video contains more information and a richer visual experience. However, there are also some challenges, such as visual fatigue and exposure to inappropriate scenes. Therefore, how to ensure the visual comfort of people when watching panoramic stereoscopic videos is a very important task. This article analyzes and optimizes OCULUS VR panoramic stereoscopic videos using image recognition algorithms. We improve the comfort of video viewing by reducing the rapid movement and jumping of images in the video. At the same time, we consider the device positioning of OCULUS VR as an important factor in visual design, adjusting the lighting, color, and other parameters of the scene in the video to meet the needs of human eye observation. The experimental results show that the optimized OCULUS VR panoramic stereoscopic video has better comfort and user experience. This research result has certain reference significance for the development of 360-degree video visual design and virtual reality technology. In summary, this article focuses on the visual design comfort of OCULUS VR panoramic stereoscopic videos, and improves users' viewing comfort and visual experience through image recognition algorithms and optimization methods. This research achievement provides useful reference and inspiration for the development of related fields.

articleTitle: Redesigning of High Swing Super Wilson Current Mirror Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Current Mirror (CM) circuit has filled in as the huge building thwart in fundamental circuit plot coming to fruition to the introduction of incorporated circuits. In this paper, a high impedance CM which is self one-sided instead of using biasing circuit is proposed. The power supply of the proposed circuit is diminished from 0.8V to 0.5V this lessened voltage supply brings out less power dispersal. In the proposed circuit the issue of befuddling of VDS on info and yield is resolved and is particularly moved forward. Data transfer capacity is furthermore enhanced of this circuit. The DC current blunder is in like manner constrained. The development used to complete the proposed circuit is 0.18μm. The circuit is reproduced using Cadence Design Environment in the UMC 0.18μm CMOS innovation.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach to Classify Lung Cancer Tissue Cells Using Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: One of the deadliest malignancies in the world is lung cancer. In this paper, we are using histopathological images of lung tissue to classify them into cancerous and non-cancerous. We proposed different transfer learning approaches like VGG16, ResNet50, and DenseNet121 to classify the images of tissues into healthy and two types of cancerous tissues. Of the three models, the ResNet50 and DenseNet121 provided better accuracies in training and testing almost reaches to 96%. VGG16 provided 91% accuracy because its complex layers take a long time to be trained. With a high computational capacity system and better training, this model can perform much better. All three proposed models gave good accuracy compared to the basic CNN model and KNN model.

articleTitle: IoT based Cold Supply Chain for Food Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Food is one of the essential needs for human survival. In the present era, there is a rapid increase in the population and emerging growth of technology in the developing countries around the globe. Due to the population increase, there is a demand for an abundant food supply. Most of the food products have a shorter shelf life. It is necessary to maintain food products at a certain temperature so that they can be preserved for a longer duration. There arises a necessity to develop a device that can monitor and maintain the food products. This research seeks to design a cold storage device that can monitor essential food storage specifications such as temperature, humidity, pressure, light and gas compositions like ammonia, methane, carbon dioxide and so on. The cold storage also alerts the user when a parameter passes through the threshold value. The cold storage device can be instated in a moving truck carrying food products as well as in a storage warehouse. It also has a Global Positioning System (GPS) module for the purpose of tracking the real time location of the transporting truck and it also provides a theft alert in the warehouse. Further the user can control the exceeded threshold value from any remote location.

articleTitle: Evaluation of an Individual's Creditworthiness
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A borrower's creditworthiness determines whether or not a lender would trust them to fulfil their loans. A lender will consider a borrower creditworthy if they believe they are capable, willing, and responsible enough to make loan payments on time until the debt is repaid. Credit ratings are used by financial organisations to evaluate and determine a borrower's eligibility. When giving loans to the average person, they frequently impose bias. Payment history (35 %), debts outstanding (30 %), duration of credit history (15%), new credit (10%), and categories of credit in use (10%) make up this credit score. The credit score is a reflection of a person's performance in the lending and borrowing of money. In order to improve the handshake between lenders and borrowers, the suggested algorithm seeks to minimise prejudice as completely as feasible. The choice to lend money can be made based on the person's credit score. The proposed creditworthiness calculation approach eliminates the problems with the loan granting process at major financial institutions and offers a platform for peer-to-peer lending to borrowers.

articleTitle: Improving Facial Recognition Accuracy Using Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The proposed method involves pre-processing of the dataset, which includes normalization and resizing of the images to a standard size. Local binary pattern is then used to extract features from the pre-processed images. These features are used to train a machine learning model, specifically a support vector machine, to recognize faces in the images. The effectiveness of the proposed approach was evaluated using a publicly available dataset, and the results indicate a high level of accuracy in face detection, with a recognition rate of over 90%. The approach was also tested on images with varying contrast and rotation angles, and the results demonstrate its ability to accurately identify faces under such conditions. The proposed method has practical applications in various areas such as surveillance, access control, and forensics. It has the potential to be integrated into security systems for real-time face recognition and identification, improving the accuracy and efficiency of such systems. Furthermore, the method can be extended to include more complex features for more accurate and robust face detection. Overall, this research contributes to the growing body of knowledge on face detection techniques and their practical applications.

articleTitle: Behavioral Customer Segmentation For Subscription
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research paper addresses the challenge faced by mobile app developers in converting free app users to premium users. Specifically, we aim to predict customer interest in the premium version of a mobile app by analyzing user behavior and app usage patterns. To accomplish this, we use a dataset of over 50,000 app users and employ machine learning algorithms to develop a model that predicts subscription conversion with high accuracy. Our study finds that features such as total time spent on the app, frequency of app usage, and user engagement with specific features of the app are strong predictors of subscription conversion. We also evaluate several machine learning classifiers and find that the XGBoost classifier outperforms other algorithms in terms of accuracy and precision. Our findings provide insights into customer behavior and highlight the factors that influence subscription conversion, allowing app developers to focus on improving user engagement and providing value-added features to increase the likelihood of subscription conversion.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-based Intrusion Detection in Cloud Computing using CSE-CIC-IDS2018 Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Securing digital information is vital for several applications. However, attackers are attacking digital information in numerous ways. Traditional methods still uncover several types of intrusions due to the rapid growth in internet technology. In addition, conventional methods cannot detect network attacks in real time. Therefore, the present study proposed the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based system to detect real-time network intrusion. The proposed model uses 19 features selected using the decision tree method implemented in Python (Anaconda 3) environment. The performance of the ANN model was evaluated with accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score, achieving results of 0.999, 0.999, 0.998, and 0.999, respectively. The results are promising and can be used for real-time datasets.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Hardware Accelerator for Bio-Informatics Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: We present the design and implementation of an FPGA-based accelerator for bioinformatics applications in this paper. To process large amounts of data generated by next generation sequencing (NGS) technologies, bioinformatics applications require high-performance computing capabilities. Because of their parallel processing capabilities and reconfigurable hardware, FPGAs are a promising solution for accelerating bioinformatics applications. To achieve high throughput and low latency, the proposed accelerator architecture employs parallelism and pipelining. The FPGA accelerator's performance is compared to software implementations on a CPU. The results of the experiments show that the FPGA accelerator outperforms the CPU implementation.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of 3.3 kW EV Charger
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a 3.3 kW EV charger utilizing interleaved boost PFC (Power Factor Correction) and phase-shifted full bridge converter(PSFB). The objective is to develop an efficient charging system capable of meeting the demands of electric vehicles. The interleaved boost PFC converter is employed to enhance power quality, minimize reactive power drawn from the grid, and improve overall efficiency. The phase-shifted full bridge converter enables smooth operation and efficient power delivery to the EVs battery. MATLAB-based simulations are conducted to optimize the charger's performance, considering factors such as power factor correction, voltage regulation, and load transient response. The proposed charger is designed to work with different types of electric two-wheeler batteries, providing adjustable voltage and current levels. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design, showcasing high efficiency, low ripple, and reliable charging performance. The study contributes to the development of advanced EV charging solutions, promoting sustainable transportation and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.

articleTitle: Microarchitectural Analysis and Characterization of Performance Overheads in Service Meshes with Kubernetes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The cloud is an emerging paradigm, swiftly changing the information technology landscape by managing and providing high-quality services over the internet. With technology stacks moving to the cloud, microservices-based architecture (MSA) is becoming increasingly common. MSA consists of small, modular, and loosely coupled services that communicate over the network via well-defined APIs. Although an MSA may significantly boost the speed and efficiency of software service delivery, it also makes systems more operationally complex. Service meshes have emerged as a viable solution to alleviate this problem by adding a dedicated infrastructure layer on top of the microservices architecture without altering the service implementations. We have performed a thorough measurement and examination of the overheads associated with deploying microservices in a service mesh using wrk2 for latency sensitivity analysis and Linux-perf for microarchitectural analysis. We present a comprehensive overview of the overheads in terms of CPU cycles, system instructions, page faults, and cache misses in deploying a state-of-the-art service mesh (Istio) on a Kubernetes cluster running a benchmark microservices application (Death-StarBench).

articleTitle: Recognition of Diseases on Horticultural Leaves Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's environment, Machine Learning has the potential to make huge strides toward making life better for everyone in the horticulture sector. Disease identification and prediction at the early stage of disease diagnosis will help the farmers get more yields and have a strong economic background. The proposed system uses a neural network algorithm to get insight into using machine learning technology for improving the nation's horticulture in areas like production, crop protection, and day-to-day field monitoring. Our work will also notify us about how various areas of machine learning may be brought together to create a unified result that will aid in the growth of the horticulture industry and, by extension, the nation's overall productivity. Our goal throughout this research was to provide a standardized method for evaluating the development and quality of produce. Because computer vision has so much promise to address issues in rural areas, this research drew on several prior publications for background material.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Fake News Detection with Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Using AI to fight fake news efficiently. Using AI to fight misinformation with more modern approaches from machine learning and natural language processing. This paper discusses on extraction, model selection, training, assement, deploying, and continuous learning. The process includes extracting of tags from all over social media and headlines and quantifying text with AI. The models are chosen using machine learning methodologies such as Naïve Bayes, Support vector, and neural networks. Differentiating fake news and training for satire/Irony and adapting to newer kind of fake trends (image, videos) will help in implementing this effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Various Resonant Coil Configurations for L-G Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this study, resonance grounding failures in power systems are mathematically simulated using the resonant grounding concept. This is done to improve the management of power system grounding fault conditions. MATLAB/SIMULINK tool is used to simulate the environment, the various resonant grounding configurations, and the L-G fault. The findings demonstrate that the zero-sequence current is present at all points of the power system during a grounding failure. Circuit has a place where the zero-sequence current has the greatest amplitude, then the fault phases are all that are present. The simulation findings also show that, in the case of a single-phase grounding failure, grounding an arc suppression coil can immediately reduce the grounding current. Additionally, it successfully removes the arc from the procedure and switches to the more sensible grounding method. Various configurations of the resonant coil are simulated and the results are tabulated. Necessary graphs and the subsequent analysis of the different configurations is done.

articleTitle: Developing a Multimodal Transportation Model for China to Minimize Travel Time and Cost Under Belt and Road Initiative
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: China exports several goods to other countries or cities and to shift these goods has to use different ways such as road, air, and water for their shipment irrespective of air pollution. Recently China invests in Pakistan Gwadar port to transport goods in a multimodal transport system under Belt and Road Initiatives (BRI). As a partner of BRI, Bangladesh offers port facilities for China to transport its goods to reach destinations in the multimodal transportation system. This study offers three alternatives way Kashgar-Gwadar, Kunming- Chittagong, and Shanghai as sources to shift goods from China and other countries as a destination. This research measures the effective travel time in the roadway as well as seaway and then finds the total travel time from each source to each destination. We develop a transportation model using travel time that helps china to make decisions to shift goods from each source to each country to minimize travel time that helps to minimize transportation cost. This model also is effective to take transportation costs instead of travel time and then it will provide direct minimum transportation cost.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the most common diseases occurring nowadays. if we don't find it in the early stages it is hard to survive. Lakhs of people suffering today with this lung cancer and they don't know in the early stages as symptoms changes for person to person in order to overcome from this we are taking help of AI and deep learning for diagnosis of lung cancer where the survival rate will be more if they don't detect in the early stage the survival chances are less and contributing deaths are more. CNN is a model which is easy to diagnose the cancers also called as convNETs the advantage of using CNN is due to its higher performance and accurate. CNN is more efficient in terms of its applications. A tumor is defined as the lumps of tissue when dead cells are not replaced with new cells. CNN or convNET relegated the lumps of tissue is a malignant and benign. A malignant is a serious kind of disease called as cancerous. This work shows accuracy of 99.7% using CNN technique so here we applied input dataset of CT scans using convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Control of Indirect Matrix Converter Using an Optimized 2DOF-FOPID-FF Controller Under Unbalanced Grid Voltage Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The control of Indirect Matrix Converter (IMC) under unbalanced grid voltage conditions is necessary to ensure that the converter maintains a balanced output and operates at maximum efficiency. Therefore, this paper introduces a Two Degree of Freedom Fractional Order Proportional Integral Derivative Control (2DOF-FOPID) technique to operate the IMC under unbalanced voltage condition. The IMC is used to control the input power factor and obtain sinusoidal load currents. This converter is controlled by the proposed Enhanced Squirrel Search (ESS) algorithm based 2DOF-FOPID control with Fractional Filter (FF). The optimal parameter gains of the 2DOF-FOPID-FF control are then determined by using the ESS algorithm. The results show that the proposed control technique has improved transient response with less rise time (0.039 sec), settling time (0.206 sec), and no overshoot and the convergence of the algorithm is quick compared to the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: English Conversation Partner Finder Using MLP Based Fluency Classifier and Linguamatch Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The ability to communicate fluently in a language is crucial in today's globalized world. Non-native speakers often face challenges in achieving fluency and finding opportunities for language practice. In this research work, we propose a novel approach to address these challenges by developing a fluency detection model and a linguistic matching algorithm. The fluency detection model utilizes machine learning techniques to assess the fluency level of non-native speakers. By analyzing a large dataset of audio recordings, the trained model can accurately classify fluency levels as low, intermediate, or high. This model can provide valuable insights into an individual's language proficiency and serve as a tool for self-assessment and improvement. Complementing the fluency detection model, there is also a linguistic matching algorithm that aims to connect non-native speakers with native speakers for language practice. By considering the user's interests and fluency level, the algorithm suggests suitable language partners, facilitating meaningful language exchanges and enhancing the learning experience. Through our research, the proposed work aims to empower non-native speakers by providing them with a comprehensive toolset for fluency assessment and language practice.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Security: Machine Learning-Based Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Internet of Things(IoT) can enhance lives in various ways by facilitating more interaction, technology, and decision-making based on data. The use of IoT devices is growing, which has increased the risk of network intrusion and other security concerns. This paper suggests a machine learning(ML)-based approach for IoT systems' network intrusion detection(NID). The model has been evaluated using a NID dataset that is openly accessible. The strategy uses a variety of ML methods including Naive Bayes(NB), K-Nearest Neighbour(KNN), Decision Tree(DT) and Logistic Regression(LR) for data preprocessing, feature selection, and model selection. The performance of these models has been analyzed using metrics like accuracy, recall, precision and F1-score. The results demonstrate that the utilized method can successfully identify network threats and enhance the resources of IoT systems. The results of this study may be helpful to academics and professionals working on the subject of IoT security. In comparison with NB, DT and KNN, which had accuracy rates of 90.68%, 99.16% and 95.55%, respectively, the system found that DT had the best accuracy, with a rate of 99.47%.

articleTitle: Devise Road Sign Alert Detection for Vehicular Systems Using Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: There are web mappings service applications like Google Maps, Apple Maps, and Waze that offer satellite imagery, street maps, real-time traffic conditions, departure arrival timings, and route planning for traveling by foot, car, bike, and public transportation. These applications enable users to view and hear traffic alerts, turn instructions, lane guidance, and available alternate route options. Road signs like speed breakers, sharp turns, accident-prone zone, steep slopes, etc. are placed beside or above streets to assist the drivers. These applications usually run on the display screen of the car or the commuter's mobile. The driver must keep an eye on the screen as well as on the road signs. At times the driver might miss the road sign due to high speed leading to a tense situation of varying severity. To overcome this problem, we propose an application in which the moving car is connected to a nearby Fog Node that stores road signs along with their proper location. Fog computing minimizes the amount of data transferred to the cloud, lowering bandwidth consumption and associated expenses.. Because the initial data processing occurs near the device, latency is reduced, and overall response time is improved. As the car moves closer to a road sign, The Fog Node evaluates the distance between the road sign and the car's geolocation. If the car is approaching a road sign, the Fog Node will generate an alert voice message. Fog Node being closer to the car will have minimum latency. Using Fog Computing we can send an early voice alert to a user within a certain time before he reaches the location. The solution proposed will provide timely alerts to users before reaching the road segment that requires the attention of the driver.

articleTitle: Bus Surveillance Using CCTV
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Bus surveillance using CCTV cameras is a common practice that helps ensure the safety and security of passengers, drivers, and the general public. CCTV cameras can provide a wide range of benefits. Ensuring bus passenger safety is of utmost importance for any transportation company or authority. Here are some tips to address bus passenger safety: Driver training: Bus drivers should be properly trained in safe driving practices, defensive driving techniques, and handling emergency situations. Monitoring: Bus operators should monitor the behavior of passengers to prevent unruly behavior or dangerous situations. Security: Buses should be equipped with security cameras and other security measures to ensure the safety of passengers and prevent criminal activities. Weather conditions: Bus operators should monitor weather conditions and adjust their driving accordingly to ensure passenger safety. By implementing these measures, bus companies and authorities can ensure the safety of their passengers and minimize the risk of accidents or incidents.

articleTitle: Dehazing of Multispectral Remote Sensing Images Using CNN with ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Satellite image utilization for data interpretation has significantly increased in the current scenario. Deep learning techniques have gained widespread popularity for analyzing satellite image data. However, a major challenge in this field is the presence of haze, which hampers accurate interpretation. Haze occurs when fine dust, smoke, or light vapors reduce the air's transparency, resulting in a lack of contrast in affected regions of satellite images. To tackle this issue, atmospheric correction is commonly employed, but it is a complex and time-consuming process that requires knowledge of various geophysical factors to achieve precise results. Hence, the objective of this research is to develop and implement image processing algorithms that can effectively restore pixels affected by haze, thereby improving the interpretability of satellite images. The proposed work consists of two main phases. Firstly, noise reduction techniques will be applied to the images to enhance their quality. In the second phase, a Convolutional Neural Network with a Residual structure will be utilized to dehaze the images. The evaluation of the proposed system will focus on the Kondapalli region and its surrounding areas in the Kondapalli dataset. This research aims to develop a robust solution that can enhance satellite images affected by haze, providing clearer and more interpretable data for various applications. The effectiveness of the proposed system will be compared with the Dark Object Subtraction method.

articleTitle: Tesla Model S Battery Pack Modelling for Voltage and Current Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the voltage and current monitoring of the Tesla Model S battery pack. The Tesla Model S is an electric vehicle known for its advanced battery technology. Understanding the behavior of the battery pack's voltage and current is crucial for efficient operation, performance optimization, and ensuring the longevity of the battery. The monitoring system provides real-time measurements of the voltage and current parameters, allowing for accurate assessment of the battery's state of charge, health, and performance. The paper explores the various components and sensors involved in the monitoring system, including the battery management system (BMS), current sensors, and voltage sensors. The analysis focuses on the data acquisition techniques employed to gather voltage and current measurements, along with the interpretation and analysis of the acquired data. The paper also discusses the significance of voltage and current monitoring in identifying potential issues such as overcharging, over-discharging, or abnormal behavior in the battery pack. Moreover, the paper investigates the integration of monitoring data with the vehicle's control systems to ensure proper operation and protect the battery from adverse conditions. Additionally, it explores the role of voltage and current monitoring in enabling intelligent charging strategies and optimizing energy consumption. The findings highlight the importance of voltage and current monitoring in enhancing the overall performance, safety, and durability of the Tesla Model S battery pack. The results of this study contribute to the understanding of battery monitoring systems in electric vehicles, providing insights that can aid in the design and development of future battery technologies and energy management systems for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Bangla Hate Speech Detection System Using Transformer-Based NLP and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Hate speech is a form of discriminatory communication disrupts community standards and breaches the line of self-limitation, causing harm to others and occasionally leading to cyberbullying. Hate speech spreads hatred toward a person or a particular group based on various characteristics, e.g., race, religion, gender, and so on is referred to as bias. The offensive speech detection system is the frontier where researchers are battling to provide secure internet using natural language processing and machine learning approaches. In this research, we strive to create an automatic Bangla hate speech detection system using natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning approaches. We utilized our custom dataset and some labeled data from an open-access repository in this work. 4,978 data from both sources were merged and implemented in our proposed model. Different data preprocessing techniques, tokenization, stemming, and removal of stopwords have been applied. Four deep learning and NLP-based classifiers have been applied to detect Bangla hate speech. Google API has been employed to convert text from Bangla to English. The emojis were removed from the datasets and the data were translated into Bangla. The GRU and Attention techniques performed best with 98.87% and 98% accuracies, respectively.

articleTitle: Model-Based Software Development for Predictive Battery Temperature Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In modern vehicles, developing reliable and efficient software systems is crucial for optimal performance, safety, and cost-effectiveness. This paper suggests a model-driven method for developing automotive software, particularly emphasizing the creation of a predictive system for estimating battery temperature. The proposed approach employs Simulink models and the KF algorithm to develop a software system for the temperature control of the battery in electric cars. The accuracy and performance of the KF algorithm are assessed by comparing it with the EKF method for non-linear battery models. Furthermore, the reliability and performance of the proposed approach are assessed through MATLAB Simulink MIL, SIL, and PIL testing. The study findings suggest that the EKF is recommended for estimating battery temperature in rapidly fluctuating systems with non-linear behavior, where accurate estimation is critical. The developed system showed good scalability, efficiency, and outperformed other methods by providing more precise and timely temperature estimates for the battery.

articleTitle: 7-Level MLI Harmonic Performance Analysis Based on Distribution of Switching Angles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Selective Harmonic Elimination Pulse width modulation (SHEPWM) scheme is a fundamental switching frequency based scheme which is used for the control of multilevel inverter in order to avoid the switching losses as well as to control a large number of harmonics for improving the THD performance of the multilevel inverter. However, the distribution of the switching angles per level of the multilevel inverter plays a crucial role in determining the performance of the inverter in terms of THD and existence of the solution for a range of modulation indices. In this paper, the effect of switching angle distribution per level of the MLI has been studied and it has been found that the switching angle distribution very much affects the harmonic performance of the multilevel inverter. The SHEPWM problem is formulated for a 7-level MLI with 13 switching angles to control. The quarter wave formulation's objective function was taken as THD minimization function which is solved using Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: Micro-Sleep Accident Prevention by SMART Vehicle Using AI and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research paper proposes a novel approach to prevent accidents caused by microsleep in smart vehicles through the integration of image processing and artificial intelligence. Microsleep is a brief period of unconsciousness that can occur during monotonous driving, leading to serious accidents. The proposed system aims to detect signs of microsleep in drivers and alert them to take corrective measures. The system uses a camera to capture images of the driver's face, which are analysed using image processing techniques to detect signs of fatigue or drowsiness. Apart from this we have come up with a smart steering wheel proposition, that monitors the data from pressure sensor installed in the wheel and launches an alert when the value drops or deviates from the normal threshold. An artificial intelligence model is then used to classify the level of fatigue and trigger appropriate alerts, such as auditory warnings, to the driver. The proposed system was tested on a dataset of real-world driving scenarios, and the results showed promising accuracy in detecting microsleep and preventing accidents. This system could potentially improve road safety and reduce the risk of accidents caused by driver fatigue in smart vehicles.

articleTitle: Software Test Automation of Power Window Functionality
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the automotive industries, there is a constant development in control strategy with the use of electronic hardware and software for advanced functionality. Software test automation plays a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of power window functionality in automotive systems. This paper aims to automate power window testing by prioritizing crucial functionalities like obstacle detection, thermal and voltage protection, and precise position tracking. The power window is a mechatronic application and its operation is controlled through software algorithm. To establish the experimental setup for this research, essential components such as the power window Electronic Control Unit (ECU), an external DC power supply, PCB layout design and software tools like the vector CANoe tool and Communication Access Programming Language (CAPL) browser were utilized. The automated testing methodology proposed in this paper helps to reduce the damaging of ECU and human injuries while testing. At present, the testing process is performed manually, requiring six weeks to complete 400 scenario checks. However, by automating this testing, the time frame can be significantly reduced to just two weeks. A comprehensive report is generated that includes detailed information such as the start time, end time, and recorded values.

articleTitle: Multifunction Biquadratic Filter based on Second Generation Voltage Conveyor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study introduces a new single input multiple output (SIMO) filter that employs voltage conveyor as an active element. The proposed filter utilises four voltage conveyors in which one is used at the input side and other three voltage conveyors are used as multiple outputs to produce low pass filter (LPF) response, Band pass filter (BPF) response and High pass filter (HPF) response simultaneously. Other than voltage Conveyor it utilises eight passive components out of which three are capacitors and rest are the resistors. The proposed filter has a simple structure and the filter's effectiveness and performance is verified using LTSpice simulations using 0.35µm standard CMOS technology and ±1.65V as Power supply.

articleTitle: Evading Firewalls & Enumerate SNMP Using Advanced NMAP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: You've been tasked with learning about a network and its systems, which you have no prior knowledge of. It's an unidentified network. You are required to locate active IP addresses, network interfaces, hosts that are actively executing apps, services, OS & their versions, or even just open or closed ports. But you have no idea at all! NMAP, sometimes known as Network Mapper, can help here. NMAP can be used for reconnaissance so that we can create our TCP packets, send them to the targets, and investigate the network and systems contained within it. When obtaining important information from target networks and systems, you can avoid firewalls and intrusion detection systems. The data gathered can also be utilised to perform penetration testing to look for weaknesses.

articleTitle: Modelling and Numerical Investigation of Graphene Assisted SIW Patch Antenna for Different Applications in X-band
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A graphene dependent microstrip patch antenna is proposed for X band claims and results are compared with perfect electrical conductor (PEC) rectangular patch antenna. The proposed device is numerically investigated using FDTD tool. The antenna is modelled on “substrate Integrated waveguide” (SIW). The proposed antenna is designed with resonant frequency of 10 GHz and achieved radiation efficiency from input power is 82.4 % with maximum directivity at resonant frequency of 6.73 dB. The device exhibits more than 3 GHz impedance bandwidth with graphene and 900 MHz with PEC as patch material. The proposed designed is compact, light cost effective and easy to fabricate for high directivity and gain.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement of Utility-Distribution System Using Reduced-Switch PV-DSTATCOM Based on Modified Unit Template Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper describes a three-phase Voltage Source Converter (VSC) based 4-switch grid-tied DSTATCOM using new Modified Unit Template Technique to achieve power quality improvement. The system under test is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3 \Phi$</tex> −3W power system to which at PCC PV-DSTATCOM is connected. The DC-Link Voltage is kept stable and voltage balancing is achieved across the split capacitors under the loading conditions. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) operated by Perturb and Observe Algorithm is used to provide the fixed power which is trapped and transformed from the PV-Array to the boost converter circuit. The model is developed in MATALB and RT-LAB software in Real-Time having Computation and Communication blocks for synchronization with OPAL-RT 4510 and to it a four-channel oscilloscope (RIGOL-MSO5204) is connected for display of the results.

articleTitle: Colon and Lung Cancer Classification of Histopathological Images Using Efficientnetb7
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The computer vision task of classifying photos of lung and colon cancer tissue samples entails recognizing and separating the two types of cancer. The deep learning model EfficientNetB7 has demonstrated encouraging outcomes in a range of image classification applications, including medical picture analysis. In this proposed model used a collection of lung and colon cancer photos to properly categorize them using the EfficientNetB7 model. The results showed that the EfficientNetB7 model correctly categorized images of lung and colon cancer with an overall accuracy of 98.49%. The model also demonstrated outstanding accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score, demonstrating its durability and capacity to generalize effectively on fresh and untested data. The findings show that EfficientNetB7 has the potential to provide accurate and timely diagnoses of lung and colon cancer, which might result in earlier identification and better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Recognition Using Integrated Lasso Based Artificial Intelligence Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Breast cancer is the most found disease in the women's which spreads throughout the body if it doesn't concentrated well. There are more technologies has been introduced earlier for the detection of breast cancer. However there is no efficient technology to find the breast cancer in the severe stage and reaches distant metastasis. In the existing work, it is done by using the various machine learning algorithms, which will predict the disease occurrence by learning the various genes associated with them by Analysing the gene structure. However those techniques are complex in nature and cannot predict the diseases in the accurate way due to its varying characteristics. These issues are resolved in the proposed methodology by introducing the method namely Lasso based Artificial Intelligence Approach (LAIA) for breast cancer Recognition which is in the distant metastasis stage. In the proposed research work, input datasets were pre-processed first which is then given as input to the LAIA method which can detect the disease more accurately. The analysis were done in the matlab simulation environment and then the comparison has been made against the various existing techniques such as adaboost and XGBoost algorithms. The metrics considered for the evaluation are accuracy, F1 Score, Positive Predictive Value, Sensitivity and AUC values. The comparison analysis proved that the proposed methodology attains better performance improvement than the existing methodologies.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design of 25W S Band Power Amplifier for RADAR Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The design process for a 25 W S-band highly efficient power amplifier is presented in this paper. The proposed amplifier design is constructed using Wilkinson power combiner which gives drain efficiency of 90.5%, PAE of 88.5% and small signal gain of 18.9dB at 2.4 GHz. The proposed design combines two 12.8W power amplifiers each which provides drain efficiency of 64.7%, PAE of 61% and small signal gain of 15.9dB. This uses Wolfspeed-CREE CGH40010F device. Using the software tool Advanced Design System (ADS), the proposed power amplifier design is simulated.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Controller Implementation for BLDC Drive Speed Control Using FOC Approach and SVPWM Based VSI Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Because of all of its advantages, the adoption of brushless DC motors has skyrocketed recently. It works quietly, is compact, has higher efficiency, needs less maintenance, and has many other advantages. When a motor is required to run at a certain speed, it's control is the key problem that has to be resolved. Sliding Mode Control (SMC), PID Controller, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Adaptive Control are few of the several techniques employed. On the other hand as Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) is less expensive to design, is robust and doesn't require a detailed description of the system to operate; so it is used for controlling speed in this paper work. By ensuring that the magnetic fields of the stator and rotor are orthogonal to one another, a technique called field-oriented control (FOC), assures a smooth response which gives control over torque and flux. The inner loop, which measures current and outer loop which measures speed, makes up FOC's two loops. The outer speed loop is replaced from a PI controller to a FLC in the proposed work. In this article, PWM signals for a three phase inverter circuit is generated using space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM). MATLAB and simulation were used to get the results.

articleTitle: Higher Order Dual Sliding Mode Controller for Position Tracking of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Higher order dual sliding mode controller is a hybrid of Terminal sliding mode controller for field oriented current control and sliding mode super twisting controller for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM). Sliding mode control (SMC) is a popular technique used for the control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs). It is a robust control method that ensures high performance in the presence of uncertainties and disturbances. This work presents the position tracking of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on higher order sliding mode control. To enhance the robustness of the control system against various environmental conditions, parameter uncertainties, and nonlinear dynamics in the stator current, a sliding mode based current controller is introduced for field-oriented control. The sliding surface is defined based on the stator current error. The control input is then designed to regulate the stator current to slide along the surface, leading to accurate control of the PMSM.

articleTitle: Green Human Resource Recommendation Algorithm Based on Lifting Tree and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, the employment problem is a social problem that needs to be solved urgently. With the rapid development of network technology, the trend of human resources networking is gradually strengthened, and human resources recommendation is facing the problem of information overload. The traditional recommendation algorithm can not better adapt to the information inflation phenomenon in the big data era. The variety of job information makes job seekers easy to fall into information review fatigue, so that they can not identify their job requirements, leading to the need to spend more energy to find the job information that is really suitable for them. Green HRR algorithm based on lifting tree and neural network. This is a new way to find the best employees for any job through artificial intelligence (AI). Artificial intelligence has been applied to many scientific fields, especially computer science. The main goal of this algorithm is to find the best employee for any job through machine learning technology called artificial neural network (ANN). The basic idea of this algorithm is that we can use artificial neural network to predict the future performance of employees and then make corresponding decisions. This process helps us identify the best candidate among all others who apply for a particular position.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Prediction Using Consumer Information and Different Machine Learning Algorithms: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Predicting financial risk is a critical task in the finance sector because it enables financial firms to evaluate the risk associated with granting credit to customers. Due to their capacity to analyze vast amounts of consumer data and generate precise forecasts, machine learning algorithms have gradually grown more popular within financial risk prediction. This presentation provides an overview of financial risk prediction while emphasizing the benefits and drawbacks of different methods. The study covers the various machine learning algorithms used for prediction, such as logistic regression, naive bayes, decision trees, random forest, XGBoost, and KNN discusses the many consumer information types utilized in financial risk prediction, such as income, credit amount, and payment history.

articleTitle: Energy Management of a Hybrid Energy Storage System during Regenerative Braking in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper focuses on the implementation of regenerative braking in an electric vehicle equipped with a brushless DC (BLDC) motor. The paper signifies the advantages of regenerative braking and discusses the control design and simulation of a hybrid energy storage system (HESS) with a new method of energy management comprising lithium battery (BT), dissipative resistor, and supercapacitor (SC) for an electric vehicle. To enable precise control over power flow, two bidirectional DC-DC converters are employed, connecting each source in parallel to the DC bus. The proposed energy management approach enables energy distribution between the BT and SC, taking into account the charge level of each source and the vehicle's operating conditions, including acceleration, deceleration, cruising on different terrains, and stops. The technique attempts to maximize supercapacitor utilization by permitting energy transfer from the BT to the SC during vehicle standstill or low load conditions. This prepares the supercapacitor for crucial conditions such as quick acceleration or climbing steep slopes. The resistor is essential for protecting the battery and the DC bus from voltage and current limits. Simulation of electric vehicle movement using the control design is verified and the effectiveness of the proposed energy management technique is assessed employing MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Hall Effect Sensors and Signal Reconstruction in BLDC Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: BLDC motors with Hall sensors are generally more affordable compared to other motor types like stepper motors or servo motors. Their simpler design and lower component count contribute to their lower cost. In most cases, three Hall sensors are commonly used in BLDC motors to detect the position of rotor. This configuration provides information about the commutation sequence and enables precise control of the motor. If one of the sensor fails, this may lead to instability or even complete failure of motor. So ensure high reliability, Fault-Tolerant Control (FTC) techniques for Hall sensors have been introduced. This paper is based on the detection of fault, identification and signal reconstruction of Hall sensor signals which is based on a simple combination of binary functions, which requires just a memory of three bit. This FTC method make sure that the BLDC motor is more reliable and will overcome false alarms that may have been caused by previous fault detection techniques. FTC algorithm ensures a long use of motor even if one of the sensors is faulty. To validate the performance of BLDC motor based on FTC, it is simulated in MATLAB/simulink environment.

articleTitle: Sound-Based Bird Recognition System using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The article is organized around a description of bird identification. Humans are only able to hear birds in such situations because they have poorer vision but excellent auditory abilities. For bird identification, this method is useful. The design of this system allows it to constantly record the birds and identify them using voice analysis. The device has a wide range of research-related applications. Studying birds is beneficial for blind individuals as well. Because sometimes people can identify a bird by its picture but not by its sound, or vice versa, these systems can also be used in the classroom to educate. Because many bird enthusiasts are interested in studying these migrating birds, the system's primary goal is to analyse birds that migrate from other continents to India. This is the main motivation behind the system's creation. No prior understanding of bird sounds is necessary for bird observation and recognition; all that is needed is a Raspberry Pi fitted with a microphone, bird identification software, etc.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Unveling Chess Algorithms Using Reinforcement Learning and Traditional Chess Approaches in AI
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the history of Artificial Intelligence, chess has been the subject of the many researches. Chess bots are now capable of beating grandmasters using reinforcement learning which is a branch of Artificial Intelligence that focuses on developing intelligent systems capable of making optimal decisions through engagement with the environment via trial-and-error. Alpha Zero, Stockfish 8, and Q-learning are the three prominent methods used in chess bots. These methods have revolutionized the field of artificial intelligence in chess, showcasing remarkable capabilities and advancements. This paper provides a comparative study of these approaches by examining the contrast in their underlying approaches, performance, training methodologies, and limitations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Supervised Machine Learning Algorithms for Liver Disease Prediction with SMOTE Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Chronic liver disease is a serious condition that involves ongoing damage to the liver, leading to impaired liver function and potentially life-threatening complications[19]. Detecting and treating this disease at an early stage is vital to prevent irreversible liver damage[2] and enhance patient outcomes. This study aims to compare the effectiveness of various Machine Learning algorithms with SMOTE in diagnosing chronic liver disease[20]. The algorithms evaluated in this study include Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, MLP, and other boosting algorithms like Adaboost, CatBoost, etc.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Modulation Techniques for Advanced Controller of Integrated Starter Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a significant increase in the demand for hybrid vehicles. A crucial technology used in modern hybrid vehicles is the Integrated Starter Generator (ISG), which plays a vital role in enhancing the electrical generation capacity and contributing to the fuel efficiency and emission advantages of hybrid electric propulsion. The design of an ISG presents several challenges due to the conflicting requirements of high starting torque and field-weakening capability across a broad range of speeds. Currently, there are two types of ISGs in use: belt-driven ISGs and direct-crankshaft ISGs. Both types offer advantages over traditional separate starter and generator systems. The belt-driven ISG configuration involves connecting the ISG via a belt between the engine and the gearbox. On the other hand, the direct-crankshaft ISG is mounted behind the engine, with separate components such as the clutch or torque converter. This design eliminates the cost and complexity associated with belt-driven constructions. Field-Oriented Control (FOC) based on the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) is a commonly employed method for ISGs. FOC enables precise control over the torque and flux of the PMSM, ensuring efficient operation. In this study, two modulation techniques, Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) and Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) are compared for speed control and settling characteristics.

articleTitle: Light Weight ResNet for Detection of Wheat Yellow Rust over Mobile Captured Images from Wheat Fields
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Plant diseases act as a major threat to small-scale farmers as they lead to major destruction in the overall food supply. In this, yellow rust disease of wheat is a major cause of concern in wheat producing countries. To provide effective measures for detection and avoidance of the destruction of the yellow rust an early identification is required. Plant disease identification from the images is an interesting research in agriculture and computer fields. The data was collected using the mobile phones and GPS meter from wheat fields of humid subtropical parts of Haryana (India). A total of 10000 images were used in the machine learning program out of which 5000 images from 2022 dataset and 5000 images from 2023 dataset. The dataset consist two categories of healthy and yellow rust images. The ResNet, is a popular deep learning method, was applied to detect the yellow rust disease of wheat. The result of 2022 dataset shows the training accuracy as 98.80% and the test accuracy as 93.19% and the result of 2023 dataset shows the training accuracy as 99.69% and the test accuracy as 99.10%.

articleTitle: Power System Control Method Based on Fuzzy Theory and Lawson Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of system control in the power system is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate result testing. The conventional mode cannot solve the power system control problem in Lawson's algorithm, and the calculation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a fuzzy theory to analyze innovative power system control. Firstly, the Lawson algorithm is used to evaluate the power system control, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the power system control method to reduce the power system control in the interfering factor. Then, the fuzzy theory forms a power system control scheme for the power system control, and synthesizes the power system control results Analyze. MATLAB simulation shows that the accuracy and time of Lawson's algorithm for power system control are better than those of conventional power system control under certain evaluation criteria Mode.

articleTitle: Implementing Logical Shifters: For Funtionality Testing and Performance of Power Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Digital shifters convert one digital code to another, or move bits from one register to another, using digital logic circuits. Based on D flip-flops as a basic building block, the present paper devises a bi-directional shifter that operates at the positive edges of the flip-flop (positive edge-triggered). The proposed shifter is able to shift a data bit in both directions, to the left and to the right, depending on the control signals. The shifter also has a synchronous reset control and is able to shift multiple bits in parallel. We have produced a D flip-flop using a gated master-slave D latch to accomplish our goal. The results of our Using two different load capacitances, it was possible to determine the propagation delay as well as the power of the source (VDD), in accordance with the results of this study, along with the short circuit current, switching current, instantaneous power, and average power of the shifter. We also observed a reduction in the propagation delay as the load capacitance increased. Finally, we concluded that the design of the D flip-flop was successful in meeting our goal. The oscillation frequency was kept constant throughout the testing, ensuring the integrity of the results. Overall, the design achieved the desired performance with a significant reduction in the propagation delay.

articleTitle: Prediction Model for Stock using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Stock market is one of the important aspects that come into picture when one wants to talk about the country's economy. So in this case study the stock values are gathered i.e., the high, low, open, close prices at the end of the day for company Tesla from dated 29<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> June 2010 to 25<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Nov 2019. In this study an attempt has been made to predict the stock value that the company can have in a particular day. To do this, simple linear regression model is being used and Price of the stock has been predicted.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Multiphysics Simulation Workloads on Cloud Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This work presents a performance analysis of multiphysics simulation workloads using the LS-DYNA application on Amazon Web Services cloud infrastructure. The study aims to evaluate the impact of various factors on simulation performance and provide insights into optimizing the cloud environment for such workloads. By comparing different instance types, including general-purpose, compute-optimized, and HPC-optimized instances based on both Intel and AMD processors, the research identifies the most suitable options for achieving efficient and cost-effective execution of multiphysics simulations. The results highlight the superior performance of HPC-optimized instances, both Intel and AMD, indicating their suitability for demanding simulations. Furthermore, the analysis showcases the HPC-optimized AMD instance as a cost-effective alternative, striking a balance between performance and price. These findings contribute to the understanding of cloud-based multiphysics simulations and offer practical guidance for optimizing cloud infrastructure for LS-DYNA workloads, emphasizing the importance of thoughtful resource selection to enhance computational performance in the cloud.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of Quadratic Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Power electronic systems are circuits that switch to process power cyclically. Their function is to transform irregular input power into controlled output power. Various types of converters are used, depending on the input and output voltages. In DC switching-mode power supply and electrical DC motor drives, DC-DC converters are employed. Power factor correction circuits employ AC-to-DC rectifiers. DC-to-AC inverters are used in uninterruptible power supply and electrical AC motor drives. AC-to-AC cycloconverters, on the other hand, are used to convert frequencies from one level to another. In industrial applications, power electronics help productivity and product quality improvement. With the advancement of technology, the cost decreases, the size becomes compact, and the device's performance improves. Again, power electronics are increasingly essential in renewable energy generation, utility system energy storage, and electric vehicles. In this, we have designed and evaluated the Quadratic Buck Converter which is characterized by a voltage conversion ratio that is equivalent to the square of the duty cycle. Due to its ability to achieve significant voltage step-down, the QBC finds substantial application in DC-DC converters, particularly in areas where a significant reduction in voltage is needed, such as in modern automobiles. The simulation results of QBC and conventional Buck Converter are compared to verify the accuracy of the obtained model.

articleTitle: Security Issues in Centralized Spectrum Allocation in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The issue of unused spectrum can be resolved by using Cognitive Radio (CR) technologies. The allotment of vacant free spectrum to unlicensed users is a fundamental function in Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs). Assuming users have fair intentions, a number of successful resource assignment schemes have been put out in the past. Malicious users, however, have the potential to negatively affect resource allocation and, as a result, seriously harm the network's performance as a whole. In this study, we discuss the vulnerabilities that may occur in CRN spectrum allocation as a result of a Network Endo-Parasite Attack (NEPA), in which the malignant node alters its interfaces to densely loaded channels, i.e., highly used channels.
