Using simulation-based studies, we analyse and evaluate the effects of NEPA with different performance measures and also compare with Channel Ecto-Parasite Attack (CEPA) attack.

articleTitle: Parallel Finite Element Algorithm Based on PVM and its Implementation in Geotechnical Engineering Software
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of PVM network in network construction is very important, but there are problems of inaccurate data transmission time and data transmission amount. The common centralized network management mode cannot solve the PVM network problem in network construction, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, a finite element algorithm is proposed for better PVM network analysis. Firstly, the long-tail theory is used to evaluate the channel, and the communication security level and network scale are divided according to the requirements of the PVM network, and the reduction is reduced Interference factors in PVM networks. Then, the long-tail theory optimizes the data transmission accuracy, data transmission amount, and data transmission time of the PVM network to form the PVM network and comprehensive analysis of PVM network results. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the parallel network compatibility of finite element algorithm to PVM network The data transmission volume and data transmission time are better than the centralized network management mode.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm and its Application in Parameter Identification of Generator Set Speed Regulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: As one of the main systems for the control of generator sets, the regulation quality and dynamic characteristics of generator speed regulation system not only affect the economy and safety of the unit itself. The voltage recovery method only obtains the parameters of the generator set speed regulation system from the perspective of physical significance, ignores the influencing factors of the actual environment, and is easy to produce unstable parameter results. Therefore, this paper proposes a particle swarm improvement algorithm based on culture algorithm to identify the parameter values of the generator set speed regulation system. Firstly, based on the PMU data, the systematic deviation of the measurement data is taken as the value of the data to be identified, and the process of unified identification with other system parameters is carried out. Secondly, in order to obtain the optimal prediction value of system parameter identification, the particle swarm algorithm is improved based on the cultural algorithm, and the formal knowledge and normative knowledge in the cultural knowledge belief space are used to optimize the particle population, and the excellent particle individual information and particle population information are effectively retained, which improves the speed and stability of the algorithm for the parameter identification of the generator set speed regulation system. The MATLAB simulation results show that the particle swarm optimization algorithm identifies the parameters of the speed regulation system under the condition that the identification parameters are uniform Be better and better.

articleTitle: Comparison of Regeneration Efficiency Employing DC Shunt Motor and Three Phase Induction Motor in Hybrid Powered Railway System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The current railway system has a 25 kV voltage rating for single-phase AC supply. This single phase is converted into three phase voltage supply for three phase induction motor and DC source of 600 volt or 1500-volt DC voltage supply for DC series motor. The use of supercapacitor in train engines become beneficial for a microgrid connected railway stations having distance between two stations within the range of 45 to 55 km. Supercapacitors can be employed to store and release the electrical energy efficiently during regenerative braking, where the kinetic energy of the moving train is converted back into electrical energy. This energy can then be stored in supercapacitor for later use. This paper proposes design of railway station integrated to PV and wind sources, supercapacitor and batteries for energy storage system (ESS) in order to increase the utilization rate of the regenerative braking energy (RBE). Initially the motor employed in a hybrid powered railway system was DC shunt motor. This work compares the regeneration efficiency of a hybrid powered railway system when the rotating motor is now switched to a three-phase induction motor. The developed control model results are verified with the simulations in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Prediction of Solar Power Generation Using NWP and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: For effective use of renewable energy sources, accurate forecasting of solar power output is crucial. This study investigates how machine learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Neural Networks (NN), Linear Regression (LR), and Decision Trees and Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) are used to forecast solar power generation based on climatic variables, historical power generation data, and other relevant aspects. The models' accuracy in predicting solar power generation could be determined by analyzing them using metrics like Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). The results advance our understanding of the potential of machine learning approaches for precisely forecasting solar power generation, promoting effective energy management, and encouraging the integration of renewable energy sources into grid.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is an irreparable neurodegenerative disease. It impairs memory and thinking, while the aggregate brain size shrinks and is seen to affect the human brain at the age of sixty and above. An early diagnosis of AD can result in high chances of reducing its occurrence amongst the elderly. The conventional approach to detecting Alzheimer's is costly and often error-prone. Human diagnosis reliability suffers from fatigue, cognitive biases, system faults, and destructions. However, Artificial Intelligence (AI) based diagnosis systems are less error-prone. This work proposes to explore four Machine Learning algorithms for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease and its possible early-stage i.e., Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). ML algorithms are applied to the OASIS dataset of the Kaggle repository to find the highest output in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of Virtual Test Environment for Vehicle Level Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A virtual test bench setup deployment is described in this work. This involves doing virtual validation to manage the complexity of new technologies in modern automobiles. By creating virtual test simulation setup on PC, the design and behavior of new systems can be analyzed in detail. This paper introduces a proposed tool-chain that specifically aims to develop a virtual environment for testing and validating Electronic Control Units (ECUs) in the automotive industry, based on the AUTOSAR standard. The main objective of this paper is to implement an automated test environment for BMS ECUs using dSPACE tools and with deploying this data on the cloud to scale up the simulation for multiple users. This environment enables the monitoring and testing of various parameters. The expected outcome of this implementation is a significant reduction in man hours by 50% and the results obtained from the testing are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Automated Guided Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Rapidly-exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) algorithm is a popular and effective motion planning approach in robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). The RRT* algorithm's essential characteristics, benefits, and applications are highlighted in this paper. The paper begins by introducing the problem of motion planning in robotic systems and the need for efficient algorithms to generate collision-free paths in complex environments. It then introduces the RRT* algorithm as a solution to this problem, emphasizing its ability to quickly explore the configuration space and find optimal or near-optimal paths. The core ideas behind the RRT* algorithm is explained in the paper, along with the notions of rapidly exploring trees, planning based on random sampling, and incremental tree growth. It illustrates the fundamental distinctions between RRT* and the RRT algorithm, such as the application of cost-to-come measures and rewiring strategies to enhance the optimality of the created pathways.

articleTitle: EcoRoute: Ecosystem of Electric Vehicle by Optimizing Route for Long-Distance Travel
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) owners in India are facing dissatisfaction due to the limited availability and reliability of charging infrastructure. One of the main concerns is the inadequate range of EVs, which creates difficulties for long-distance travel. For instance, if a user needs to travel inter-statefor 1000 km but their EV's range is limited to 350 km, they need to stop multiple times at charging stations to complete the trip. Unlike traditional petrol or gasoline-based cars, EVs require a considerable amount of recharge, meaning users must manuallyplan their charging stops and search for available charging stations. This problem statement highlights the challenge of ensuring that EVs are viable and convenient for long-distance travel in India, where the availability and accessibility of charging infrastructure remain a significant concern. These issues can be resolved by eliminating human intervention in the route planning process of any trip. To minimize human interference an algorithm is required that can generate a route plan for long-distance travel based on the real-time stats of the electric vehicle. Various parameters need to be considered to optimize the travel route, and to minimize the overall travel time by reducing the total charging time in between.

articleTitle: Smart Stethoscope for Remote Healthcare Monitoring Using IoT: A Cost-Effective Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Worldwide, the major cause of death is Cardiac Dysfunction, which can be detected through heart sounds. Acoustic stethoscopes are one of the oldest methods of auscultation. An ordinary acoustics-based stethoscope is limited in providing high-quality sound in noisy environments. This paper addresses the problem of cost-effectively making a smart stethoscope using modern electronics and computing technologies for cardiac auscultation. Along with that, to have telemedicine involved with the utmost accuracy possible. A signal conditioning circuit is designed to process the auscultation signals measured by a condenser microphone using a Preamplifier, a High pass filter, a Low Pass Filter, and an Op-Amp Subtractor. An ESP32 development board is used to convert the signal to digital format and transmit the signal through Bluetooth to an Android application to visualize signals. The smart stethoscope is designed to record and transmit real-time heart sounds to healthcare professionals while considering cost-effectiveness and portability. In the future, we can use the recorded signals to predict cardiac disorders using Deep learning models.

articleTitle: Protection Circuits for Optimal Battery Management of Battery Electric Vehicle Scooters
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper focuses on a decentralized battery management system (BMS) of a 3.97 kWh or a 2.98 kWh lithium-ion battery pack with a claimed range of 181 km and 121 km respectively for electric vehicle (EV) scooters, which is important and necessary to guarantee the lithium-ion battery pack performance in EV scooter applications. The proposed BMS will include a mode control dashboard, State of Charge (SOC) estimation, current limiter, thermal control unit, and battery protection logic unit. Since the high cost of Lithium-ion battery packs is one of the main important factors which must be considered when installing the BMS. This paper proposes a BMS which is less costly, easy to install, reliable, and has high precision.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Model Using LSTM: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Due to its potential use in financial markets, stock price prediction is a difficult issue that has drawn considerable interest from academics and business executives. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) have demonstrated promising results in time series prediction applications, such as stock price prediction. In this paper, we examine both univariate and multivariate LSTM-based stock price prediction models. We compare the forecasting accuracy of these models using a variety of assessment criteria in order to measure their performance on a real-world stock price dataset. Additionally, we look into how different hyperparameters, such as batch size, learning rate, and the quantity of hidden layers, affect how well LSTM models perform. Finally, we talk about the interpretability, limitations, and prospective uses of LSTM-based stock price prediction models in practical financial decision-making scenarios.

articleTitle: Output Estimation of the Solar PV Plant Using System Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: System identification is a method of estimating the behavior of a system by analyzing input and output data. System identification techniques can be applied to estimate the output of a solar PV plant, considering different input parameters, such as solar radiation, temperature, and humidity. The first step in using system identification to estimate the output of a solar PV plant is to collect data on the input parameters and the corresponding output of the plant. Once the data has been collected, it can be analyzed using various system identification techniques such as Nonlinear ARX, Hammerstein Wiener, and Correlation models. These techniques can be used to develop a mathematical model of the plant that relates the input parameters to the output. If the model accurately predicts the plant's production, we can use it to estimate the plant's output. System identification is a powerful tool to evaluate the production of a solar PV plant based on input parameters such as solar radiation, temperature, and humidity. By accurately predicting the plant's output, system identification can help optimize the operation of the plant and improve its overall performance.

articleTitle: Unveiling Risk Factors of Knee Osteoarthritis: A Novel Approach of Integrating Sample Survey Insights using Statistical and Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This survey is aimed to identify risk factors associated with knee osteoarthritis (KOA) among various occupational categories in Pune and surrounding regions. The survey was conducted using multiple media platforms, including email, face-to-face interviews, and telephonic conversations, to ensure broad participation. Statistical analysis based on Confidence Intervals, Chi-square tests, and Spearman's correlation coefficient revealed significant risk factors of knee OA among various parameters such as gender, age, BMI, followed by subcategories of occupational activities, knee movement activities, and functionality. In addition, machine learning algorithms, such as Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers, were employed to find the probable association between knee pathological parameters and knee pain. The SVM (RBF) model demonstrated higher prediction accuracy of 88% compared to the RF model. One notable finding of this study is that individuals engaged in regular sports activities showed a reduced risk of knee pain. The identification of the impact of age, BMI on OA development, the influence of prolonged standing, and heavy physical work on knee pain have significant implications for preventive measures underscore the importance of early detection, appropriate workplace modifications, and promoting regular physical activity to lower the burden of knee OA.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Obesity Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Obesity has plagued the world in recent years and is a serious health issue in the modern times. There are various parameters that have led to this epidemic like lifestyle changes. We have hence conducted a study to determine how well three different machine learning algorithms can predict obesity in adults. Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and OneR are the algorithms used in this study. The different parameters we have used are Precision, F1 score, Accuracy, Recall and the Area under the operating curve (AUC) to compare them. They were used to assess how well the algorithms performed. In conclusion, when compared to the One-R and Naive Bayes algorithms, the Random Forest algorithm is the most accurate and trustworthy algorithm for predicting adult obesity. The findings of this study may aid medical practitioners in identifying people who are at risk of becoming obese and in establishing preventative strategies to lower the likelihood of obesity-related health issues.

articleTitle: Color and Texture Based Similarity Search to Enable Secure Image Sharing on Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Image retrieval plays a significant role in various fields, with applications in medicine and healthcare, e-commerce, art and culture, and social media. This study proposes a novel method for image retrieval that utilizes both texture and color information. Color techniques such as Color histogram, moments, layouts, and Color correlogram, whereas texture features such as GLCM, Gabor filters, LBP, and Wavelet Transform, have been tested and compared based on their retrieval time and similarity score. The average of Dot Similarity, Kendall's Tau, Cosine Similarity, Spearman's, and Pearson Correlation scores is used to determine the final similarity score. The tests performed on the Flickr30k dataset show that the suggested strategy can locate the top three feature-matching images. The study's feature fusion highlights how these techniques can improve image retrieval performance. Apart from image retrieval, this paper also uses a technique to embed user IDs with uploaded images to notify users when another user uploads an image that resembles them. The suggested method can increase the precision and effectiveness of image retrieval in various areas, including e-commerce, medicine and healthcare, surveillance and security, education, digital libraries, art and culture, and social media.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Decision Tree Algorithm in College Employment Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The role of employment guidance in employment management is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate outcome evaluation. The didactic teaching model cannot solve the problem of employment guidance in employment management, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved decision tree method to optimize employment guidance analysis. First, the multiple intelligence theory is used to evaluate students, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of employment guidance to reduce employment guidance in the interfering factor. Then, the multiple intelligence theory optimizes the employment guidance for students, forms the employment guidance program, and conducts the employment guidance results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the employment rate and internship rate of improved decision tree method for students' career guidance are improved All are superior to the didactic teaching mode.

articleTitle: Landslide Susceptibility Detection Using ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Landslides, one of the most common natural disasters in the world, have caused numerous deaths, infrastructure damage, and monetary losses. In the past, scientists have employed a variety of techniques to predict landslide susceptibility. Unfortunately, there is currently a lack of the most precise algorithm that may be utilized to create a landslide susceptibility model. Therefore, the objective of the current work is to assess how well three distinct machine learning techniques—CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), KNN (K-Nearest neighbor), and ResNet (Residual Neural Network)—can predict landslide susceptibility. In this study, training datasets (70% of the total) and testing datasets (30% of the total) were randomly separated into 19 elements like photos, topographical data, and geological data related to past landslide locations etc. For susceptibility modeling, the following factors were taken into consideration: Additional aspects to take into account include soil texture, lithology, land use/cover, slope aspect, topographic moisture index, proximity to roads, streams, and lineaments, convergence index, profile, and plan curvatures. According to the experimental findings, these two machine learning models accuracy is greater than 0.95. The results show that the suggested technique performs with 98 percent accuracy when using the Resnet-50 model and 96 percent accuracy when using the CNN model. Additionally, it should be highlighted that ResNet performs better than CNN in terms of estimating the likelihood of a landslide occurring, but CNN outperformed less accurate. The suggested ResNet model is reliable and suitable for use in the study area's future hazard reduction and land use planning.

articleTitle: Multirate Filtered OFDM Waveform for 5G and Beyond Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: F-OFDM has better performance and is more suitable for low power low cost IoT applications in 5G/6G. Normal F-OFDM suffers from high computational complexity when compared with multirate F-OFDM. Performance analysis based on mathematical modelling and Matlab simulations of multirate F-OFDM has been carried out. Matlab simulations and mathematical modelling has been carried out to analyze effect of ACI, ISI, and ICI. It has been observed that multirate filtered OFDM has better performance than simple filtered OFDM. The multirate F-OFDM has reduced complexity than normal F-OFDM and is suitable for the next generation communication systems.

articleTitle: Automated Solar Panel Cleaning and Monitoring Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Solar PV is an emerging technology for the electricity energy and when it comes to environmental efficient energy generation. The natural sources like Sun has a huge potential radiation, solar energy is one of the most substantial and biggest sources of energy. In the modern world, solar energy is one of the most exciting, promising clean technologies because it emits no carbon. To harness the solar power generation it is essential to pay attention to its upkeep. Just like the solar panels are installed in open yards sand, dust particles and bird droppings accumulating on solar panel, it causes reduction in power output. Lifespan of solar panels are drastically reduced without proper cleaning due to aggregation of energy loss over time and occurrence of hot spots. To address this issue, automated solar panel cleaning and monitoring robots have emerged as a promising solution IoT technology. Hence it is required to design and develop a solar panel monitoring and cleaning system to gather and analyse solar energy data in order to forecast performance and ensure effective power production. By using this cleaning system process can be done timer based as well as cleaning process can be initiated by giving command through proposed application on just one click from anywhere at any time.

articleTitle: Performance Analogy of Autoencoders for Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Image Denoising is one of the current day challenges in the field of image processing. Noise in the image is the existence of artifacts that do not start from the original picture content. Autoencoders have made considerable progress in image denoising because of their ability to reconstruct image inputs. Autoencoders for denoising images usually accepts a degraded image as input and is trained to predict the reconstructed image as its output. An effort has been made to analyse the functioning of selected autoencoders for image denoising, such as Basic Autoencoder, Denoising Autoencoder and Convolutional Denoising Autoencoder using the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology database (MNIST) dataset. The performance of these models is evaluated and compared using Structural Similarity Index Measure, Peak Signal to Noise Ratio evaluation metrics. The strengths and weaknesses of each autoencoder are discussed and the factors that influence their performance are explored. Qualitative and quantitative analysis of the dataset provides an insight of effectiveness and efficiency of each autoencoder in denoising images. Observations show that Convolutional Denoising Autoencoder out-performs other autoencoders in terms of the evaluation metrics and better reconstructed image. This study can act as a base for researchers and practitioners to identify suitable autoencoders for denoising images in real-life applications.

articleTitle: A Polarization Reconfigurable Equilateral Triangular Microstrip Antenna (ETMA) for 5G-NR Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A novel polarization reconfigurable inset feed based Equilateral Triangular Microstrip Antenna (ETMA) design is presented for 5G mobile communication. In this design, the ETMA achieves both circular and linear polarization radiation by modifying the triangular patch through the truncation of its corners using a single PIN diode. During ON configuration, the proposed ETMA design with the single PIN diode exhibits linear polarization at the resonant frequency of 1.85 GHz, providing a gain of 0.4 dB. In the OFF configuration, it offers circular polarization with a gain of 0.21 dB. This versatile antenna design holds promise for applications in 5G NR (n-98) based mobile communication.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Outer Rotor Ceiling Fan Single Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Recently in 2016, the domestic industry taken into account 24% of overall energy usage in Asia. This quantity is anticipated to more than eightfold by 2050, owing mainly to appliances and gear. Ceiling fans tend to be among the products to Contribute for the exponential growth in energy usage. In 2015, India made over 40 million fans and a 10 percent rise year on year is being recorded. Major electric devices are getting to be more power efficient. Ceiling Fans are a definite popular and important among such electrical devices. The fan is among the feasible energy consumption applications worldwide. Reducing the power consumption of these causes a lot fewer carbon-di-oxide emissions and reduced power usage. The goal of this is to go for the powerful design of a single-phase induction motor (SPIM) for roof fan applications. Moreover it determines the important single-phase induction motor design qualities for an exterior rotor configuration. The inaccuracy difficulties at the equivalent circuit way of such low wattage application are examined, along side experimental validation utilising several comparable circuit methodologies. Moreover, the finite element Analysis (FEA) technique is utilized for accurate SPIM design. Future options to minimise energy usage tend to be pointed out within the summary section.

articleTitle: Automated Landslide Event Archive Generation from News Articles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Landslides are a type of natural disaster characterised by ground movements in the form of rockfalls, debris falls, mud-flow and slope failures. It is one of the primary natural disaster and has been studied since as early as 1807<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>https://shorturl.at/nvxAJ. Disaster management is a stream of research in Information Technology, Political Science, Legal and Ethical Studies, Geology and so on which has garnered a lot of attention in the recent past. A primary dependency of such research is on archival data related to landslides. As a part of this work, a novel framework for generating landslide archive is proposed. The source of this data archive are online news articles from dependable news publishers. The data archive contains comprehensive information about the date, location, severity, and meteorological causes for landslides. The end-to-end framework contains a user-friendly web interface for running easy, concise, and customisable queries with near real-time responses.

articleTitle: Design of Voltage Controlled Oscillator Based On Active Inductor For RF Receiver Front End
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: For high frequency applications active inductor based designs are preferred because they take up less space than conventional inductors. In this paper the design of a voltage-controlled oscillator with an active inductor which can be used for RF receiver front end is presented. A Voltage controlled oscillator implemented using an active inductor with a high operating frequency is shown in this work. This design can be used to generate a carrier signal at the front end of an RF receiver. Cadence virtuoso is used to simulate a VCO based on an active inductor utilising UMC 180nm technology. Cadence Virtuoso's Spectre RF is used to run postlayout simulations. This voltage-controlled oscillator has a tuning range of 912 MHz to 2.14 GHz, making it appropriate for the design of multi-band transceivers. The phase noise measured at a frequency range of 1 MHz is −91.43 dBc/Hz. VCO occupies a low area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$62.4 \times 53.5 \mu\ m^{2}$</tex>. The constructed VCO's simulation results can be compared to other designs present in the literature.

articleTitle: Combining CNN and SVM for Accurate Identification of Ridge Gourd Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study proposes a method for identifying and classifying ridge gourd leaf illnesses using a network of convolutional neural networks (CNN) models. Two layers using convolution, two maximally combined layers, and one completely linked layer are included in the proposed model. The goal is to forecast the existence of five diseases in the ridge gourd leaves: Powdery Mildew, Downy Fibre Mildew, Anthracnose, Bacteria Leaf Spot, and Cucumbers Mosaic Virus. For training and evaluation, a large dataset of gourd ridge leaf photos labeled with illness classifications is used. The CNN model uses its capacity to collect and extract key information from input photos to accurately classify and predict diseases. The results show that the proposed approach is effective, with high accuracy in diagnosing specific diseases. This study provides important insights into the early detection and handling of ridge gourd leaves diseases, which will be useful to farmers and researchers. By diagnosing and addressing these diseases as soon as possible, farmers can undertake focused prevention and control methods, enhancing crop health, decreasing yield losses, and assuring sustainable agricultural practices. The suggested CNN model provides a low-cost and efficient approach for automated illness detection, removing the need for inspection by humans and expert assistance. This model's excellent classification for the ridge gourd illnesses of the leaves has considerable promise for optimizing agricultural practices and boosting yields in the environment of ridges gourd farming.

articleTitle: Lotus Disease Diagnosis Using Combined CNN and SVM with Max Pooling and Convolutional Layers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study presents an evaluation of a classification model employing convolutional neural network (CNN) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms for the identification of various diseases in lotus plants. The model's performance is assessed using precision, recall, F1-score, support, and accuracy metrics for each disease class. The results demonstrate the model's effectiveness in accurately distinguishing between different diseases. For instance, Leaf Spot achieves a precision of 93.97%, recall of 91.60%, F1-score of 92.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and support of 595 instances, with an overall accuracy of 97%. Similar high-performance metrics are observed for Rust, Pythium Root Rot, Leaf Blight, Stem Rot, and Lotus Mosaic Virus classes, showcasing the model's robustness. The weighted average metrics, considering class distribution, yield precision, recall, and F1-score values around 92.86%. The macro average indicates an overall average performance across all classes, while the micro average reveals a precision and recall of 92.85%. These findings validate the efficiency and reliability of the CNN and SVM model in accurately identifying and managing lotus leaf diseases, thus contributing to crop health monitoring and disease management in lotus plantations.

articleTitle: Evolving Agritech: Implementing Federated Learning & CNN for Parsley Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study investigates a unique approach that combines federated learning with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to identify illnesses of the parsley leaf. It illustrates the effectiveness of using decentralised data among several clients to produce highly effective, reliable models while protecting data privacy. The empirical results show improved model performance for six illness classes (Class_A through Class_F) and four customers (Cl_a, Cl_b, Cl_c, and Cl_d), with precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy typically above 95%. For instance, in the regional analysis, Client B attained impressive accuracy and recall of 97.39% and 97.85% for Class_F, suggesting little to no false positives or negatives for this class. In the overall study, the federated learning average results show similarly impressive results, such as Client B, which produced precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy values of 96.45%, 96.31%, and 99%. The little differences between local and global metrics demonstrate federated learning's resilience, which successfully maintains high performance in the face of data decentralisation. Macro, micro, and weighted averages, which provide subtle hints about the model's performance across various classes and data distributions, are also explored in this study. For example, Client D showed a macro-average precision of 95.47%, a micro-average precision of 95.35%, a weighted average precision of 95.41%, and an accuracy of 99%, demonstrating the model's consistency in effectiveness under various circumstances. The findings show the value of federated learning as a decentralised, privacy-preserving, and high-performing disease detection method in parsley crops. Thus, this study contributes substantially to creating tech-driven, sustainable solutions for agriculture, potentially benefiting farmers worldwide, especially those in India.

articleTitle: Dissecting Parsley Leaf Disease Severity: A Federated Learning and CNN Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model in conjunction with a Federated Learning (FL) framework to thoroughly investigate the identification of parsley leaf diseases. Four local datasets representing four customers and five different degrees of parsley leaf disease severity were used to evaluate the approach. Precision, recall, F1-Score, and accuracy measures were used to assess the model's performance. The model performed well for all customers in the local results and analysis, with an accuracy hovering around 0.98. The highest severity level often had the most excellent accuracy, recall, and F1-Score, indicating skill in spotting the worst parsley leaf infections. For example, Client 1 obtained precision, recall, and F1-Score values for severity levels 1-20% of 96.48%, 96.33%, and 96.41 %, respectively. The model showed good performance across customers, with accuracy ratings close to 0.98 in the area devoted to overall outcomes. The F1-Scores, which measure how healthy recall outperforms precision, were generally high among clients; Client 1 had an F1-Score of 95.73 %, for instance. Finally, the global averages section shows high-performance metrics for all averaging techniques. Precision, recall, F1-Score, and accuracy scores for the macro average were 95.73%, 93.98%, 94.83%, and 94.94%, respectively. Precision and accuracy were consistently close to 95% for both the weighted and micro averages, which showed comparable results. In conclusion, our study confirmed the value of using a CNN and federated learning strategy to identify illnesses in parsley leaves. High precision, recall, F1-Score, and accuracy are all shown in the findings, proving the model's dependability and robustness. The research confirms that our federated learning approach has the potential to be a helpful tool for farmers in controlling parsley leaf diseases, hence improving agricultural practices and enhancing food security.

articleTitle: Emerging Paradigms: A Federated Learning CNN Approach for Tomato Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study examines how a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model based on federated learning may be used to categorize tomato leaf diseases. Four customers from each of the five classes-four representing the four tomato leaf illnesses and one representing the healthy class-are included in the research. Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and Accuracy are the metrics used to assess the model's performance. With overall accuracies ranging between 98% and 99%, the data show consistently strong performance across all customers and courses. Most Precision, Recall, and F1-Score values are over 94%, demonstrating the model's ability to accurately identify healthy and diseased tomato leaf pictures with few misclassifications. In all three averaging techniques (Macro average, Weighted average, and Micro average), Client 2 regularly surpasses the other clients, demonstrating its better performance in the categorization job. This study emphasizes how federated learning may be used to build reliable and precise models for categorizing tomato leaf diseases while maintaining data privacy. It is clear from the consistent results across all customers and classes that this strategy may be used in the agricultural industry and other privacy-sensitive industries. The findings provide insightful information for further study and practical federated learning applications in comparable settings. This study offers a CNN model for categorising tomato leaf diseases based on federated learning. This study highlights the potential of federated learning in developing reliable and accurate models for categorising tomato leaf disease while maintaining data privacy.

articleTitle: A Novel Q-Learning Optimization Approach for Flight Path Prediction in Asian Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The domains of logistics and transportation have long been interested in the optimization of flight paths between cities. This research aims to use Skyscanner data to estimate the optimal flight path between 42 Asian destination cities using Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques, notably Q-learning. RL is a great strategy for addressing the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) connected to aircraft route optimization because of the distinctive reward structure it provides. The main objective of the proposed research is to create a model that learns to suggest aircraft routes based on factors such as cost, time, and number of intermediate points that maximize benefits. The proposed research work incorporates a novel Q-learning approach for training an RL agent to predict optimal flight paths. The proposed research work showcases the power-fullness of Q-Learning based RL agents in suggesting optimal flight routes and lays the groundwork for future developments in this research domain. The proposed algorithm provides useful information for tourists and business people looking for accurate and affordable flight path forecasts in the Asian region. The various performance metrics such as Reward Accumulation(RA), Episode Length(EL), and Exploration and Exploitation evaluates the proposed model performance and yields an optimal solution.

articleTitle: The Application of CNN Algorithm in COVID-19 Disease Prediction Utilising X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent times, COVID-19 has emerged as important threat to researchers, healthcare professionals, & governments globally, offering issues from identification to treatment. The epidemic has led to extensive lockdowns, & efforts are being made by researchers to develop ways to prevent the spread the infection. The strategy that is frequently utilized is the analysis of lung pictures obtained from CT & X-ray scans. This method can be time-consuming& requires the skill of several radiologists to thoroughly review each report. To overcome this difficulty, we provide nCOVnet, a unique technique that quickly& precisely detects COVID-19 from chest X-ray images using deep learning neural networks. This strategy finds visual indicators unique to COVID-19 patients in radiographic imaging, providing a quick& accurate way for illness screening.

articleTitle: Mitigating the Impact of Guava Leaf Diseases Using CNNs and Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Farmers may suffer considerable financial losses due to guava leaf infections, notably in India, where guava planting is common. This study uses federated learning and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to categorize and diagnose guava leaf diseases at five severity levels. A framework comprising five clients has been used to guarantee a varied and inclusive data representation. Each client represents a distinct severity degree of guava leaf disease. Utilizing local data from each customer, the performance of the created model is assessed. The model demonstrated exceptional precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy outcomes. The accuracy measures continuously remained over 95%, with precision values ranging from 91.25% to 96.79%, recall from 90.83% to 96.87%, and F1-scores from 86.90% to 96.83%. Additionally, the model's overall performance, as determined by federated averaging, showed outstanding values for accuracy, recall, and F1-score, ranging from 89.43% to 94.09%, 89.74% to 94.18%, and 89.56% to 94.13%, respectively. These numbers demonstrate the model's ability to generalize well from various datasets, with astounding accuracy exceeding 96%. Additionally, macro, weighted, and micro averages were used to examine the overall performance. The weighted averages varied from 90.59% to 94.38%, the micro averages from 90.57% to 94.38%, and the macro averages for all customers fell between 89.57% and 94.13%. The promise of federated learning and CNNs as effective methods for controlling and treating agricultural diseases is highlighted in this research. This will help farmers increase crop productivity and ensure food security.

articleTitle: Role of IoT in Building Smart Healthcare Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Internet of Things is an emerging technology. It is a combination of, software, physical objects and computing devices that interact with each other and then gather medically related information and upload this data to cloud storage which is helpful in disease detection and some cases for diagnosis. In today's life, IoT for healthcare has become more popular because of self-life security. The risk of an uncertain death rate is decreased by implementing the health sector's IoT infrastructure. IoT infrastructure used for healthcare has big achievements in monitoring the health of infants, toddlers, the elderly and immobilized patients. Because in most cases the patient dies because they did not know about their diseases. And now the lifestyle of the people is changing every day. The aim of this review is to summaries scenario of the IoT infrastructure being used in healthcare and to explore the implication.

articleTitle: Genome Sequence Identification Using Neural Network for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The disease that strikes women the most commonly worldwide is breast cancer. According to the International Agency for Research on Cancer, 685,000 women will pass away from breast cancer worldwide in 2020 after receiving a diagnosis of 2,261,419 cases. With early discovery and diagnosis, the disease's mortality rates can be lowered and patients' lives can be extended. Even though many screening methods have been employed for the early detection of breast cancer, including ultrasound, X-ray mammography, breast magnetic resonance imaging, computed tomography, partial emission tomography, biopsy, and breast temperature measurement, even these are, to some extent, insufficient in screening. The effectiveness and accuracy of these systems can be improved by utilizing a range of AI and deep learning models. The accuracy of a variety of distinct neural network types classified as machine learning and artificial intelligence will be explored, reviewed, and analyzed in this study. Identification, interpretation, and categorization of the genomic sequences relevant to the diagnosis of breast cancer are made much easier by these neural networks.

articleTitle: CNN and SVM-based Model for Effective Watermelon Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Watermelon farming is hampered by a variety of illnesses that harm its leaves, resulting in lower quality and yield of crops. We present a unique strategy for the precise identification of watermelon disease of the leaves using a model of deep learning in this study. Our model is made up of four convolutional layers, four max pooling levels, and one fully connected layer. Bacterial Fruits Blotch, Anthracnose, Gummy Rope Blight, Downy Mildew, Alternatives Leaves Spot, Cercospora Leaves Spot, Myrothecium Leaves Spot, and powdery Mildew are the eight watermelon leaf diseases to be predicted. For each disease, we analyse recall, precision, and F1-score to determine the model's performance. The obtained results show potential accuracy and efficacy in illness classification. Precision rates vary with the disease, with Anthracnose getting 76.00%, while values for recall also vary, with Gummy Trunk Blight reaching 75.56%. Overall, the model performs well with F1 scores, especially for Anthracnose (73.17%) and Gummy Trunk Blight (73.12%). Furthermore, the micro-average precision of 70.29% and weighting average precision of 70.26% show the model's capacity to manage imbalanced class distribution. These findings highlight the importance of our deep learning-driven technique in assisting in the early detection and discrimination of watermelon leaves diseases, hence contributing to more effective crop health monitoring and assuring long-term watermelon production.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Integrating AI, IoT, Big Data, and Blockchain Technologies: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Many facets of contemporary life may be drastically altered by the confluence of AI, IoT, Big Data, and Blockchain. When combined, these technologies hold the promise of providing robust, safe, and efficient solutions to complex problems. To better serve customers, streamline internal operations, and maximise available resources, AI could examine the mountains of data produced by Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Businesses now have the power to make data-driven choices in real time because to Big Data technology's ability to store, handle, and understand this data. By making transactions transparent and immutable on a distributed ledger, blockchain technology may improve the safety of these systems. Safer and more efficient methods of data exchange and cooperation may also be simpler to implement through decentralised networks. The impacts of integrating blockchain, big data, the internet of things (IoT), and AI are investigated in-depth in this paper. The objective is to comprehend the potential benefits and challenges brought on by the combination of these cutting-edge technologies. Manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and the financial industry are among those studied in order to assess the revolutionary consequences of integrating AI, IoT, Big Data, and the Blockchain. The study's findings add to our understanding of the synergistic potential of artificial intelligence (AI), the internet of things (IoT), big data (Big Data), and blockchain technologies, and they provide direction to firms seeking to use this potential.

articleTitle: Real-time Event Streaming for Financial Enterprise System with Kafka
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Real-time event streaming refers to the continuous and immediate processing and analysis of events as they occur in real time. Presently, Apache Kafka is a very popular and preferred framework for real-time data streaming. Data stream pipelines to serve enormous data for large organizations are built between systems in Kafka for real-time streaming. Kafka provides a distributed, scalable, and fault-tolerant platform for capturing, storing, and processing streams of events. It provisions seamless integration with different systems and applications, enabling real-time data analysis and processing. Thus, event streaming with Kafka is a modern approach to processing and analyzing large volumes of data in real-time. Event streaming with Kafka has a wide range of applications in varied industries such as finance, e-commerce, and more. It has the potential to transform the way businesses operate by enabling faster decision-making, improved operational efficiency, and better customer experiences. With financial enterprise application as our main goal, we focus on how Kafka could be a better-suited alternative to enhance event streaming.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Heart Disease Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The prevalence of cardiovascular disease has been steadily rising, driven by factors such as sedentary lifestyles, unhealthy dietary habits, tobacco use, obesity, and an aging population. According to the According to the World Health Organization (WHO) and the (GBD) study, cardiovascular disease is the main cause of death. In addition to comparing the performance of the five machine learning algorithms and two different datasets, this study also aims to investigate the impact of different algorithmic approaches on heart disease prediction. Logistic regression is a widely-used algorithm for binary classification, utilizing a linear function to model the relationship between input features and the target variable. K-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm relies on similarity measures to classify instances based on their proximity to known instances. Random forest, a powerful ensemble method, combines multiple decision trees to improve prediction accuracy. Decision tree algorithms employ a hierarchical structure of nodes and branches to make sequential decisions. Support vector machines (SVM) aim to find an optimal hyperplane that separates different classes in the feature space To conduct the evaluation, a dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository containing relevant features and corresponding heart disease labels was utilized. Prior to training and testing the algorithms, the dataset underwent exploratory data analysis to understand its characteristics. Preprocessing steps were employed to handle missing values and scale the features appropriately. To ensure unbiased evaluation, the collection of data is subsequently split between train and testing collections with a 70 to 30 ratio. Several factors, such as the F1 score, an area underneath a receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC), recall, accuracy, and exactness were used to assess the algorithms' performance. Depending on the experimental findings, the random forest method outperformed logistic regression, KNN, decision trees, and SVM in terms of all assessment measures. Its greater F1 score, AUC, recall, accuracy, and precision all point to its improved capacity to distinguish between cases and non-cases of heart disease.

articleTitle: CaptionGenX: Advancements in Deep Learning for Automated Image Captioning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The inception of an extraordinary and sophisticated image caption generating system, known as the CaptionGenX, is witnessed in the realm of artificial intelligence. This groundbreaking project embraces the realm of deep learning, an intricate discipline that enables machines to acquire knowledge and decipher complex patterns through neural networks. Within this context, the CaptionGenX embodies a pinnacle of innovation, harnessing the power of advanced deep learning techniques to unravel the intrinsic meanings concealed within images and transform them into contextually rich and linguistically refined captions. By leveraging a meticulously crafted neural network architecture, this cutting-edge system emerges as an epitome of computational prowess, engaging in a profound analysis of visual cues, intricate semantics, and subtle intricacies ingrained within the images. Through a meticulous process, the CaptionGenX seamlessly fuse them into a unified framework capable of generating captions that exhibit an exceptional level of coherence, nuance, and descriptive power. The integration of advanced deep learning methodologies and algorithms empowers the CaptionGenX to transcend the boundaries of conventional image captioning systems. It adeptly discerns and dissects the complex interplay between objects, scenes, and emotions depicted in the images, unraveling their essence with remarkable precision. Furthermore, this state-of-the-art system possesses an inherent ability to adapt and refine its captioning abilities over time, continuously learning and evolving to enhance its linguistic prowess and perceptual acuity. As an emblem of scientific ingenuity, the CaptionGenX stands poised to revolutionize the landscape of image caption generation. Its capacity to synthesize visual and textual domains, coupled with its unprecedented linguistic sophistication, renders it an invaluable tool in various domains, including multimedia analysis, content indexing, and assistive technologies for the visually impaired. With each passing milestone, this pioneering system forges new frontiers in the realm of artificial intelligence, promising a future where machines possess an extraordinary ability to comprehend and articulate the rich tapestry of the visual world.
